text: Honestly if I wasn't playing this due to a reward app I'd never touch this absolutely awful game. Many levels feel doomed from the start, and it feels deliberate in order to get you to pay for more coins. I've had far too many situations with just one card left and 5 in the deck, none of which let me win - or multiple useless cards in a row from the draw. Not saying there's no skill involved but the luck element is too big. Oh and only getting coins every hour IF you open the app is heinous.

Great game, lovely music - shame I can only play one round at a time without paying for coins as it's not a game where "lives" regenerate. You use in-game currency to pay per level you play and you get enough for one game per hour (and a top up if you win a round). If you don't collect the coins each hour, they don't store up so you can't collect more later on - no matter what time you log on, you get one hour worth of coins. I would give 5 stars if you got enough for 3 goes at a time at least.

The gameplay itself is fine and fun, but the game is sooooo evidently rigged towards making money, it's baffling. The average expenditure is 3 to 4 times what you can earn per game. This leaving the player waiting for the free coins, or paying real cash. Not to mention the 7 or 8 pop-ups geared towards buying stuff before you can actually access the game. I understand paying the Devs, but there's a point where remuneration becomes greed. Unless this changes quickly, I'll delete.

Could have been a great game - easy to play and graphics are brilliant but geared too much towards pay to play. You earn coins at the end of a completed level but then have to spend nearly all of them to play the next level so you're left with nothing to buy help when the cards don't fall right unless you purchase more coins!

Absolutely terrible format in regards to the in-game currency. It "costs" an extortionate amount to even start a level and the money does not regenerate on its own over time. Then the in-game costs for boosts are even higher with no other way to get them other than completing levels (or spending actual money which I won't do). If you actually complete a level, the reward money is only just higher than the initial cost to play! So you "spend" more than you win.

I'm /was obsessed with this game. I think I'm on level 5000 or so now and it's getting ridiculously hard to pass, the cards and settings don't make sense. managed to win about £400 just from playing it though, in about a month and a half, so happy with that. I doubt I'll put more time in it apart from a quick daily mission. no ads though. huge bonus.

If playing this because of a cash app like Testerup - Do not waste your time, and especially your money. The ability to complete stages quickly slows down and in order to continue playing you need coins, which costs money. It's very easy to get sucked into spending more money on the game than you can feasibly earn back, as there are so many tactics employed ingame to push microtransactions and "deals" to the player. It feels not much different to how online casinos hook you.

This game is amazing with the sounds and lovely Disney characters to build up with the side games. making enough coins in the day is hard and may need looking at. log in and playing a game without ads. I repeat WITHOUT ads is brilliant. You don't need to purchase coins. Just wait for timer free clocks build up during the day then. play time at night 4Stars for the enjoyment.

You have to use in game currency to even play a level, then use that same currency for more cards in said level to match up with what you have left. Then if you can't beat that level cause you have no more in game currency, you can't repeat the level you've already paid to play.... Absolute con. Literally only playing through a reward app like many others. No wonder they need these apps to lure people into their games. And cue the generic response of " thanks for feedback.... Trying to improve"

I enjoy the game but its too hard to get coins to play for any amount of time or progress/get rewards without spending money constantly. it is a very money hungry game. fed up with it really. cost of items is too much i blew through 300k coins within an hour. I have spent money on this game and I wish I hadn't. levels cost coins, mulitpilers cost coins, additional cards x5 cost 5900 coins rarely has a card in you need, wild card to get rid of the final card 11k coins. lots of complaints on this.

Playing for a reward app. The in game currency earned does not match what in game currency you spend. Double cards in packs and always seem to pick cards I need after spending to add to the hand - only to be rewarded with less of a coin total than when you went in with. Then here comes the kicker, after the game has you wasting your coins you're flooded with purchase offers for real money. I get that Developers need to earn but you won't get a lasting paying player base by deception.

DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS GAME!!!!!!! ITS RIGGED. I was doing really well as I got higher and invested money to play it. I noticed how they have rigged it so as I bought more coins, what would happen is the cards became more scarce to help you finish. which meant you were backed in a corner and had to purchase more cards to be able to finish. which are through your in-game money. the same with the prizes in the mini games. it's not worth it I invested over £50 and they screwed me. so do not be fooled

this can be a fun game to play; however, there are too many in-app purchases, too many 'events' that don't last long enough to achieve any of the goals, never an opportunity to collect all of the cards in the album collections. If the developers don't want to award high coin prizes to many players, then don't offer high prizes. I would rather be able to complete an album than win hundreds of thousands of coins. I'd prefer easier achievements & lower prize amounts

No difference to other solitaire games except you can't just open the game and play. You are hit by at least 5 "buy me" in game ads as soon as you open the game! No progress without paying so don't bother, unless you are happy to save everything over the week to have one day where you can get a little progress. Not worth it just for Disney characters!

Entirely pay to win, there's only one currency & it's coins, the levels get difficult after a while and make it impossible to play without using more coins. No ads to get more.I basically have to wait for the coin bonus then play a level and if I lose that level I'm screwed till the next bonus. It starts really good, you get loads of coins and loads of wins and you play it quickly but then all of a sudden it's difficult and your coins run out FAST. It's a shame because it's a really good game.

It seems most levels are geared towards only being winnable either after several attempts or by purchasing additional cards. Game play credit only refills slightly, once an hour. The graphics are great, with lots of Disney characters and scenes to build from credits gained when you win a game. But it's clearly geared toward pushing purchases which is a shame especially for a kid friendly game.

the game is addictive and fun, but, PLEASE tell me why I am on level 470, paying 11,400 coins and Still not playing for more than 1 Star to progress?? The game throws many multipliers at you but refuses to award more than one gold star, even with Epic x4 multiplier, even at level 400. The cost of playing a game increases every 20 levels or so, but paying 11,400 coins Only to receive a pay-up of about 2000 coins is disgusting.

Impossible to win regularly without paying and if you do manage to win the rewards are barely enough to keep playing they also shrink after a loss. Often you will get multiple cards in a row that you can't use at that moment meaning that you can't win that round, you can get additional packs of cards to try and make it through but good luck getting any you can actually use to complete the round. Or you can buy a wild card for much more than the cost of another attempt.

I'm sorry but this game is horrible! You don't even earn lives over a period of time. Unless you spend money, you have to log in every hour to collect 2K coins which isn't even enough to start a level! Once you advance a little bit, it costs more to start a level than the measly amount of coins you collect. Forget if you need extra cards. The premise is great, but it's just another pay to win game. Do better Disney!

The coin situation is getting really annoying. Use your coins to actually play a level?! Seriously?! Use more coins to reshuffle the cards. Definitely a better way to do this. Recommend a friend who played 20 levels and no reward given as the game promised. The game is no longer fun with this coin issue. I also keep getting notifications about events and when I click on it... Absolutely nothing. Don't recommend it.

Great game - ANNOYING PAYMENT POP-UPS It's not quite like solitaire but still fun enough to keep me playing. I like building the scenes. However, there are at least 8 blooming pop-ups asking if I want to purchase the "Spring", "Hades", "Ratatouille", "Monsters Inc", "Bolt" and more packages. It ruins the feel of the game. Too many payment options actually makes me not want to purchase any. Too complicated.

when you get through the 10+ pop ups that appear when you open the game, it's pretty good. the actual solitaire part is fun and it has mechanics that make it interesting, but the blatant money grabbing is almost unbearable. you can always tell when the game will stop letting you win, and when it'll be nice to you again because you're short on coins. it's borderline predatory since this is a Disney game that kids will likely find and play.

The game itself is fun, but it's very obviously built on trying to sell you stuff. pop-up "buy this deal" sometimes 4 or 5 of them in a row, constant need to spend money or wait an hour for coins, the game i like but you barely get to play it because you're just waiting for the timer to allow you to play without paying. Edit: as I've played more it gets even worse for being unplayable without paying. I have to drop the rating to 2 star.

impossible to continue playing behind the first few chapters without spending heaps of money. each level costs twice as much as you earn back for completing it and then the cost of each level goes up as does the cost of everything else. i wouldn't recommend playing it unless you want to spend at least £30 a day. you also never get the day 7 daily rewards. it just goes back to day 1.

Started out loving the game but it soon became clear that there was an egregious system behind it. In tried and tested style you get to a certain point and you have to start paying to progress. To begin with I didn't mind a dip into the wallet here and there but, again, as is typical a £2.99 investment which basically provided enough resources for a reasonable session early on lasts for mere minutes after clearing lvl 100 or so - if you want to progress you have to pay more for less time. Shame

I downloaded this as I play a similar solitaire game and enjoy the format. If you're a fan of Disney, you'll have fun building up the scenes as a plus. My only suggestion would be to be increase the stars you get in the x2 and x4 levels. I would be more inclined to spend coins in a higher level of play in exchange of more stars, particularly since some scenes stages take 8-10 stars (perhaps more, I haven't been playing for that long).

The first couple of levels are great, loads of rewards and plenty of in-game coins so you don't need to make a purchase... up until about level 20 because the levels become more and more unplayable. I didn't download a game like this expecting to open it, play one level then run out of coins and have to wait the hour it takes for coins to regenerate just for an unlikely chance at winning another level... if you run out of cards, you can 'buy' 5 more... 3 of the 5 for me were unusable! Joke

its a decent game, solitaire is easy enough to play, you go through levels and earn stars to make a Disney scene and coins needed to play levels and additional help (extra cards/wildcards). I dont think it would hold the attention of younger gamers as it slows down by scene 4 due to the cost of levels. I think your first attempt of each level should be free. im on level 90+ now and its really pushing me to spend money to be able to keep playing through levels. save your coins on earlier levels

Relatively fun game, no ads which is refreshing.. But some issues make the game a lot less fun than it could be: 1. The multitude of pop up in game extras that you have to go through almost every time you open the app up, or sometimes after playing a level. It gets really tedious. 2. When you play a level, often it feels like its pure luck if you get any matching cards to the point of feeling unfair. 3. The Vs matches like paw draw i feel are too difficult, favours pay to win players.

This is a perfect example of just how low developers can sink. Rewards are getting smaller, the cost of helpers is rising, each level has an entry fee that also goes up, and the game gets harder all the time. The odds are stacked against you more than in a casino. In the end you have two options: pay up or quit playing. This is a trap not a game.

Whilst I love the game itself, getting through the constant stream of pop ups trying to entice you to spend is very off putting. The game appears rigged to get you to spend money on a regular basis or accept that you will play one game every now and then and usually win which ever level in the morning. Given that it is a Disney game it likely to appeals to kids and the mixing of monetary and non-monetary purchases appears is predatory. I can't see it changing due to the number of similar reviews

Horrible predatory game aimed at extracting as much money out of little children as possible. I downloaded this game to complete a free cash back offer and am blown away with the predatory practices that this game employs to try and extract money from you. The game itself is fine, the problem is to play a single level you need to spend a Ingame currency which run out very quickly and the only way to replenish them is to wait an hour for enough for one level, or buy them at ridiculous prices.

I've been playing this for a long time now, I dont like how it gradually trys to get you to spend more and more money the further you advance through the levels. levels are very quick so you could spend a ridiculous amount of money if you were venerable or had a gambling addiction. I like the Disney spin on solitaire and making the scenes, they take a long time to build though. I do feel like this is all about finding ways to take your money. I wouldn't let my son play it.

I keep having to log in for rewards all for cards to be very hard to catch below or under for over 7x, prices are also over the roof once u reach a certain point, pointless game after a certain level, that's why I use the golden card all the time, Id rather just log in for a whole year claim the coins and then play, it's worth doing that instead. Thanks.

**They replied with the same from a month ago - clearly not doing anything about it though!*** Reduced to 1 star. No change in amount of pop ups or cost. Uninstalled. Too many Pop Ups. Open the game to 10-15 pop ups and then after a level yet more pop ups. Your algorithm is set wrong for higher levels. I won't be spending any money as the cost is a joke! If wasn't being paid to play I would uninstall.

came back to give it a real try.. im now over level 800. it cost 14,000 to play epic game but its x3.. so someone explain to me if you complete the level you only get 17, 000 coins.. every 2 minutes you get the buy this or that adds.. each level goes up in price but the coins returned dont match.. so its definitely designed to make you buy extra stuff..

it's rigged to fail you from the start. You're given points for completing levels, in which you have to spend points to play and win within. When you get your x amount of coins, you're barely breaking even. The devs force then expenditure further with certain game modes forcing you to spend more. It's insulting, pretending to dangle a carrot in front of you with the "rewards" while they take even more from you. Only playing because of FreeCash.

would be a great app BUT each level costs points to play, when you win your reward is just a tad more than what it costs to play the next level. So lose one game and you don't have enough to play on. When you do accrue some extra points, the have is set against you winning, forcing you to either lose your streak or pay more than a new game in points for a few extra cards, suddenly you are out of points and unable to play on ad well as losing your streak. Really frustrating

Frustrating experience. You basically get to play one game an hour and coins only top up once. Coins should be able to be built up so that when you come back on you can play multiple games. Short lived experience and have uninstalled due to above. Shame as has the makings of being a great game.

I came back to this after a long break. The pop ups are FRUSTRATING and far too many please get rid of them or make them less in your face. Still hasn't integrated a lives system, so any coins you get are gone and you can't play anymore without having to purchase which even then is pointless because they up the coin requirements as you progress in levels. If you have money to burn, then this game is for you, but if your f2p don't bother. Definitely a cash grab game 😔

A fun and engaging game however after a recent game update the cost of a round of solitaire is higher than the number of coins you receive every hour or win the daily rewards. You need to stop make levels so hard regardless of what mode your playing on it is taking myself many attempts to complete the majority of games. I am beginning to think that it is not worth it. ADVICE I would stop increasing the cost to play every so many levels and leave them be otherwise you will loose a lot of players.

The design of the game and the levels and all it's super fun, but you need to constantly spend money so you can continue to play. You don't regenerate lives you spend coins on levels and this is quite annoying. Obviously you want to make money out of it, but it's so sad you chose Disney theme to do it. #SAD

I raced through the first 100 levels no issue. Then the levels become unwinnable and cost more and more coins with each level. It has become clear this game has been developed simply to make players spend money. I will be uninstalling this as I am not willing to spend a fortune to play solitaire.

This game starts out great but it becomes a disgusting cash grab after you have been playing for so long. So many times I get stuck on a level that doesn't even give me a legitimate way to win the level in order for you to spend your coins. It's an extremely scummy tactic knowing people will want to finish a level and spend money to do so.

The gameplay itself is polished with levels looking like a diorama. The coin system is broken and feels designed to make you spend money. The plus five extra cards or wild card assists constantly increase in price. The rewards for completing levels are static and very low. I.e it costs 4400 coins to play, if you win you might get 5500 coins max. Plus five cards is 8500 coins approximately and a wild card 11000 coins at level 149. You will need to use them meaning you play at a net loss.

Extremely rigged to be Pay-to-Win which is pretty damn predatory considering Disney is predominantly for Children. Edit: Yeah this game has been out for a year and hasn't changed the Pay-to-Win aspect at all for the better. You (the developers) are definitely not going to change anything and you know it. As usual, another greedy company.

would be good, but want you to spend so much money to require to contiune playing, it sincerely waiting for you to get to a point to win something bigger before making sure you fail at the biggest prize. not to mention itll eventually ruin your game with so many ads when you open the game to try and make you spend your real time life to pay for it. please dont waste your own life just to play a free to play game (its just not free to play)

Once you get past a certain point you have to buy the in game currency or you just won't win. I played the same level 7 times without buying a wildcard or the extra cards and lost every time. I even used over a dozen rewinds just to make sure I chose the best cards in the most efficient order. I'd have one or two cards left on the field and sometimes up to ten left in my draw pile but still couldn't beat the level without buying upgrades. It's all a scam!

I like the graphics and game itself, my problem is that there are no options to watch videos to gain coins or better side missions that offer more coins or free plays. After playing the game for a few months it's not worth it. The cost of each game keeps going up. Right now my level takes 5k coins and I receive between 6k-7k if I win. Most games like this allow you to receive the coins when you hit streaks. This one doesn't. Also the stars go up but you can only win 1 at a time.

Was roped into this game through my Earnin app. was offering double cash rewards for play. I thought it was progress based. I went as far as level 34 and was told to wait 24hrs to see any cash. I have yet to see a dime. lots of encouragement to spend my own real money. Why would I be trying to play a game for cash if I have cash to spend? So Dumb. And a huge scam and waste of time. I figured I'd see something after level 20. Asinine.

It's a Disney game - meaning OF COURSE there's going to be an insane amount of pay walls and pay to continue moments. that's literally their whole company... the first 50 levels feel fun and normal, but then you'll be set up with cards that do not match at all with a deck of cards that don't even allow you to start or move forward, forcing you to keep wasting coins on the level, or just straight up buying with real money to get through. the games mechanics switch A LOT.. every 10 levels or so.

Update: The cost of everything just keeps growing the farther you get. You will lose more and more games. I've just played the basic level, which are now $18000. Forget getting extra cards, they're twice the cost of a single play, hit $200000 for one game. You will go through multiple sets and get not one to help. Ad bonus stops helping. Any 3+ reviews here are likely app farming. This game doesn't function like it came from a multi-billion dollar corp. Worse than Disney MK app. Embarrassing.

I like this game! The card game is fun and the Disney scenes are cute. But there are coins in the game, and the way the game is set up, you slowly lose more coins than you earn. Then they keep trying to get you to pay real money for more coins. Lots of popups, $1.99 for 2 or 3 games worth of coins. They do gift free coins sometimes, but not much. I would rate the game 5 stars if there was a way to keep playing for free, and more coin rewards. I would be willing to watch ads to get more coins.

Great game, solid game play, but it's basically 100% pay to win. Once you're out of coins (which are easy to accidentally spend) you only get one refill (ie ONE PLAY) per hour. Who has the patience for that? And if you don't pass a level you can't reset it to try again, you have to replay it and that costs coins so you just have to wait an hour to do a re-deal. What a money grab.

I liked this game at first. It was nice to play a game with no ads. I was lucky too- I won lots of levels without running out of coins. As soon as I decided to spend a few dollars though, the game became infinitely harder. Now I lose about 75% of the time, and I'm always out of coins. the only reason I haven't uninstalled it yet, is that I have several other games to turn to when I get shut out of this one. Now I wish it did have ads, so that there was an option to keep playing without $.

Great app but unfortunately like most apps focused on making money, once you reach the higher levels it's almost impossible to complete a board without the need to spend money. When you first start playing, the rewards allow you to play additional cards when you need them and give you enough coins to play another game. But as you progress in the game, it costs more and more coins to play a new game and now it costs more than 10k coins for me to get extra cards when I have one left to clear, 😭

For 2 days straight I've been stuck in a loop of pop ups in game. When I try to start a round, all of the pop ups for purchase start and I can never start a new game. It goes through all 5 or 6 of them, goes back to the start new game screen, and then all the pop ups come back again. I am able to play w couple rounds when I first open the app, but then this happens again.

The gameplay is fun and the visuals are delightful. If you take the time to log in every hour and build your coins up you could play entirely for free. That said the game is addictive and the bundles they sell to keep you going are predatory. I also do not like that this game interrupts my audio, even when I mute this games music and effects. And it keeps crashing, usually I can get back in right away, but today I've tried four times to open the game and it keeps crashing.

Good game play but unless you put actual money into it, its a losing battle. As you need coins to enter a game, you only get back about a quarter in winnings as what you put in. It's all set up as a cash grabbing app. Games and cards get more expensive as you go along and almost impossible to get the "free extras" like collecting cards and winning games first round unless you invest a small fortune. Pop-ups within the game are annoying too. Deleting.

great card game, I like the various styles of gameplay. but the pop-ups to buy in-game stuff are ridiculous. not to mention the cards aren't an actual deck. you will have SEVERAL of the exact same card and suit and next to nothing of other cards, making being able to win a game next to impossible. so of course you spend all the allotted money on games within an hour. and your earnings is next to nothing, making it where you really can't play nearly as much as I would like

So the game is polished, looks good, etc, etc. The thing I'm wondering is if it purposely feeds you levels you can't win in order to (potentially) entice you to spend money? UPDATE. I've played a lot and determined 2 things, don't spend money. Just stop when you're done. Save coins throughout the day and play casually. Events always end, new ones start. You'll always fluctuate coins. I had 500k yesterday, played for hours, then lost it all in minutes. Don't drop real money unless you want to.

While fun to play, this game absolutely is pay-to-win. I went from 100,000 coins to not being able to play any game. You get down to one or two cards and seven or eight left in your deck, and yet NOT able to pull a card to finish the puzzle. Meanwhile, other puzzles will rifle off a ton of applicable cards in a row that somehow seem to match every card on the board. This game doesn't let you stay successful for very long, all in an attempt to get you to spend your money on bonuses. GREED.

The game is cute and fairly easy for the first two chapters. once you hit the third, you are consistently having to spend all your coins for either more cards or a wild card to complete levels. I'm able to do 1 sometimes 2 plays before I've used all my coins and have to wait for more. Now, you can then purchase coins through their many "Specials" going on if you don't want to wait. I do like that there are no ads, aside from their own pop-ups wanting you to purchase with real money.

Game is cute & fun. No ads. Love it. Originally downloaded it so my kid would improve with numbers. But you can't progress without spending REAL money. Never enough time to finish challenges without spending REAL money. I have put so much real money into this game, I refuse to do so anymore. To earn coins the free way takes forever, so I only get to play like once every 2 days. My son has lost interest in playing, he waits for me to earn enough stars or puzzle pieces so he can do that part.

This game becomes costly very quickly. Around level 25 the cost to play each level increases significantly as well as any aides. The same is true of the stars needed to get puzzle pieces. Not coincidentally, as the cost goes up the ability to pass levels gets difficult to pass without help; this occurs around level 30. There are far better options for Solitaire game play, but if you are a diehard Disney fan you will enjoy the cute and colorful graphics. I deleted around level 45.

I had to edit this review after playing awhile more. My biggest gripes with this game that actually makes so angry is the fact you have to pay coins to play a level which, that in itself, is absolutely absurd. Then, you can flip SEVERAL cards with not a single move. So many times I can get down to one card and have 8+ cards left, and flip them all either not a single playable move. So, now you are telling me I have to spend coins for a wild or add more cards or just to replay the level? insane

The gameplay is fun...once you finally GET to it. I'd play this game so often if it didn't take sooo long just to actually get to it. All of the in-app purchase, minigames, and event popups are ridiculous and a MASSIVE annoyance. The game would be near perfect aside from that, but there is no way to stop it from happening. It's ridiculous.

The game is nice and casual for the first 100 levels or so. But after that, it costs so much to play a single level and there's no other way to replenish energy other than logging in every hour to claim the coins for ONE play. I also have a feeling that the cards are not shuffled fairly. There were times I drew 8 cards and didn't get a single card that would help me continue. This game is predatory to the bone and it wants you to spend money to play. Extremely F2P unfriendly.

This game started off great. As you progress through the levels, however, it becomes incredibly difficult to play without spending money. Coins get drained very fast. I understand it's disney and as a huge dinsey fan myself I was drawn to the app, however, there are many other solitaire options out there that don't try to drain your bank account.

This game is flat out cash grab! it's fun at first, then it takes forever to go to the next scene because doing the solitaire part you run out of cards and you spend tons of coins to finish one level! I had to buy 45k coins and spent all on one level because they aren't fair with the flips! you waste a lot of coins! the wilds are a waste in coins! 9k to get one wild! not worth it! fun at first, but after scene frozen you'll get frustrated! I'm uninstalling! it's not right!

Want to like it, but it's seeming borderline rigged to lose. It's not just wow I'm unlucky. It's I've gotten the same number 3 times in a row, wasting 3 draws. When there's already 2 of said number on the board. Past level 50 and now grinded to a halt fast. Nothing really to even do at this point, I'm not paying for anything in a game that makes their cash grab so obvious.

I have to complete 29 scenes in just over 80 days to get $3 value for a rewards program I'm in. I have spent over $30. I despise this game & I used to like solitaire. You can't watch a video to gain any coins or help whatsoever. I should have just uninstalled in 1 day & downloaded any other game! Do not recommend, it's like gambling, no skill, just chance. I never made it past 12 scenes. This game has been a total waste of my time & $.

the game okay is great and the Disney theme is fun but the pop ups are really annoying. between every round you have to x out of at least three pop-ups. nothing advertising third party things all trying to get you to spend money within the game. Every round costs coins but every hour you can redeem coins. All of the pop-ups trying to get you to purchase extra coins it's just super annoying. I can only imagine someone accidentally clicking purchase instead of x'ing out of the pop-up

The game is super fun and was one of my favorites but it's completely rigged after a certain level. It purposely doesn't give you the cards you need so you end up spending coins to progress. I managed to figure out a pattern, you can win 1-2 games free everyday, afterwards you gotta spend real money or the in game coins which you also need to play every level (and spend to retry every level)

I downloaded this game on launch day. It is very cute and fun! I am currently on level 180. However, I had to spend quite a bit of real money to get that far. I feel the game would be more enjoyable with a better cost-to-winnings ratio.bI will continue to play when I can, but I refuse to dump money into the game every other day just to keep progressing. I also feel that most of the mini-games involved are pretty much unobtainable unless you're winning to spend a good amount of money.

So tired of solitaire games that once you get to a certain lol (usually less than a week worth of play), it takes 3 to 5 (or more) hands to actually win a hand & since each win essentially only gets you enough coins to play one more hand, if you don't pay to play you basically get one hand per hr. This is the same. But even worse since it is nearly impossible to or takes forever to win a challenge that could get you more coins. Way more to say but unfortunately not enough room.

This game has so much potential. but due to the ridiculous amount of coins it takes to play it makes it obnoxious. 1st as you advance it requires more coins just to play the level. 2nd it cost an insane amount of coins to purchase +5 cards while you're in a level. A wonderful mix of solitaire and Disney magic!The card game is fairly basic solitaire but with clear, colorful graphics and, of course the enchanting music and sounds which only Disney can produce. Game can be fun. Many unwinnable levels, but can get through eventually. The same stage when you repeat it has different cards, so it usually makes you fail the first time and succeed the second.
