I love almost everything about this game! The graphics are amazing! The colors are beautiful! I love, love, LOVE, the themes! All Disney of course! And let's not forget the actual game playing part, lol! It's A highly addictive, fun form, of Solitaire. As the levels get higher the more "difficult" it gets! The little "side" games are fun too! The SERIOUSLY ANNOYING & just about worth uninstalling it altogether part?? It FREEZES way TOO OFTEN & for way TOO LONG! Fix that & it'll be perfect!

Coin Trap avoid!!!! Graphics ate very good. the game is very generous in the beginning for coins and prizes. Tou get justbthe cards need to finishnthe level. But when you hit 40K coins or so, when the levels start to advance you start not to get the cards and you need and you have to ask extra cards which is 1.5 times the game price. then even with single extension you can not find the cards you need you go for second and third extension. So you start to loose 10 times more then you win.

Disappointed. Unfortunately spend $50+ & you're NEVER able to complete an entire Album (all sets) except for 1 single card, had 12 days left on the event and spent $20-30 and NEVER got the final prize! Even though you can fill some up in a day, you can't ever get it all. As with the kitchen, 1 ingredient will never be filled to complete all sets. Now they've added another impossible task, collect characters. Walt would be ashamed, not getting your money's worth!!!!!

After playing over a 1000 levels I can tell you that this game sucks. You generate coins way to slowly to make meaningful progress. You have no control over whether you win /loss a level because you have no idea what cards you are going to draw, every level starts out great but screeches to a halt when there are only a few cards left because there's nothing to match them with. I was getting paid to play and I still couldn't continue. Edit: Companies that use Ai generated responses get punished.

Disappointingly dull game. The ads lead you to believe there's a certain level of storyline and interactiveness in the gameplay, but there's nothing of the sort. You just play solitaire, and get pieces to put together scenes that you aren't even able to interact with. Tons of wasted potential :( Edit: I didn't say anything about the coins or cost.. it's just a very boring, non-interactive game.

Starts off with a form of solitaire. pretty decent overall. But it's just another typical cash grab. You earn coins by completing a level of some achievement. but most of those coins are used just to start a level. There's a cost to start a level. Then if you run out of cards, there's a cost to buy more. which increases as you progress. my leat favorite part is the stars required for the scenes, which jumps dramatically when you reach the Moana scene. From an average of 3-4 stars to 11+ for each

The gameplay and graphics are polished and satisfying, but you could do a study on predatory app behavior with this game. You're hit with "Buy now!" ads in groups of two to four every time the game opens (and during play), coins are few and far between, the items are almost required to clear levels and they're obscenely expensive. Coin prices raise with the levels and it voids any fun the game may have provided.

I want to like this game, but it is frustrating. there are multiple times I run through a whole deck without a card that works. so you just lose levels over and over again. there really is no progression. you have to spend money to get further & that's not worth it. you can't even get close to winning any of the big side games because you need too many "butterflies, puzzle pieces, lamps" you name it.

I really loved this game to begin with, but the amount of coins needed to play each round continued to get increasingly higher, to the point of not being able to play without pay. I bought a few packages thinking it would last a long time, but even when purchasing, the coins run out after just a few rounds. I no longer have a desire to play because the fun is gone. Even after waiting an our for the bonus points, those points no longer cover the coins needed to play a single round.

Bad Card Game overall!! the game charges you in-game currency to play each round. It would be fine, except the way the card game works is bad. You start the game with the possibility of not having any possible matches off the start. Then, when you go to draw a card to match it to the deck, you could draw 5 times before even getting a match. You will ultimately spend extra coins in order to pass a single level it ridiculous!!! play to see what I mean. Disney characters and design is cool.

Starts out really fun, easy to win & progress. But the more you progress the more infuriating the game becomes, it costs way too much to play a game, & an absolutely ridiculous amount to buy extra cards to finish a game. Don't play this game unless you plan on spending lots of money for coins because past a certain level you literally can't progress without paying real money. Such a bummer to have such a fun game made by such greedy people.

It was ok at first except it takes a lot of coins and long waits to get more to play a round. The worse is when you finally make it to day 7 log in for big prize, you can't collect it without a error message and it says restart app... which didn't fix anything... just repeats error over and over. ..to the point you can't play the game anymore because the log in keeps popping up and then forcing restart. No choice but to uninstall it because I can't even play it now.

The game is pretty fun but the app is broken. It used to crash all the time and cause me to lose rewards when it was (mostly) working but for the last couple weeks or so, it won't even open. When I open the app it says there's an error and to restart the game but the error message never goes away and I can't get into the app at all anymore. ETA customer service told me I should have certain system requirements back when I reported it crashing and losing rewards and my phone does meet those.

The game is good. But. You cannot play the next level without paying coins. The prices for each items you'd wanna buy is expensive. And sometimes, I think the game is rigged to make you buy more. The moment you have lots of coins, you'd be forced to spend it in one go just to proceed. Plus, some items needing for the cooking event can only be taken if you purchase that 19.99 usd amount.

This game has so much potential, the gameplay is so much fun, but it is literally impossible to win after a certain point unless you buy in game currency. The game is so clearly rigged against you, there will be one card left on the table, and 8 left in my pile, and not one of them will match with the card on the table. Getting extra cards, or using a wild card costs double the coins it costs to even play, you can easily spend over 15,000 coins trying to win a single game.

Its fun for the first 100 levels or so, but around the level 80 mark, you will realize that its going to become a shameless cash grab. And it does...after level 140 or so, you have to save up a days worth of hourly bonuses(about 20k coins) in order to play one round without having to buy the premium currency or quit. Its just not fun at that point! Friendly advice, find a good, ad free, no premium currency tripeaks solitaire game(thats this games solitaire style), and turn on a Disney Movie!

All the positive reviews are bot reviews. Great reviews are short = fake. Notice recent reviews are VERY low. Fun at first, but gets harder and harder to where you would have to spend money to continue. 5-6 pop-ups at the beginning of each session to spend $$$! I finally got fed up. It gives you just enough free coins every hour to play 1 time, unless you win. Then if you win, just enough coins to play 1 more time. Disney = money grab from children.

good scam. Here's the play... Promo to win $75 if you complete a certain amount of levels. (through promo ads). You figure you'll play when you can, and not spend any real money. Eventually the levels get harder and impossible without spending a few bucks here and there. At least that's what you think... you will spend a few bucks because you think you know your getting $75. so what's a few bucks if you're getting 75, right? Wrong. you use up quickly what you purchased and never win. Ur welcome.

This game could be fun if it weren't for the slimy, greedy way it tries to force you to spend money. It is honestly worse than the majority of games with micro transactions. Instead of passive stamina, you are forced to open the app once an hour to collect coins used to play the game. And since the game relies on some chance, it can screw you over at any time.

the gameplay loop is quite addictive although how it works is different from other solitaire games. whatever card from your deck you pull, you have to go down or up one to place it. this is a pay to play game, but it does give you roughly enough coins every hour to do a play without needing to buy anything. the biggest thing I can brag on is the execution- all Disney characters are in different 3D models with interesting and good animation. they could have completely phoned it in but didn't.

Don't waste your time playing this game. when you actually start enjoying it you'll have to pay if you wanna play because you lose every level and it costs money to buy more coins to play or you have to long on constantly through the day to barely get any coins...the coins given versus wins is disappointing. I'm at the frozen level and my goal is " let it go" ironically don't mind if I do! UNISTALLED lol

This isn't Klondike solitaire, or any other type of solitaire I've ever played. Suits don't matter, there are no columns, there aren't multiple piles. You just tap over and over, picking a number that's one above or below the card shown. It's very boring, imo. It's got the bland, simple, repetitive nature that would be good for teaching toddlers about numbers.. if there weren't the typical Disney pay-to-win tactics. But those are veeery much present. So I can't even give it a star for that.

Game is fun but they are really trying to scam you to buy things. a lot of push adds to buy more content. Keep raising the price of levels and making them more complicated so you would have to pay. The levels sometimes aren't finished without spending a bunch of in game currency, which you can but if out of currency. almost looking like you may only be able to play a game every couple of hours the ways it's going.

This game starts off so fun until it gets to a point where it is impossible to win without spending the game currency which urges you to buy more if you want to play more than one game a day. As you level up, those in-game prices continually increase as well. It eventually became too frustrating to tolerate after completing hundreds of levels.

it is an excellent and fun game.... for an hour or two. after that it costs more for one game-saving boost than you get in the hourly free coins, and there is no passive coin gain. you have to log in every hour for like 3 hours just to play one hand. very disappointing. if they offered an ad for 25,000 coins or passive coin gain, I'd change my review.

I found this game on my fetch app. I was trying to earn double points they had a special going.I realized I was really enjoying the game. Now that I'm deep into it I'm realizing it's impossible! Just as every other review I read on here. I know your gonna send me that generic response like everyone else got and that's frustrating! It's simple to fix it so coins are easier to get. At least give enough free ones to actually pass a board! I'm searching for a new solitar..Sucks! Wish I didn't have 2

The pay to play scheme is frustrating and embarrassing, and based on the information found online, they have continuously increased the number of stars needed to get ahead, even for the same scenes/levels. Often the levels cannot even be solved without using a booster or paying extra coins with ridiculous amounts. It was fun in the first few levels but not anymore! Don't play this game unless you are willing to spend money or have A LOT of patience

This is extremely fun. Until for no reason , even if you've got every play correct , it ensures that you have to buy something . I get very fresh frustrating when you use your only coins to have to buy a pack of cards for the one card that you need. Without purchases, you cannot make it past the levels with just the bonuses. You collect. . I've never been so frustrated playing a game, I thoroughly enjoy and happen to stop and be stumped.Because I don't have a few dollars. I wish the company wou

I have changed my view on this game. I really enjoy playing it but it is ridiculous how most rounds I can't even finish without using some kind of booster. I have spent some cash over the last month since stated playing hoping it would get me more of an advantage of the game. Nope just a waste of money. You need to make it easier to complete levels and give more coins. all the reviews on here are terrible. Just think if you actually made it achievable you would get so many more people to play.

Very pretty aesthetically but the game is unplayable. Once you're a few scenes in, the games are clearly designed to be almost impossible to complete without spending coins. I wouldn't even mind spending money occasionally but I bought $10 worth of coins and the levels are so expensive that I managed to get through two before they were gone. Ridiculously expensive for a solitaire game. Also the pop-ups are infuriating.

DLed the game for research after a number of people told me how greedy it is. BY FAR THE GREEDIEST GAME I HAVE EVER PLAYED. I have thoroughly documented everything and plan on releasing it for as many ppl as possible to see. I'm on lvl 2413. It costs 10k per round. 25k FOR A SINGLE WILD. When you first start playing a single round is 1k. Absolutely no reason to increase the cost of everything as you progress... other than greed. It's Disney affiliated so it's not much of a surprise. DISGUSTING

This is a money app, The game is fun the characters and sounds are cute but like anything with Disney, if you want the fun and the experience, it will cost you. I thought the Monopoly Go app was a money grab, but as usual Disney will not be out done. I play plenty of games on my phone and I have NEVER seen a game this expensive to play. But again it's Disney so it's to be expected. And developers of the game, you can keep your generic unhelpful response to yourself.

This game is absolutely infuriating. The idea is good, but executed so most of the levels are literally impossible to complete without help from the boosters, which cost an obscene amount the longer you play. They're designed for you to fail, or to spend ingame money to pass, and the moment you're out you need to wait over an hour to play one single level you'll probably fail again. The only way to move past that wait is paying. Plus the art style looks really AI-ish. Don't recommend.

the game can be fun, that's undeniable. however there are too many unfun elements to give it a higher rating. you clearly have a better experience when paying, but also if you start buying packs, you're essentially locked in to spending money to progress. there are entirely TOO MANY POP-UPS when trying to start the game. I shouldn't have to close 6 different pop-ups to get to the gameplay. hardly any event is able to be completed without paying. it's a racket.

To be honest, I wasn't expecting this to be much. I tend to avoid mobile games like this like the plague but it has been fun. A good solitaire type game with a bunch of Disney scenes and characters. A fun pastime for Disney adults. Edit: After a certain point it starts shoving microtransactions in your face every time you load up or do certain things, especially if you're out of coins, and it's hard to get enough coins for free to play more than a couple levels an hour.

The other 1 star reviews are spot on. I've spent money, around $8, on this game trying to buy coins to win levels. You get close to winning, but never quite close enough before the time runs out. The app says I haven't gotten my daily rewards, when I have played DAILY, but customer service says it's just a glitch they are trying to repair. The levels are almost impossible to win after you get past a certain point. It's fun in the beginning, but quickly becomes frustrating.

fun game, pretty relaxing, enjoyable animation scenes, but patience based. If you're looking at moving quickly, you will have to make purchases. Other than that, the game is solid. I will say that the set building and task reward system is amusing, but some of the collecting rewards also have a purchase to progress point, which ultimately ruins the experience of finishing tasks. with that being said, I actually enjoy the game, and the streak rewards are pretty good. I will update as I play.

The game itself is fine. Cute little Disney Solitaire game with a slight twist. but it loses 3 stars due to the amount of pop ups EVERYTIME you open the game. I'm not exaggerating when I saw AT LEAST 6 or more pop ups asking you to spend money on different "deals". You can't skip them, and you have to hit the very small X in the corner to close them and make then to away. Really frustrating.

As many other reviewers have said, the game starts out simple enough, but you will inevitably need to pay money to continue to advance. I'm on scene 8 (level 200-something) and the cost to continue isn't worth playing. Getting "free" 2,000 coins every few hours when it costs 10,000 to play a level means you MIGHT get to play 2 or 3 levels a day, if you win. Wild card costs 21,000 coins. Even the very expensive packs might have a free level ticket or two with the coins, but not worth the cost.

The constant attempts to make you spend money are unbearable. And even after I've tried to play through that, my game has glitched and broke my 70+ day streak. Every time I try to log on, it tells me "There was a problem Please restart the game." I've updated the game and it still won't work. Even after attempting for five minutes each time, I'm still unable to play. And I have no way to reach customer support because I can't get into the god forsaken game.

This game is pay to play, which is a crazy thing to say. most games are pay to win, but with this game, you have to pay money if you want to play past the first few scenes. You get around 2,000 free coins every 3 hours. a level costs around 2,500+ just to start. If you need help in a level (which you will), then you're playing 5,000+ coins per help. A single level can cost over 40k coins. almost a full week of free coin collecting for a single level. insane

Once you get past a certain point you have to buy the in game currency or you just won't win. It's all a scam! There are coins in the game, and the way the game is set up, you slowly lose more coins than you earn. Then they keep trying to get you to pay real money for more coins. Lots of popups, $1.99 for 2 or 3 games worth of coins. And the constant ads to spend more and more money. I have a screen with 8+ different offers to suck your wallet. AVOID! Disney just looking for a cash grab!

Don't make a purchase!!!!!!!!! I was playing and winning pretty frequently with just losing here and there it was actually fun..... then I made the mistake of making a purchase now I've been stuck doing the same 3 levels for a week now. I will just delete it since unless I pay I can't play more than one try every hour, nobody has that kind of time and when I do have time I'm not wasting it on a game I'm just going to continue to lose because I won't spend more money on it.

The good: extremely fun, and addictive, version of solitaire and highly recommend! The bad: it's a complete money grab. You pretty much have to pay to play and that really sucks. EDIT: The constant money grab makes this game annoying. You have to pay for coins, or wait hours to collect very few free coins, just to advance. It's a great concept and fun to play, but not worth it.

This would be an amazing app, but all the push to buy buy buy is too much. Also, I wish the levels weren't so tedious to get through. 77 Stars needed for Level 19 scene takes forever, etc. I used to play daily. Now it's maybe twice a week. Come up with different side games to win things, stop all the pushing to buy, and lesson the amount of stars needed to pass levels. It's overkill.

it's a fun game with good graphics. My only problem is it's fun in the beginning since you get enough coins to play but once you hit level 4, which isn't even that high, it's harder to progress without spending money. You basically get one play every hour and you have to sign in to collect the coins. It hits a dead end and I'm already losing interest in playing

it's a trap! don't buy a single coin! each level or scene is progressively harder and more expensive! so many ads thrown at you, I've had up to NINE panels of ads to go through just to get to the game screen! every hour you get free coins but just barely enough to play a single hand of solitaire! reward system is designed to keep you from winning anything unless you buy a coin package and they're just not worth it. once I get to level 9 and get my 75.00 gift card, I'll erase the game!

The game itself is fun and the animations when you unlock them are cute, the only reason i took a star away is because there are so many pop ups, about 8. They aren't ads, but they are for side events and almost all of them need real money to unlock, some of them will give you freebies. There will also sometimes be coupon popups. On the plus side, after the daily reset the mass amount of popup only happen once, then a small one after your first play of the day then done.

I really liked this game at first and was spending so much time and effort on it, was even willing to drop a few dollars, but after like scene 5, its just a cash grab. the ratio to coins earned to how much you have to spend per level is just not possible. I would rather have lives or atleast a better way to earn coins, or maybe the coin price to play each level to be lower. its a shame because it had so much potential. also some levels are just straight impossible, wasting so much coins.

this game does offer a lot of ways to make coins, but it doesn't really matter when you consistently lose rounds, just so they can get you to buy more coins. I've had one card left on the board and ran through 14 cards, just to lose. Disney games and to cheat a lot, especially when they're trying to get money out of you. I definitely wouldn't let a child play this game. The same, also, consistently hit you with ads to buy coins, especially when you lose, which is a lot. 2 star, lazy response.

The game was fun for a while, and I would making occasional purchases. But the further you progress, the more it feels like you have to buy coins to keep playing. In one day, I lost over 700,000 coins that's 70+ games. Using coins at the end of a round when only one or two cards remain often costs as much as two or three extra rounds. A win only earns about 10% more than the cost to play, losing just one round can wipe out the profit from many wins. It's designed to drain coins, not reward skill

Every level seems designed to purposely make you fail. Each time I get close to finishing a set, it never gives me the cards I need and it doesn't just happen once but at least 3 or 4 times - yes, I counted. All for the purpose of spending money on the game and I hate that. I should not have to play the same level five times to pass it for it to happen back to back or again two levels later. It's nothing more than a waste of time at the moment and stops being even remotely fun. Fix this somehow.

It's too bad, because the base game is fun, but the predatory monetization in a game clearly aimed at kids is vile and disgusting. Every time I open the app I have to tap through 4 or 5 pop-ups begging me to spend money, and the types of "deals" cycle nearly daily. Even as an adult it's frustrating at minimum to constantly have these pop-ups, and I have to wonder how much of the base game has its chances tweaked to incentivise me to buy more. EDIT: LOL! They replied with the link to support.

The game is fun and challenging, it seems to make it easier if you've been on a level too long so you can progress. My complaint is every single coin I've spent has been on accident. It makes it nearly impossible to collect coins to use. You're moving quickly trying to beat it, time runs out and the "buy more time" button appears out of nowhere and then bam all your coins are gone for 30 seconds that isn't going to help you anyway. Very Frustrating.

There was an ad promising $75 reward for playing a required amount of games. I followed the link provided, and ended up on this site. I played and played, and although I was supposedly winning, it seemed I was not making any progress towards the $75 reward. CS bot says I need to deal with company hosting the contest, but after clicking link and going to app, I'm unable to go back to page with ad for company and contest info. Thank God that I didn't buy anything on site! So, big ripoff! scam.

addicting game. I feel like the amount of coins you spend to play vs what you win is not fair. I know they do it to provoke you to buy coin packages. also the amount of promotions for in game items is out of control. its annoying to have to click through 7-10 different offers every time I open the game, I can see all the offers on the screen, there's no need to force them in my face.

I downloaded this app as an offer through another app, Freecash. Not talking down on it, but, it's not "solitaire". It's also not possible to beat some levels on the first try, so then you have to use a ton of coins for five more cards or for a wild card, while beating a level barely earns you enough to do another level. Clearly designed to trap you into buying more resources. However, the Disney stuff will probably appeal to kids. I just dislike predatory apps.

Since you're not playing with a full deck of cards, this game is not about luck, strategy or solving levels, it's just algorithm and money grabbing. The game knows what cards are on the table and what to send you to make you lose and spend money on extras. Once you stop playing into their abusive algorithm they "ease" your way into winning a few more levels until you restart the behavior of spending money on it again. 1.816 puzzle pieces to finish the album can cost up to 20$

the game itself would be fun if it wasn't so obvious that this is a cash grab. when I lose a level and don't have enough money to continue, I get hit with at least 4 pop ups of all the ways I can purchase more chances to play. insane that you can't even replay old levels. the game is created to only be completed if you pay. I only downloaded this game for the gift cards reward, and the game is so unplayable that it's immediately getting deleted

A Game that becomes pay to play. The core limit to gameplay is coins. You will run out of coins. Then, you can wait an hour for a small amount that is enough (maybe) for a 1x reattempt. Or, spend real money to buy coins. It would b better if the cost of wildcards were not so high, and if the free coins each hour scaled and did not wait for collection. Who wants to set an hour timer for a game? Who wants to try a level once an. hour then wait another to play again?

This game is garbage- Solitaire- This game has nothing to do with playing the fun game of solitaire, it has to do with them making money (in-app purchases) Disney- The Disney theme makes it fun, I guess, and unfortunately what will bait a lot of people especially minors in making purchases. Cons- You can't collect or accumulate lives, it's only waiting for the bonus every couple of hours that's allows you to use the coins to pay for a game. You can play a perfect round and still lose lol.

Unfortunately the game goes from extremely fun gameplay to putting you in situations where you pretty much need to spend money if you want to progress. I am convinced that you are given worse hands when you are close to completing an objective so that you are forced to make a purchase to continue. If not for this feature it would be an easy 5 stars. I understand monetization but this is predatory and scummy.

Excessive amounts of pop ups throughout the game, always trying to make you purchase something. I have to spend what feels like 5 minutes exiting out of a list of pop ups saying "40% off!" , "only $12.99!" when all I want to do is collect my hourly reward. Aside from that the game just isnt fun enough to justify the headache of running out of gold and being assaulted by dozens of offers. I only played to to be payed and will be deleting as soon as that is done.

This game is great until it's not anymore. In the end, it's a money grab. They let you win like a pro for the first several rounds and then there's a turning point. You will start to lose even tho you're still playing really well. The more you level up - they get you in the wallet. If you start paying to keep playing they will make you lose after every round or every other. Been playing for 90 days. Basically I will win one lose the next, mandatory wait 4 an hour to play again. unless I $$

its a super fun game. Just not fun when you. reach a level and it doesn't let you win no matter how hard you try. like other reviews im sure they want you to purchase in order to succeed. ive spent 4 days on the same level not moving up once... I get through the whole deck and on my last card on the board im still stuck. I refuse to purchase because that's not how these games should be. if you want to spend money that's fine but for the ones who dont, you shouldent be stuck not able to advance.

it's tolerable if you login here and there just to collect hourly coins and play on the lowest setting for least rewards. You'll still have limited game time due to running out of coins but can play a few levels most days. Between this setep and the amount of popup "please pay me" nonsense, it's definitely a too money driven. I'll happily watch reasonable adds to play a game for free, but they just make it hard to play if you don't pay. Game is fun otherwise

Garbage, they charge you coins to play each stage. At the end of each stage, you win less than what you were charged to play. They give you bonuses, but only after 4-5 stages, and charge you if you're missing the last card. That's not always beneficial because you usually don't get the card you need. Then you run out of coin, and the only way to play again is once an hour for your bonus coin, which at higher levels sometimes isn't enough coin for one stage. This results in you having to spend $.

-5⭐️ This game was listed on one of my "play to earn" apps so I figured I'd give it a try. The longer you play you can tell that some of the levels are not even possible to win without using your coins. Coins are needed to begin the level, add cards and play wild cards with little opportunity to earn the "free" options and each round you hardly win enough to even play the next round. I even bought a few of their offers only for the next few levels to seemingly deliberately waste all of my coins.

The game itself is fun, but it genuinely feels like the game is constantly discouraging you from playing it. Coins are a struggle to maintain and it gets to a point where you have to open the game every hour just to claim 2k coins, then close it until you have enough to actually play. I respect that there are no ads and appreciate it, but it really alienates those of us who just don't have two dollars to spend. Money's so tight and I just wanna play the fun card game and not think about it, man.

I really enjoy this game, but, the further you get(for instance I'm on level 17), it's way less enjoyable because you have to make many purchases just to keep going. the game is such that you are successful a few rounds, and then it gives you an impossible round(at least impossible to complete without a wild or extra cards). this becomes very obvious that it is happening purposely and that each round is not a random deck of cards.

I love this game but sadly I am going to have to quit playing as it has become way to expensive with many goals unachievable unless you spend more money and as you spend, the amount you need to buy points gets larger and larger each time, I feel like 44.99 is a lot to just get points to play. when I started, i did not know that the cost would increase over time.

Pros - Solitaire portion of the game is fun. Cons - there's a lot. - I keep turning off the music & it keeps turning back on. - Each round costs coins & you will earn slightly more coins than you spent to start the round. If you have to use extra draws, you will lose money that round. - On app open, you will have to close, on average, 7 pop-ups for coin offers or regarding the current mini games. - Too many mini games. As I write this I counted 7 mini games. - Hard to win without buying coins.

I really like the game, but it is definitely pay to play. They don't give you nearly enough coins. But my biggest issue with it is the freaking pop-ups. You have to log in every hour to collect free coins, but I counted this time - nine pop-ups before I even had an opportunity to do anything in the game. After I finished the first level, there were four additional pop-ups. There's just no reason for it. Let me open up the game and play.

I would like to give credit for the idea behind the magic, the carefully crafted graphics, and soundtrack. However, the game takes up battery, doesn't always run smoothly, and relies on in-game purchases to move forwards consistently. While I am determined to complete this game without spending money, I do not recommend doing so.

I actually really, really enjoy playing this game, but I have to give it 2 stars because of how long it takes to earn the in-game tokens/coins and how few of the rewards you get each round which help you advance. It's clearly a money grab to get you to make a LOT of in-app purchases to buy more coins or extra cards to advance. You barely make enough coins on a successful round to even buy into the next one! It's super frustrating and I'll likely delete the app bc of these issues.

I spent 3 hours playing this game and made it to level 87. After about level 50, the game is impossible to play without spending real money. I downloaded it for a cash back offer, you have to reach the 9th scene, I'm on scene 3 and there's no way possible to go further in the game without real money. Once I made a small purchase, the game immediately started making me lose levels and took all my coins. You have to pay coins to even play a round, stupid idea. Don't even bother playing this game.

A very fun, relaxing solitaire game featuring beloved Disney characters. the main issue that's held me up is not having enough coins and having to buy them. it costs way more (even on basic level) then what you win so you are constantly losing even when successful. plus if you want extra cards or wild cards, the cost is more than double the reward. 🤔

This game is fun, but unless you're going to keep paying actual money to play then I wouldn't recommend it! It costs way too much to play each level once you start getting into higher levels and the amount you win isn't much more then it costs to play the level, so if you can't beat it on the first try then your always losing money! and the extras cost just as much as it costs to play a board if not more sometimes! And it'll give you the same card over and over, so you purposely can't win!

I really enjoyed this game! It was so fun and rewarding! The only real downside was: that it took a few days (or more) to earn stars for one level... I was playing the game through a play-to-earn app, and since so many are scams, I rarely invest $$$ - so I had to keep collecting the free 2k before I could maybe advance, if I remembered to do so. Other than that, great game.

Be prepared to spend money in order to advance in this game, or set an alarm on your phone to log in every hour to collect 2000 coins that you can continue playing. I have been stuck in the Moana level for 3 days now. Because the only way that you can get through it is if you spend money on more coins which give you power free play cards. several of the levels that give you stars to advance are purposefully made so that you can't win without spending money on more coins.

Very "entertainingly challenging" but as you progress through the levels, scenes, and chapters, the coins go a lot faster, and it gets much more difficult to beat multiple levels in a row. Went from beating 5-8 levels in a row frequently early on, to now maybe 2-4 if I'm lucky. Other than that, it still is a great game, and it definitely will keep you hooked until you run out of coins and have to wait for the hourly/daily bonus unless you buy them ofc. For that reason, I rate it 4.5 stars not 5.

This game is by far the single most predatory game ever. The card distribution when buying more moves is consistently unfavorable, making it impossible to clear the deck If you have more then one card left, and most cards in the deck aren't relevant at all, potentially drawing 5+ cards with no use at all. And considering Disney is aimed at kids... On top of that. 5 Extra moves are more expensive than retrying the level. That is proof enough that they just want to rip you off

its fun.. until it became a total cash grab. the levels are expensive and so are the "draw five" or "wild card" options. it slowly increases with every "scene" as well. Each scene takes about 20-30+ games per scene which is absurd. Coins are expensive and go to waste almost instantly because of how expensive it is to play a single round. super disappointing.

I tried this app in conjunction with a pay to play app. It is horrible. Not fun and becomes more "expensive" to play as you advance. I hit level 6 and am out of coins unless I pay real hard earned cash. uh, NOPE! Bad animation style. Tink will pout at you pathetically everytime you choose not to pay more (about 4600) to get 5 more cards; twice the game play fee (2300)! Even if you do win in those 5 cards, you lose because the win is only about 200 above the game entry. Greedy & manipulative.

I want to give this game a better review so bad because I love the graphics and its super cute. You fly through it at the beginning but after a while, you run out of coins and the games get impossible to beat with coins unless you get really lucky. It feels so greedy after a while because its so obvious they want you to buy things to win after you get like 5 pop-ups in a row. I really hope this is fixed cause I'm losing interest..

Play a different solitaire game, it's pay to win or check back every hour without actually playing a level so you can stock up on coins. The gameplay itself is fine, but the constant pop ups trying to get you to spend money(which is the only way to actual beat some levels because they give you 0 ways to win without spending all your coins) make it annoying to get into the actual game.

Just like the rest.. I got this game thinking "Oh! Disney solitaire how fun!" the game hooks you in with so many wins, and when you get to a certain level... you're just stuck. Scam. You dont even earn enough coins to play a level like almost any other game out there. So so sad. I was really looking forward to this game. Now I just shake my head at the creators, and myself. So stupid.

Absolute scam and predatory monetization. The reward for beating a level is lower than the price to start the level (yes, you pay to try to best a level). and in 80% of levels, you always finish your stack of cards, with 1 card remaining on the table. which entices you to spend more money because "I almost won, just this 1 card is left". For every 1000 coins you earn from beating levels, you can expect to pay around 3000 coins. Once you're broke, you will start getting spammed with "pay money"

it's a solitaire grand harvest knock off. once you get about 100 levels in it doesn't matter how good you are it just goes by if you get the right set of cards so no skill just luck. not too mention it'll get to the point where you'll only be able to try a level once per hour if you don't spend money. and no it doesn't build up you have to log on every hour to claim the free gold which is exactly enough for 1 level try. not a good enough game to even think about spending money on

This game is unplayable in the high levels without spending money. Even then, the game is designed to force you to lose. I've spent money several times in hopes to win and it is absolutely rigged. All risk, no reward. I love that there is no ads, but thats it. Disney is capable of making a game that you get what you put into it -their matching games, even emoji blitz- Disney Solitaire is NOT one of those games.

This game plays at minimum 10 ads for in game purchases before EVERY SINGLE GAME. Also don't bother trying to figure out what cards could possibly be left as the game reuses cards whenever it needs to. That ensures that the game controls which levels you win and which you lose 100% of the time. So, in conclusion... more ad time than game play time in a controlled environment where your play determines absolutely nothing. Enjoy

The game is good in terms of graphic and game play. However, the cost of each round doesnt make sense. For example, I need to spend 5000 for a game, after I finish the game, I just can earn around 6000. it means I just only can get 1000. It is not attractive at all. When I use the 5 extra cards, it costs me around 9000, it is not guranteed that I can get the cards which I want. The cost becomes too high, which makes people quitting the game.

fun at first, however the ads have become obnoxious; you have to sift through 4-6 (sometimes more) just to get to the actual game and notifications have gotten out of control. at first it was every hour which is when next free round was available. now it's anywhere from 15, 30 &/or 60 minutes at which point you have to sift through all the ads to find out next free round is not yet available.

Gross - Can't Win if you Don't Pay They don't even give you lives. If you get stuck on a level you HAVE to log in every hour to collect coins. You get to collect the amount it takes for you to play 1 level. You don't get to ever collect more than that 1 level meaning you don't get any kind of lives in your down time. You can't watch ads to do anything. You literally have to pay to win. If I could give negative stars I would. It's wild how this has a high rating, I'm sure there's tomfoolery.

I am really, really enjoying Disney Solitaire. I have no complaints about the gameplay whatsoever, but devs....all the popups upon starting the app are insane!!?!!? I open the app and I have to close out 5 to 7 popups every time. Can we please get a setting option to disable this? I don't need to be reminded about events and special prices and whatnot. That's not why I downloaded the game.

Disney Solitaire is honestly a very fun and addictive game. The graphics are beautiful, the Disney themes are nostalgic, and there are several ways to earn extra coins while playing. The gameplay itself keeps you interested and wanting to continue to the next level. My biggest issue is how expensive everything becomes as you try to progress, and the amount of stars needed to complete 1 task is ridiculous, so it can become a money pit fast. so I get my several people are complaining 🙄

Fun game but it is a money pit. Sometimes it will give you a good chance to win a level and get prizes but to often it lets you get right to the edge of winning and then snatches the rug under you. The scaling is bad as the cost to play gets more expensive. I also feel like I don't get all my rewards when I purchase immediately it waits until I spend coins and then they magically appear. Also, when you have wild cards or bonus decks, the game really turns on the cheating.

I originally wrote about how scammy this game is. I do think the game developers are trying to make it more fun and worthwhile so I gave an extra star. There is so much more luck than skill; however, how you use your coins and play your streaks does have a bit of skill to it if you want to progress without spending. That said, spending gives much more access to daily events which makes it more fun. Overall, if I wasn't earning money by playing, this game probably would not be my go to solitaire.

This game is a waste of time and money. They charge too many coins to beat levels and you don't get that many for winning. It takes forever to get any coins from the side quests which a lot of them reset if you don't win the levels. The only way to win most of the levels is to keep buying stacks of cards which quickly adds up to an insane amount of coins to beat one level. This game could be fun if the made it so you don't have to spend a fortune to get anywhere.

PAY TO PLAY! I've spent hundreds of $$ on predatory offers to continue playing the game. Other reviews agree with this, only to get the same generic, repetitive response from DISNEY- "we're working on it". Level 1186 costs 18K coins. 5 extra cards is 30K coins. 120K additional coins later & I still didn't win. Side quests are nearly impossible unless you pay for extras. Only 2% of players complete albums. Facebook page offers 4K free coins here & there. They're "working" on it tho. Lol! LIES!!

I was looking for an alternative to Monopoly Go, that is now too greedy and expensive to enjoy that game at all. Don't bother downloading this trash. It literally takes longer for the app to open than for it to automatically crash and exit out. This game sets you up for failure. You get to play a bunch of levels at first but you slowly run out of gold. once you run out you can't play anymore unless you spend money or claim free gold every hour. The amount you get from free claims are minimal and there is no passive or automatic claiming. If you want to play this, you pretty much have to throw your money in the garbage, or insessently check back every hour just to not play a stupid predatory card game.

It's a decent game if you want to kill some time. The gameplay can be satisfying at times. There's also a multiplier you can turn on to increase earnings, but it further increases costs as well. It's not worth it because you're spending more to make the same progress, and the earnings never outweigh the costs.

Oh man this is NOT casual play. I downloaded this for a Fetch bonus, and it's not a casual, relaxed game. this gives you LITERALLY 10+ pop-ups trying to get you to spend money every time you open the game, and at least 5+ more when you run out of moves. Don't be fooled, this is free but they want you to spend money. being Disney it's geared towards children, but under no circumstances should you let your children play this game because they're going to spend money.

I'm changing my rating... in the past couple of weeks the game has been crashing in the middle of play - and sometimes before it even finishes Ioading. none of my other apps are doing this, so have to assume it's the game. I've tried restarting the phone and doing an uninstall/install on the app, but that hasn't helped either. I'm beyond frustrated.

I don't write reviews, but this game is so horrible that it warrented a review. I've never played a game that activly wants to keep you from playing it. Not only from the coin set up where you can't afford to play more than 1 round like others mentioned but also the too often to be coincidental way the deck is delt so there is no way for you to win. Don't waste your time.

This game is way too expensive. You cannot play without spending actual money. So many times you get to the end of a level and have to buy more cards 4 or 5 times to be able to finish. Each buy is 25k or more. meaning you spend over 100k to finish and you get back 16k but it cost 16k to play in the first place. Its beyond frustrating to have to keep dumping money in the game. You go through coins way too fast. It's nothing to loose 200k playing a level.

I am about to be so brutally honest! Firstly, The solitaire is fun, I guess. I like most of the reward systems. Gameplay. LIKE 8 OF THEM! SO ANNOYING! Nothing dampens my experience with a game like immediate popups!

it's basically gambling. nothing random about the deals, not real solitaire. straight up fixed 100% in an attempt to get your money. if you are doing well, it's not you, you aren't good at the game or smart. it's their algorithm throwing you a bone to key you interested. doing badly? algorithm thinks it's got you locked in and it's trying to get your money. I gave it two stars because it's cute but shame on Disney for putting their branding on this shameless fixed slot machine.

This game is great at first! But then comes the pay wall after a certain point. The difficulty of the random draw of cards almost feels like its against you to push you into spending real money on this game. If the insane pay wall was replaced with ads, it'd probably be better. You will start to notice when the greed of the developer takes over and you realize its incredibly hard to progress with spending real life currency.

Updated review 2. This game deserved a higher rating than I had given it due to the cost for gameplay. After further play with a strategic approach to cost. It's not as expensive as I previously thought. If strategic about how & when to play, one can make the free play credits go quite far. However, if you want to play continuously, then you will definitely have to spend a little money. It is a fun game & you will likely want to play it often. (Thank you for always reading through our feedback.)

very predatory system. you will be forced to pay eventually. the levels and items required to finish them cost more and more. faster than you make money for beating levels. a better title would be like, "inflation simulator". you get free coins every hour you log on, but they aggressive shove literally 5-10 ads begging you to pay in your face before you can click the button to claim them. just kills the playing motive

My main problem with this is the levels are not guaranteed Winnable, and they need to have that feature so you can complete a level if done right. the problem comes up when you have one car left, you get five more cards and still can't get it. this game sucks I just spent 4 minutes on the game and couldn't even collect the 2500 hourly coins cause of all the "special offer" pop ups. even when you collect 50k coins, that'll only let you play 5 minutes. unless you want to spend money on a super boring game with lots of pop ups, don't download. it also loads you up with Disney cookies so you'll start getting Disney ads all the time.

very rigged to encourage spending money, by far the worst ive come across for this. all of my albums had 1 more card left to gain the reward. In traditional Disney fashion it is designed to cost you money. it doesn't have the option to watch videos for free coins. You either wait an hour or buy coins. I play this game through tiktok and the get paid for it. but you can only withdraw when you reach the amount you chose. Total Cash Grab. You have to come back every hour to earn more tokens to play, it doesn't let them stack while you are away. Monopoly Go is way more fun than this game and isn't as money hungry

had to hit X on at least 12 things before I can play a round every time I open the app. more times than not I have to buy extra hands of cards because the cards given the last several are of no use and repeat. and sometimes even the extra cards bought are of no use. costs coins to play a hand. costs double the price of the hand to buy a few extra cards. pushes far too hard for you to spend actual money.

the game never works. and once you get into a good groove, the game shuts down and all progress is lost. game shouldn't be out on the market. not fair game play. maybe because the game has rewards available and Disney and other people don't want you or certain people to win so they hack the gameplay so you can't win. or the game is full of bugs and Disney knows and is cheating it's customers once again. you pick. how can I contact you through the game if it doesn't work. it won't stay on.

It was fun. However, I notice that it gets nearly impossible to have more than 5 plays after reaching more than level 95. this game is an absolute waste of time. once you reach the "Frozen" scene your progression pretty much becomes completely halted because they game gives you absolutely no resources to continue playing. you get about 2500 coins for passing a level, however to start a level you need 2200. and if you DONT beat that level you end up wasting the coins with not enough coins to start a new one. this gets worse when the game pretty much blocks you from winning by just giving you a horrible deck.

This game is super fun! There are a couple of downsides: #1 would be popups to make in app purchases take like a whole minute to go through. starts as a fun mahjong type game, quick becomes one of the biggest cash grab games I've ever seen. many levels leave you with rng making 80% of seeds unfinishable without buying upgrades. the currency in game gives you about 1 try at a level per hour, assuming you log in every hour on the hour to redeem. most of the time you need to redeem 4-7 to actually finish the level.

my experience in the beginning was great was able to complete levels and move up and grow in the game. currently sitting at level 286. my issue with game is once you get high in the game it stops setting you up to beat the level your on so you burn through your coins and then gives ad after ad after to purchase coins and other things and once your own money has been spent it sets you up again to make runs on levels. game is rigged to spend money not play and beat levels freely. consumerfraud imo

Fun little game but you run out of coins way too quickly and have to stop playing. I'd be happy to watch an ad to get more coins but that's not even an option. how it works is no different than bingo voyage. thats not a compliment. you can play for free daily for about 15 minutes or so before your coins run out. it's heavily focused on purchases. pay and drain game. nice music and relaxing for a few minutes at least. i dont have time to check in hourly to pick up the bonus coins, which frankly, just like bingo voyage are ridiculously unbalanced for how expensive game buy in is.

Game is super easy and fun however, the game eventually forces you to lose to the point you no longer have coins to just play. horrible, just a money grab. can't even play a few games on a row before being forced to spend money for coins. each game cost more and more coins just to play and lose more often. buying a coin pack does nothing because the cost to play is higher and higher the further you go. can't even enjoy to the game without coin packs being thrown at you every 5 seconds

like the Disney part that's it. after a certain point it costs more in currency than it does to play the level. The most recent update (May 7, 2026) has destroyed the game functionality on my device. Before that? this game starts off fun and very cute. until you get around scene 4-5 is when you start seeing the collectable coins you need to start levels and to buy re-draws start draining way faster than you are collecting them, thats when they start offering you a bunch of junk purchases that may let you play the game for another half hour if you fork over 6 bucks. Fun but as soon as you hit a certain level you pretty much have to spend money. Went through 30k in coins on the same spot and never won. absolute pay to win, playing it for a while I've noticed a tendency, on the beginning you have "luck" to win up to 5 lvl straight, then you suddenly get unlucky and to win you MUST buy more cards. fun game, annoying experience. the actual game play is so fun but the constant pop ups to try and make you pay for the game is relentless. takes me a full 2 minutes before I can even start playing the game between all the pop ups they start with when you open the app. and no they are not ads so its nice but its still way too much.

it would be a great game if it weren't rigged to make you lose/run out of coins. it is not actually solitaire because of this. it "randomly" generates cards and as soon as you start to do well, the game stops giving you the appropriate cards. it's overrun with ads. everything was going fine untill I got to leave 3 thats when I had to play the level over again not bad right I had problem between but LEVEL 9 it wouldn't let me when I had about 7 to 8 thousand coins left and I ran out of all of them the game is a waste of time i don't want to be rude Disney no no no fix the game atleast when you run out of coins but a thing were you can ethier watch a ad or do quest

"SCAM" Avoid this game at all costs. even if its part of a cash app prize for completing levels. it is the worst money grabbing game scam I've ever came across. okay I'm reediting my comment because this is now getting absolutely ridiculous. I had over 400k coins, made it to the end of the level, and it left me with 3 cards left.
