This game is rigged so you cant win once you get to a certain point. I literally had 1 card left in play to get rid of. I had 10 cards left (no gold) in my pile. I thought oh wow easy good win this hand. Nope! Its rigged so I still lose. Went through 10 cards and didnt get a single thing to get rid of my 1 card. About 4 of the 10 were Jacks! Unreal and frustrating. Not only that... Im sitting on like 6 albums with 1 card left in them and cant complete them. Such a scammy feeling game.

There has been multiple times I jave been granted coins and not actually given these coins or food from baskets and I get nothing in my pantry added. This typically happens when first logging in for the day and you're met with the many pop up prompts for everything. The games algorithm is definitely pay to win some of the stuff like the last puzzle or getting the last portion of any event. When I spent money and got a lot of coins everything drastically increased as well.

I really enjoy the game but I hate that you have to purchase coins if you actually want to play more than one round every hour. it's almost not even worth the time and effort. I don't know who has the time to check the game every hour to get your free coins but I certainly don't.

The game is good and of good quality, but it is very difficult to level up unless you pay, and you can only play once every hour, and even then the chance of leveling up is very low. Please make the game so that we can enjoy playing it, not so that it is stressful and expensive.

It's a fine enough time sink. But go in understanding every level of it is designed to extract cash from you. You don't NEED to pay money to advance. But my experience is the longer you play the more likely to get a spread to drain your coins down to zero. My advice is when you get to that point is to take a break. Build your coin base back up. After a bit it'll be more fair and you can advance.

got to level 69, ran out of coins, you have to pay to play, another con cash game don't bother, rip off. these pay you games are a con, same as testerup etc, unless you buy extras you soon run out of free play coins. you are encouraged to get friends to sign up to get more coins

it's literally unplayable past a certain point unless you pay. you get enough coins for one game every hour and they don't even collect you have to collect at that time or the same 2000 coins just sit there. you're lucky if the coins you do have give you a winning game.

Kinda fun, but way too over animated (lots of pop-up "hey look at this") and rigged like a carnival game. If you want to play for more than a few minutes at a time you will have to first log in every hour to collect coins and/or spend real money.

Game design takes too long to go between levels, with some rounds being designed to be impossible so you have to pay money. don't recommend unless if you want to wait between levels and pay money just to advance

Holy incessant microtransactions batman! what a money grub by Disney. You only get enough coins each hour to play attempt. you also get bombarded with a minimum of five different 'opportunities' to spend money. the free events are alright but to actually complete any of them you almost need to spend money

I am level 1497. I play this game DAILY. I have never spent real money on this game. It's addictive and challenging without bogging you down and getting stuck on any levels for days at a time like other games I've played. Would recommend it's always updating and has new things going on! ❤️

Highly not recommend this app to spend any money on or to earn the $75 gift card from Smart Wallet. Customer service is very slow in response time. Then the lady did not answer my app issues. She instead blamed the issue on Smart Wallet saying whatever agreement I have with them I need to contact them. Disney Solitaire is blocking me from proceeding past 5 of 8 in level 7 Toy Story scene and not reporting my progress I have made to Smart Wallet and I have spent plenty of $. Unethical!!

while the game is fun, they do push purchases on you. I can wait them out but I get so tired of fun games pushing purchases on me. I know why they need you to make purchases, I just don't like them being a condition to win in the side games.

I thought this game was super cute at first. The scenes were fun to put together, the game mechanics are straight forward, and it seemed like a nice way to spend some free time. However, now that I'm at scene 5, level 137, its clear to me the real point of this game (at least currently) is to make as much money as possible. Without spending any money on coin packs, I can go whole days without making any sort of progress. Its incredibly frustrating and has made the game not fun anymore

I really enjoyed this game and with the Movie Night challenge (where you had to go through 24 ads), you could gain a lot of coins and puzzle pieces, so I was able to play without working about having to pay. But recently that changed and somewhere after around 20 ads or so, to continue the challenge you had to pay! And even more recently, Movie Night went away entirely. It was a fun game, but I'm not longer satisfied with it.

Good solitaire game. I haven't spent any money and have still managed to have plenty of game play. It's cute building the different Disney scenes. My only complaint would be sometimes there's so many events running it takes a while to click through to the card game.

I have reached the point in the game where it is essentially pay to play. I pretty much am only allowed to win one level a day unless I watch ads. No matter how perfectly I play the levels, I am not allowed to pass them. It has become stale and boring. Fun for a while, but like all "free" games, you eventually need to pay to progress. Great while it lasted though.

They want to insist that purchases are entirely optional, but not in any real sense. This "game" uses high pressure tactics to make you buy packages. Opening the app triggers 4-6 ads for "deals" you have to click through before you can play. They run events that reset if you fail a level. Fail and try to quit, they guilt you with "progress will reset!" It takes hours to get the "free" coins to play one level. Fail, and it costs more to continue than to try again. Don't play.

Cost too much to play. I downloaded this game thru the "free cash" app. It is a cute and fun game. However, its hard to progress because it keeps requiring more and more money to progress. I guess it has to make up for not having ads some how. But I honestly, would rather watch ads to progress, than keep being asked to put more money into a game. Especially, when the return on your investment is weak. This is a money hungry game which is why it will never be my go to game.

After a while, it becomes almost impossible to progress without spending money. You have to pay coins for each level, and the only way to get more coins is either by paying or by opening the app every hour to collect a bonus, which is barely enough for one level. On top of that, completing a level almost always requires buying extra cards, and those cost as much as two levels. The game clearly exists for the sole purpose of pressuring users into spending money.

Deceiving...just another game you can't get ahead unless you spend actual money. This game starts out pretty easy, but as you progress you quickly find out that it takes a lot to level up, you have to lose a lot in order to win one game (only to earn 1 star if you're playing on the easy level), and finishing scenes takes too many stars. This game has proven to be quite disappointing, considering some levels you are set up to fail so many times before you can actually win the solitaire match.

I'm right on the borderline of liking and hating it. You have to login to collect coins once an hour and don't accumulate automatically. You're so often 1 card away from finishing and if you need to use a chat, it uses a massive amount of coins. Levels are so long and take so many stars to beat. The game is so hard to be successful at unless you buy coins and if you do, they're gone right away. They bombard you with their own in-game pop ups. Annoying.

Not Solitaire really. Also, it is extremely hard to win once you get in the upper levels unless you pay money for coins. I am up to almost level 500 and at a "bonus" level. It is not a bonus level at all to me when I have to constantly play levels to get coins and it costs too many coins to unlock one thing. Needs to be changed and made more affordable in my opinion!

This game is fun, however the further you get into the game you can't play more than a couple of levels if that because the cost becomes ridiculous. It costs thousands of "coins" just to play one level, and the further you go the more you get levels that take multiple times to beat since you can have a whole stack of cards and not get the one card you actually need. if you dont pay real money to get coins, you cant play really. This is the top issue in reviews, shocked this issue exists still

I had to come back and edit my review. I love the game, but as others have stated, the more you play, the more it costs you - you're given fewer cards to complete the level and fewer 'matches.' So you 'purchase' more cards and it can cost 50,000 to 100,000 coins to complete the level - you can have 350,000 coins and after 1 round, not enough coins to play another level and then the levels cost more to play! it's an awful cycle that I didn't want to believe until I couldn't ignore it!

It's a nice game, love the set up but this is Pay to Win. You cannot progress without spending money like crazy or waiting hours to fail on the same level for the fifth time. I had 25k coins and lost it all on not even two levels. You lose more coins than you make back and you can't get more coins without buying them. The events exist yes, but to get rewards on those you literally have to win the levels. It's a whole circle. Unfortunately I have to uninstall, it was fun at first but no thanks.

this is a pay to play game. no doubt about it. it is a scam. unless your willing to gradually, but surely spent $1000+ for the duration of playing it. go ahead. but in reality it isn't worth it. and to mention i experienced a bug in the game that froze my game upon opening the app. and support couldn't help me out with it and didn't compensate me for any in game coins that I was going to get during the in-game limited time contracts. I had to wait until contract expired to be able to play again.

Used to be good. It's pay to play now. You used to be able to progress with in-game currency, now the "prices" for the same things have more than doubled forcing you to spend real money. Also how well you do is determined by how much real money you spend. To get you to spend that real money, there's NINE pop ups trying to get you to buy before you even play. Graphics are good.

only exists to get you to spend money on it. the amount of in app credits needed to play a level quickly increases with very little made back if you beat the level. and that is a strong if. like all solitaire games, there is an amount of luck involved, so a bad hand would be expected, but the cost of the aides (extra cards and a wild card) also rapidly increases. you can wait ages to build up credits with the only way to get them without paying real money, then spend it all losing a single level

The game is okay. The rng is clearly rigged by the devs to frustrate you into paying. Downloaded from a 3rd party and once I get my points I'm out. Not bad for a single day play but I would not go past. And before the copy and paste response "thank you for the feedback" most of the reviews are in agreement that the game is rigged, so don't bother lying.

Very fun & strategic! Although I still think this game is fun however, I feel the point system to continue playing is far too steep. It would be better to ease up on your point system when we're playing. It costs way too many points to continue playing & you shouldn't have to pay with points for new games because the players may have run out or have run low on points. Your point system is way too expensive; it's obvious all the game wants is money; It begins to take the fun away from the game.

was actually enjoying the challenging puzzles, but I cannot stand when games punish you by not being able to play at all when you lose too many times. This game would probably be 5 stars of I could just retry as much as I want. but the gold system ruins it, and just makes me angry when I lose because I know I just dug another foot into being locked out of the game. I know it's meant to entice me to purchase more gold, but all it makes me wanna do is go find something else to do instead.

I used to love this game, but the prices have gotten out of control. It shouldn't cost $50+ to get items needed every time you want to level up. oh, and you can't get the items organically. You have to pay and pay A LOT. Thanks for ruining a great thing.

I just started playing a couple days ago. It's a decent game it would be better if the characters talked or sung when you unlock more in their levels. I think my only big issue! Is the coin rewards!! After you start getting higher in the level it costs more coins to play and not everyone has that kind of money to spend a fortune to get more. there needs to be a free way to get more coins it's not fair for people who can't afford to buy packs to get more and then they're stuck and can't play!!

I have tried to enjoy this game. While the game is technically "free to play", it is designed for players that pay to play. Most rounds you cannot win without using helps, which use up your accrued game currency quickly. The game has a lot of events/promotions that you accrue tokens for through game play. Most of these events you have to pay to play or pay after the first level or two. If you have a ton of patience, you can play for free, but be prepared for constant pushes to spend money.

Game was enjoyable until now to move forward at any pace, it costs money. At least before I could choose to watch many ads to get puzzle pieces, etc. Now you can only watch so many before you need to pay. can no longer complete puzzles let alone levels without burning through previous winnings. And now as 2/18 the game does not load on my phone. Tried resetting my phone twice and the start screen just spins. So even if I wanted to play for awhile more until my money is gone, I am stuck.

The game is fun, but I wish they'd switch to a life basis or something cause the coin balance is terrible.The increasing cost just makes it more difficult to get the coins you need and it seems to limit the times you can win. The helps in the game are so ridiculously expensive that they're not actually able to be used, and the events can never be won without paying something. that being said, the animation and design of the game is good. however there are some improvements I would like to see.

this game is pretty fun and when the "movie night" bonuses were handed out for watching ads, it made this game more enjoyable. If I choose, I can watch an ad, get a bonus (coins, puzzle cards, or whatever) and I can end up playing longer. however, can't do that anymore.... you get up to "movie bonus" #70 and you can't continue unless you pay. like come on.... we chose to watch these damn ads, don't charge us for us to continue with the bonus. you charge for everything else, leave this alone

I've been playing this game for a few months now & it has so many pop up ads to purchase is so annoying. Also it's almost near impossible to play for more than 15 minutes. You use to be able to chose to watch ads to earn more coins but not anymore. You only get basically 1 play every hour and it doesn't accumulate....so you have to go into the app every hour to collect. Not worth playing anymore. I did enjoy it while it lasted.

I read the reviews as I was downloading and thought "it can't be that bad" but it is!! It was a fun game through the first 20 levels... now its just ridiculous in how it sucks your coins. Unless you're prepared to spend big cash to play, don't bother. I've never seen a game where you pay 2000 coins to play each level, only receive 2300 on completing the level, but need to spend 5000 to get through the level. I'm sure you can do the maths... Very disappointing

I do enjoy this game. I have fun playing and sometimes my 3 1/2 year old likes to play with me which is a great way for her to learn to recognize numbers. However, they really try to force you into spending money. In my opinion, the coin rewards should be quite a bit higher for completing a level, and the cost to continue a level with a wild card or additional 5 cards should be lower.

the game itself is great but they don't inform you that you only get limited replays and wild cards and that it costs coins to use. then you get into the real gameplay with no coins unless you buy. which is fine I support game creators but there needs to be a bit of extra coin earnings mini games etc just to keep interest. ty.

I truly enjoy this game. It is my go to at nights when I need to calm down. However, the more levels you pass abd the more packets you purchase, the more it cost to play each level. Also after purchasing, I began to lose more than I won. I won't delete it because I enjoy playing but I have found new games to play that is more user friendly and give more perk points per game.

I wanted to love this game and for the first 40 levels or so I did. But much like many other reviews the game grew stagnant forcing me to pay to play. the levels become unbeatable. I let my coins stack up multiple times with the same outcome. Remove the barriers and make the game truly free to play and I will update my review because the concept is adorable!

A really cute money grab! Like all free to play Disney games, this is really cute and a lot of fun... until the money grab algorithm sets in. I've completed 450 levels over the past month and have a very strong feel for how the game works. In the past (on other F2P games, including Disney), I've always earned the top event rewards by playing both well and often, but not this game. Nothing random about loss frequency at all, and top tier rewards are basically impossible to earn w/o paying $$

It's almost great! Visually it's amazing, gameplay is fun, no intrusive ads. The only downside is the inability to continue playing. The hourly coins you receive just doesn't work. You can log in to play a level but you can't complete it as you don't have spare coins for extra cards. I would suggest making this a 12 hour gradually increasing amount. this lets people log in 2 or 3 times a day to get a chunk of money to play with rather than opening the app every hour just to not play.

This is a fun game do get me wrong but there is flaws in my eye. 1) You spend more money to play and win a round then you earn for winning one. 2) The ONLY 1 star that you earn for each round doesnt get you far after scene 3, im on scene 5 and have had to play almost 70 rounds just to complete the scene but to add one thing to the scene you need 6-10 star 9 times, that's a lot of levels, which is why im on level 151. 3) there are several ads trying to get you to buy coins that will just pop up.

Loved the game until they removed the ability to watch ads to get some more coins and power ups. Now they just constantly push buying packages, which I won't be doing, and have made the levels harder without spending money for more coins for the powerups that are needed to progress to the next level half the time. At least you were getting revenue from me when I was watching ads, as compared to the packages I refuse to buy. I will change my review if you add the optional ads back in. Thank you.

I'm not sure why this game is as highly rated as it is. Sure, it's enjoyable, but INCREDIBLY greedy, which is saying something considering the number of gacha games I play. The amount of popups to try and get you to spend money is ridiculous and near constant. Plus, you can only get enough coins to attempt a level once every hour, and if you don't collect those coins, you're out of luck because subsequent hours won't stack. Game kept pestering me for a rating, so here it is.

This is a sad, sad excuse for a "game." I think the game is extremely predatory in its monetization, especially for a Disney game. Playing for free is extremely inconvenient, and the game is aggressive in pushing micro-transactions. You can play for free once an hour, which sounds like a lot but you only get those coins if you log in that hour. Opening the game once an hour to play the game every 5th time I opened it is NOT a game. Events rotate too fast for F2P

Pretty fun game, until it isn't. Played until level 6, when it became impossible to proceed without payment. I guess you could log on at every hour of the day battling 4+ popup ads begging for money each time. That way you can save up to play two or three games daily. Though, you'll probably lose them all, because you definitely can't afford help cards after a few levels if you want to be able to afford to play the game itself.

This was a fun game for a while! But as you keep moving up, it feels rigged so you can't win without spending money. The amount of coins used to play a round is ridiculous, even at the lowest level. You can't even redeem your earned rewards without spending money! And the ads we've seen here are atrocious! My kids were playing this and had to stop due to highly inappropriate ads. So disappointing.

SHOULD BE CALLED DISNEY VILLIANS ! Terrible game. At first I loved it but now I'm at level 315 and can't even play the game. Today I was up at 6 am and clicked on to get my daily bonus and check in coins which totaled barely nothing. i checked in almost every hour. Tonight could only play one game. Just 1. It takes 10,000 coins to play one game and the pay offs don't pay enough to continue play. You lose and you're done. RIP OFF! Impossible to win or get ahead. NOT WORTH IT.

This game is rigged. They make it seem like it just a cute card game with your favorite characters. But its actually a gambiling game designed with levels you cant get passed unless you use gold coins at high cost. Making you have to pay money to actually make any real progress. As an example, I just played a level where I had one card left and 6 cards left in the deck. And all 6 of the cards where the same. Its actually really disappointing Disney would steep so low. Would not recommend it.

it's fun, but why is everything so expensive? it costs so many coins to play a level, and then if you don't get lucky with the cards you could end up nearly depleting all of your coins in a single game. it's not an f2p friendly game, and I wish the game was more lenient on that. the mini events in the game are impossible to complete unless you have the money to spend on bundles or the time to spend grinding carefully for these items. it's fine for casual gaming, but costs too much money to play

Downloaded this game through another app to earn points by completing tasks. Not worth it. It takes forever to reach the next level. You barely earn more than it costs in coins to play one round. The cost to get additional cards or a wild card is outrageous. Unless you are willing to spend a ton of actual money to keep playing, you can only play one or two rounds before you are out of coins. And there are plenty of pop-ups trying to persuade you to spend, spend, spend.

I would give this 5 stars if there wasn't a giant pay wall so early in the game. The free coins every hour is a smart idea but for other tasks like win streaks, it's almost impossible to achieve those without spending money for coins to use powerups. So then you have to wait to play at all because each round costs coins. Everything else about the game is great.

This game becomes impossible to play without spending money. If you download this as game play for cash rewards, you will never, ever get the rewards. I downloaded this for free cash and have received .02¢ at 100 screens cleared. I am at level 3 and level 6 is the first $6-7 payout. Do not think for a minute that you will get to the end $400 payout. That will never happen. Otherwise if it's a game you are downloading for slow progress and free play that takes a long time, then I would rate it 4*

I'm definitely keeping my kid away from this game. This is not a solitaire. The more you progress thru the levels, you'll find unsolvable decks more frequently. even if you play your perfect moves on your deck, you will still fail. This game is intentionally designed to drain ingame currency as you progress, eventually get stuck unless you spend cash.

overall I enjoy this game even though the amount of coins it costs to play the later levels is crazy. what's frustrating is that the cost per hand goes up but the rewards for the more expensive scenes does not also increase which is annoying. also by the time I hit level 2750, I stopped getting daily rewards and most of the other collecting things to earn other rewards just disappeared. half of the time I don't actually get the album or the cooking one, so it's impossible to complete those.

this game is cute and while fun, it very quickly becomes literally impossible to progress without spending real money very quickly. I had credit on my play account, so I've spent nearly $20 on this game, and I'm still completely blocked to making any more progress. The amount of coins you need is insane to complete levels. Just overall a complete cash grab and waste of money. which sucks cuz it is really cute, but absolutely a waste of your time and money.

They made it so you have to PAY TO WATCH ADS. You'll watch a bunch of ads to earn coins and whatnot and suddenly it will cost $1.99 to continue or else you'll lose your progress and not get to collect the prize you were working towards. The only way the game was playable was to watch ads to earn stuff. Now it's pointless unless you plan on spending money. Their reply asking me to email for support is bizarre, almost as if they didn't even read my review. This is not a bug, it's intentional.

Ever since I spent money on this app one time, I've noticed it's set I will fail, the cards don't align forcing me to have to pay to play unless i sit there waiting to build coins off rewards. I feel like it's set that once you spend money, it'll encourage you to spend more. I'm only disappointed I spent in the first place because immediately noticed the pattern change. I'm too financially strained to spend money on games like it's gambling, it'll never come back to me. Was 5 star review 😭

This game is very nostalgic and obsessive. I'm constantly playing all throughout the day. The only drawback that I have noticed is how swiftly your coins are gone. Due mainly to the cost to do simple tasks like: Restart a stack, and even going back a few cards will cost you greatly. This has to be my least favorite quality of the game. Very disappointing.

a random chance game, that will waste your money and tokens. if you get into the game, and run out of cards. it asks you to spend the in game currency to buy more cards to continue the game. but, there is a heavy chance the cards you buy wont even be what you need to finish the level. and you can burn through your entire in game currency in one round. then be expected to use real money or lose the level. its a pay to play, that doesnt matter how good you are, will eat your cash.

Game play cost vs rewards are very minimal and let's face it, they control which cards you get and if you need to play over or pay for additional cards so... I don't feel it's feasible to play this often or long term unless you want to spend real money. It's obvious throw main goal is to bombard you with ads to make money much more than making enjoyable game play.

Fun game with good graphics. At the beginning, rewards are just and you could feel that the game is helping you level up, hence enjoying more because you feel like you're winning. As you progress, you're suddenly faced with a losing streak, most of the time even with a pile of cards left at your last turn. This restriction gets a bit frustrating, instead of making you feel like you want to continue playing.

it's a fun game for sure but they have made it to where you absolutely can't advance on the higher levels unless you spend a lot of money. I'm on scene 6, level 177 and it costs soo much to buy the +5 cards or wild cards and its next to impossible to win without them. I broke down and paid 7.99 for a deal and wound up getting through a few levels but it just wasnt worth it considering I still need 26 stars to finish off the scene and I cant imagine how much it will increase in the next scene.

The art and animations are okay, the gameplay is annoying, and the RNG forces you to use coins to beat levels often. Coins are very expensive and the game is constantly throwing up pop ups asking you to buy more. The events are almost impossible to beat in the time limits, and almost always locked behind a pay wall. Don't play this game unless you're getting paid to do so.

I started this game through one of the play to earn money apps, so I'll start off with how I should have seen this coming. The game is not solitaire, its using random cards and hoping you stay the whole time as the coins to play each level get higher and higher in cost. You pay 2.2k for a level but when you beat it finally after five attempts (the rng is truly terrible) its fine! because you get 2.4k for beating the level! Just enough to bash your head in one last time before the hourly coins!

This game is pay to play which is pretty frustrating because it would be a decent app if it wasn't. The coins you get in game are minimal & aren't just used to pay for additional cards to help pass a level, but are also required per game & the price goes up over time. I much prefer apps that go on a 5 lives basis. That way you have so many chances to pass levels but can still pay for coins to buy additional lives or the helping cards while continuing to play. Make your money but keep people..

It's ridiculous how predatory this game is. The balance of coins that you earn, compared to how much you spend on each level forces you to wait days between play just to save up login coins, or spend tons of real-world money to continue. Then there are at least ten pop-ups every time you open the app, trying to get you to spend more money on the app. Don't risk this on your kids, or on yourself if you have issues with impulse control.

The cost to play a level, assuming you need to buy more cards to actually finish (which very often you will) is way more than what you receive in rewards for winning, so you either pay way too much real cash for gold, or you get to finish a round a couple of times a day. Blatant cash grab. Gameplay is decent, but without the Disney branding it's nothing all that compelling.

Yet another game where you have to pay in game currency to play every level, they rarely give you enough cards to finish the level so you have to pay MORE game currency for more cards, your winnings are often less than you paid to finish the level (thanks to all the extra cards). Pretty tedious really, and it's not even really Solitaire. Add in each scene costing more to play and taking more games to finish... no. The Disney face doesn't make it worth it. Money grab from big company basically

it's a fun game. but it takes forever to get coins and stars. each level gets one. and scenes cost more to unlock. takes forever. it's a cool game, just not fun to play for long periods of time because of that. it pushes you to spend money constantly and power ups cost way too much. it's a game of chance, not skill.

this game is made to make you want to spend real money. I've read the other one star reviews and the response from the developer is the same on every one. "coin spending is essential to enjoying the game. we are working to better the experience." here's what you can work on. Make the game so that coin spending ISN'T essential to the game play. Then again, I could just uninstall the game and stop playing it.

Fun at the start. I played almost 3 hours straight and the levels felt fair. But by the third scene (Moana) it becomes a pay-to-play trap. The cost per level gets so high you can only play again after waiting an hour or two for the gift timer. The card draws suddenly stop helping and levels feel impossible unless you pay. Fun early, but it quickly turns into a money grab.

downloaded for $75, never got the money after passing all scenes required. Samething happened to 4 of my friends as we installed around the same day. we all lost over 300 plus hours each playing this game. I even emailed the company that was supposed to pay us$75, they never responded to any of us for our $75. In the app, they also wont let you rate it less than 5 stars. They want you to rate it 5, if you dont, they wont let you leave your review. We all lost a combined 1500 hours & got nothing

Fun game, but they definitely rig it so you constantly lose once you get far enough. The cost to play levels slowly goes up (which makes sense), but the daily rewards slowly get worse and worse and the game definitely sets you up to lose after awhile so you'll buy more coins through in app purchases. It kinda sucks cause it's a fun game, but I've been stuck on the same level all day despite hopping on religiously every hour to claim my coins for my freeplay. They don't want me to win without $$

One of the purchase in the app hides part of another purchase you should make in addition to the one you're purchasing, and reveals it after you buy. Very disappointing to have only half of what I thought I would get. It didn't show I had to make 2 other purchases to have my full final coins. Otherwise game is fun but I'm uninstalling. EDIT : You hid the other purchase, so now i should purchase an additional amount to get the rest 20k and 12k coins I thought I would get with my one purchase.

The game is fun and it's a great time killer. The only downside is the ratio of coins to play versus the rewards you get. Too many duplicate cards make completing the packs almost impossible. The biggest frustration for me is how many times you have to get additional cards or buy wildcards to complete that game. 2 or 3 are acceptable but 5 or more is a bit much. Increasing the awards to at least cover the "cost" of that level would be good.

I think it's a rather regular game. Nothing too special or too bad about it. The reason I gave a 3 star is because, in the game, you have coins. Those coins are used to play each level, to get extra cards, etc, etc. Pretty much everything is tied to the coins. But when you run out of coins, you either have to wait for a reward after hours or buy more coins to play. I dont really like that. That's different from other games where you have hearts or lives, this game uses the coins for everything.

this game is extremely rigged. I've never seen a game so badly rigged. it knows what cards you need and doesn't give them to you so you are forced to buy coins to play more rounds, purchase wild cards, etc. if you don't purchase you have to wait days to get enough coins to progress. there are 20 rounds per level. the first two levels no problem. but after that you have to pay to win.

most frustrating game i have ever played. First of all you can never play since the free money that s given is so low so you can t try to win levels, so you have to put money on it. Then, when you finally reached enough to try levels, the game gives you bad cards on purpose like you try 10 times the same level and you still don t win. Worst experience ever.

Read the 1 - 3 star reviews. The same complaints get the same reply, "we're working on improving player experience..." Seems like that is just an empty promise since it's been quite some time from the first complaints. I'm only 40 levels in, and the game economics are starting to push towards pay to play. I don't mind a game that has a pay exchange, but this one is extremely stingy, and after I run out of coins, I'll be deleting it and moving on to a new game. This review is my opinion.

When you get pass a certain level. It becomes impossible! They don't give you the cards you need. You buy extras until you run out. Especially if your close to the final reward on the side games. You have to spend real money to advance, and then you it's not enough. Glitch when I got my final ingredient, and haven't received it yet. The price to play on levels above 1,000 Is soo much. It cheats so you have to spend more real money to go any further. Other then that I love it.

The game unfortunately becomes difficult quickly and you'll end up losing coins fast. The pop-ups to spend money to buy coins is invasive and highlights how money focused the game is. It's frustrating to lose coins and having to wait an hour for your bonus or be pressured to spend money to buy more. I did buy the 4.99 option and still ended up losing majority of it quickly

I won't necessarily call this app a cash grab, per se. You can play the game without spending any money whatsoever and even have fun. However, you will not complete any of the events without spending money. And there are a LOT! They let you know about every single one, too, before you can even play. I think the other day I had to click out of 11 event notifications before I could actually play. And because if all those events, the home screen is a cluttered mess. Why not have an event tab?

Game is fine though feels rigged to let you have hot streaks and cold streaks. I don't love how you have to spend coins to play a level and then hardly win more than the cost of the level after beating it. It's intentionally geared toward making players grind to be able to play. Also way too many monetized systems in the game. Today I had to skip through 5-6 screens of different offers and in-game events before I got to the main screen. They asked me to spend $17 between 3 screens. Ridiculous.

I want to absolutely love this game but it's so aggressive. you open the app and before you can ever play you 6-7 game ads that pop up to try and get you to buy something. The animations are cute but in true Disney fashion it hooks you with cuteness and then tries to drain your pocket. If I'm lucky I can play 1 round a day because it's so expensive to play each round without spending money. Most puzzles take 3-4 times to finish because you'll get like 4-5 cards that are useless every 3-4 matches

Horrible experience. The only way to progress past scene five is by shelling money into the game. Levels aren't guaranteed to be completable without power ups so you can get stuck for days without any real chance to progress. I've been stuck for a week now and all I get is ad after ad about how I can spend $12 to get more gold to continue and a bunch of power ups. Don't waste your time and get invested.

There are so many pop-ups that come up between levels, you can't play the darn game! If I weren't earning points for another app by playing the stupid thing, I would uninstall it. It also tries to push you to spend money by making the later levels deplete your gold so quickly, it's not even enjoyable past a certain point because it is so clearly a money grab. Pathetic!

Costs vs Play, SUCKS! I have been trying to achieve the cards to get 800000 points. at 4 days it just stopped giving me cards. I've spent around $70 and just doesn't seem worth it to me. and that was in 2 week period. Just trying to get those cards. I feel like whatever you need to get the cards it just won't do it... Doesn't want you to win the 800000 points! In 18 hours I will delete if I don't get them. trying to decide how competitive I am right now...

Hooked from the first moment. You just can't put the game down and with side missions to do as well as play solitaire you have to keep going just to unlock the different stages. A great fun game for everyone of all ages!!!

This is the most predatory game I have ever played. Levels are not inherently winnable, requirements for the round prior to winning a final prize is astronomical and not realisticly obtainable, bonus scenes are added for the sole purpose of slowing your progress and there is no way of knowing what is required to advance at the start of the scene, you just have to play through it and find out. Expect minimal winnings if playing for a cash app!

Such a money grab featuring disney characters and nothing special. It is absurd and extremely off putting to have unstackable low hourly bonus that clearly people have to pay to buy coins to play more than one game in an hour if you are unlucky. Would definitely give less than one star if I could

there's no way to play this game when using cards cost 7k coins and you only get about 2k in bonuses an hour. the only way to play after a certain point is to pay and it's a tricky game that doesn't play but normal solitaire standards..

This game is fun, the artists did an amazing job thematically, but there is so much gambling!!! I couldn't recommend this for kids, because of the amount of ads to buy in game currency. It's a shame, because it is really well made. I notice the closer I get to finishing a segment the worse the odds are of winning without paying for extra plays. I love the puzzle sets and trading card collectibles, but it is impossible to get a complete set without spending money.

The gameplay itself is decent. The scenes are stiff and uninteractible. Made it to level 50 or so. I don't like that you have to pay with in-game currency to play levels. If you didn't already have to pay for any other action that wasn't making a match, it would be fine. Like, either pay to play, and have a scoreboard at the end (deductions for extra actions/time) or pay for the extra actions so you really have to rely on skill and a good draw. Otherwise, not half-bad from Disney.

To be honest, I initially downloaded & intended to play for 5 minutes, for the 20 play point reward, but ended up playing for an hour, or so. Nothing groundbreaking, but a fairly decent stress free way to pass the time. Being Disney themed, it was always going to be kid centric, but I was expecting something a little more intuitive for adults. Fantasia like, you could even say. Not a big deal. That's just a matter of personal preference. My actual rating would be a solid 2.5/4.0

I really enjoyed this game when I first starting playing it, I even got my husband hooked. Now it's become frustrating because how quickly you lose coins and there is no great way to earn them back without spending money. They need to reduce the about of coins it costs to play and have other ways, like watching ads, to earn more. Also The puzzles are almost impossible to complete without spending money to buy pieces.

I went into this with positivity, and I am very disappointed. Over time, the game seems to force you to spend more coins in order to win levels, which means you spend more than you earn, which, in turn, eventually leaves you without enough coins to play another level. Both a friend of mine and I found this extremely annoying. If there was a way to keep your coins, or to get coins w/o paying, I would give it a much better rating, as it is a fun game, but, in the long run, I DO NOT recommend >:[

Would be a perfect game if it didn't try to cheat you. The solitaire itself is fun when the game doesn't spam the same cards in a row. The Disney movie scenes are a joy to watch take shape, and the other gimmicks like puzzles and card collecting is fun too. I get the developers have to make money somehow, but cheating during the to so is bad business.

Game itself is fun once you close out the constant "offers" that pop up, like 6-8 different offers each time have to be x'd out before you get to actually play. And like others have said, it's very hard to move forward unless you're paying for coins because it's 10k coins for each hand of solitaire. I liked it, but I'm deleting because I'm sick of the constant "offers" to spend real money.

This game is exceptionally well-made with stunning graphics and nostalgic charm. The animations are fluid and truly capture the Disney magic. However, the balance shifts quickly. Once you reach a certain level, you constantly run out of currency. The difficulty spikes so much that you’re practically forced to spend real money on power-ups just to progress. It’s a nice experience, but the aggressive "pay-to-win" wall at higher levels makes it hard to keep playing.

This game is very fun and engaging but the cost to play is way too high and players aren't given enough coins causing a large stagnation of progression, on top of that the requirements for completing some scenes can be extremely daunting and make it feel like you're not progressing at all. The game feels like it's intentionally designed to back you into a corner to where your options are to repeatedly not play it for an hour or spend money.

I have played this 1447 times.level 6. Recently I find it very frustrating that 1. every time I get close to an achievement, it ends. Especially the album stickers. I get to 98% complete,5 days left, 3 more to complete, then it's gone! I have made purchases that include stickers but never get ones I need. 2. A couple times I got "free play" tickets. It was time to take a break from playing so did. When I went back the free tickets were gone. 3. now I am timed out of this review.

This game is garbage. They make it impossible to complete scenes. You lose more coins than you can win, they try to trick you into spending all of your money, and your balance isn't what you can cash out. I don't even know if you can cash out because you have to wait until you get $25 to do. I dont recommend this to NOBODY. Been playing for 2 weeks and have not made $20 yet. Deleting now!!!!!!

A nice game. It's easy and simple to play. A beautiful interface. However, it has about 10 pop up ads for in-game sales & events every time you open the app, as well as every few levels. And, unless you're willing to pay to play (which is totally fine & how the developers can afford to make the game) you have to spent an inordinate amount of money to succeed in both the levels & events. In a lot of ways, it feels like gambling.

I initially gave this game 4 stars because the mechanics, art and everything are great. You start out accumulating more coins than losing them. At some point, pretty early on, that changes and you'll lose coins easily. This should be a completely free-to-play game with micro transactions just for aesthetic things- not to actually keep playing the game. I'm super bummed because I wanted to like it.

Just like any other mobile game, it's fun for about 50 levels, but at a certain point, the game forces losses onto you. For me, more than 70% of the time, the boards become actually impossible to solve without using power ups. And you guessed it, you'll run out of coins for them in 10 minutes, and be forced to buy more if you want to keep playing There's literally no skill involved for me anymore, I can sit with one card left of the board and go though my 8 cards remaining and lose. Stay away

I started 2 days ago, totally addicted for some reason. spent probably $15 yesterday because I had the time. it costs game coins to play a game, and depending on if you want multipliers and I depleted everything yesterday, now when I sign in, with the hourly bonus, I can only play one game. fun while it lasted, I guess. but it's just tri peaks higher/lower. my interest was going to wain quickly anyway

The game can be fun, and yes, spending real money does help progress you in the game, however I find that this game almost forces you to spend money to complete challenges, also if you stockpile your coins in the game, the game will purposely inflate the amount you need to complete daily objectives. The game very rarely gives you the chance to get ahead without spending real money.

Don't get this game. It's expensive and has nothing to do with solitaire. It's just a money grab from the creators. It's rigged so you are forced to spend more than you make. It's roughly 10$ every 3 to 4 games after level 100 and they make sure you run out of coins very, very fast. there's really nothing fun about it other than waiting for your coins to run out and if you should purchase more. Save yourself some time and skip this one.

I actually really love this game. But here lately, when I login, it's not giving my rewards for the day. The daily challenge things are not loading. I can't get my puzzles or nothing. Really wish this issue would fix because it's frustrating playing without those goals. I've spent a significant amount and should be able to play this without these issues. I've updated the app and still have this issue.

I have played this game for years and loved it but I really enjoyed a recent feature where you could watch ads to get additional coins and other items instead of having to pay real money for it. In a recent update they have gotten rid of that feature and I'm DEVASTATED 💔 Can't play as much anymore cos I only get one game per hour so I've installed other games and moving on. always a money grab for these Disney games.

The concept is fun and the game is pretty but it all gets lost in, what I'd call, poor game design. This game obviously falls into the typical mobile game trap where everything has constant pop ups of "deals of high value" where you pay with real money to gain an advantage. Besides that, the level design is horrendous and heaviky RNG based. Some levels may be impossible because of the RNG which is incredibly frustrating. The progress also slows down by ALOT the further you get.

I've decided to change my rating as I became deeper in the game. I truly enjoyed this game! The Disney-themed solitaire is incredibly engaging and well-designed. However, I’ve encountered a major issue where the game continuously drains Play points at higher levels and eventually locks you out of playing altogether. I hope the developers can balance the economy so long-term play stays rewarding.

It's a cute, fun game. They give you some coins for daily logins and enough every hour for 1 game. It's fun when you can actually play, but very challenging to win and earn enough coins to be able to play for very long. Lots of pop up opportunities to spend $, but no outside ads. As much as we all hate ads, it would be nice if there were optional ones or some other way of earning extra coins. Would love to play more than a game every hour without having to purchase coins every day to do it.

I really really love this game, but they make it harder and harder to win and you can't play longer than a short time unless you pay, and once you pay I swear you loose way more like forcing your hand and even when you pay cash sometimes you can only play a few levels, it costs over 40k coins to play one 3 star game, at the level im on. If you could actually play without the constant need to pay,I would gladly give this game 5 starts.

The more coins you have, the higher the costs to play. This game is so much fun, even I bought some coins and I've never done that. Unfortunately, the game has dynamic pricing so it adjusts based upon how many coins you have in an effort to make you want to buy more. I realized this and confirmed by googling so I only bought 70k coins one time. I haven't bought more and the game is still playable, albeit I can only afford a few games a day. Collecting hourly coins is annoying so I don't do that

Clever use of game mechanics to get you, the player, to spend real dollars. The house always wins. Be suspicious that there aren't ads. I figured out how the game works. The first 50 levels are easy and fun. After that, the more rounds you play in 1 day, the less lucky you are. Why? Because it forces you to spend excessive amounts of coins to retry rounds, it plays on your monkey brain to make more in-game purchases. Only play 5 rounds PER DAY.

the concept is great. and it can be fun. the problem is it basically becomes pay to play after a bit, so you can't just play the game without waiting a long time to build up coins or pay to get stuff to let you complete levels. I made it through about 359 levels before I finally decided I had enough of this. I am not paying for coins in order to play levels.

No way this got such a high rating. This game sucks. You play maybe three or four rounds before you run out of coins to play another round. then you spend the rest of the day opening the app to just collect coins every hour to be able to play 3 or 4 rounds tomorrow. Plus, after the first few completed scenes it takes like 12 or more stars (meaning 12 games) to complete one part of a multipart scene. if it wasn't a rewarded play game I would have Uninstalled this real quick. PASS ON THIS ONE.

Money hungry app. it's just another game that starts off easy but then becomes difficult enough to try and convince you to spend real money so you can progress higher. The developers always say they are finding new ways to help the players build more in game currency but I have yet to see something. The levels set you up for failure all the time unless you play perfectly, but even then there is a chance you lose. Make the game 10% easier and give more coins and I will play again.

A few points I want to get across. One the game is very aggressive on the money front. I know games are meant to make money, but the curve is definitely very high. There are also times when the game forces you to do something, sometimes without the full information. A good example is mega mode. The first time Mega Mode activates it forces you to do it, but also says it will be free. It's the entry that is free and it does not explain fees still apply and they have increased. Ran out of room.

game is fun to play. would be better if the coins you win out of chests where more. if I wasn't playing on an app to win money for completion of levels I would not play as you need to spend money to keep going. what you earn is not nearly enuf coins to play. disappointed about that. now I needed 3 items in kitchen and they want me to buy them for $80 to complete it after I opened several baskets to get ones I don't need any more. total rip off to win things.

It used to be fun, but slightly frustrating, as it was mainly pay-to-play, except for events and side games that allowed in-game earnings. However, those are now completely gone, so you get enough to play one low-value game with no perks once a day. So, it's no longer worth the hassle, especially since to complete every level, you need a billion stars, yet still earn just one or two from completing the level. Time to make space for a less greedy download.

Yes, this game has beautiful graphics, and it's interesting and addictive. But I, as an experienced player, haven't seen worse algorithms in any other games. Here if you don't pay, you can lose for weeks, no winning. Usually, you can play easily, but additional attractions and bonuses need payment, of course. This game just eats your money if you simply want to play.

I've played solitaire for years. I made a purchase equaling 140,000 in Disney coins! played 15 rounds that always went into over payment, 8k left! Never getting ahead in 15 rounds! The rewards don't compare to the cost of getting additional cards or using a wild bar. I do not recommend this game to anyone unless you intend on spending $$ to move ahead in the levels. Definitely the thumbs down 👎

I am so disappointed in this game.It was fun until I couldn't play anymore without buying something!Beware, youll get through a few levels but eventually you won't be able to go any further. The game is set up to not let you get past the levels unless you give them money. Even when you do you'll still have to continue buying stuff. You get no where. You all should be ashamed. Taking advantage of people always comes back to haunt you. Smart, considerate adults know this.

Great Spin on an old favorite!! Originally I posted the above;; while that still remains the fact, after playing the game for awhile, I felt compelled to further the review. This is DEFINITELY a money MAKING game (for the makers of the app), it will actually cost you a fortune if you continue to play and pay (because you will pay to play). The more you play you realize it is set so you can't win without purchasing coins, PERIOD!

In typical Disney fashion, they've employed an algorithm that draws you into spending money in order to progress through the levels. the more you spend, the easier they make it to complete levels but when they hit the switch your credits drain rapidly. Very addictive but you will definitely need to buy credits to progress. Beware

love the game at first. it was a lot of fun but now the pop-ups are getting annoying and I redeemed my Google Play points to obtain a 40,000 coin package and as soon as I did so the app will no longer opened. every time I try it just says oops an error occurred, restart app. if I can't open the app how am I supposed to play. ridiculous!!!!

the game is fun but it gets really expensive to play really quickly! I have noticed a direct correlation to buying packs and progressing in levels. as soon as you get on a roll and are building coins in your bank (as opposed slowly losing coin each round) the game will throttle your play and every time you get down to the last 2 cards you are forced to either replay or play an incredibly expensive booster to pass. So, buy a pack and I'm good for like 5 or 6 more levels until it goes south.

It's fun and all, however you have to wait 50 minutes to even get coins to even play the game and progress in it. If you want to play continously, you have to pay, and the paywall keeps popping up everytime. There is a practice, but you get literally nothing from it. It would've been better if we could get coins from the practice.

Complete money grab!!! Won't give you any playable cards and the "rewards" are pathetic in comparison to how much you have to spend to even complete a level!! (cost 6,000 coins to play but want you to spend 11,000 because there is 1 card left without a match) once I'm done getting paid by another app to play this I'm out. DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME.

Unplayable! I was playing this game through the Amazon App Store and it was having so many problems, crashing, severe FPS lag, etc, that I decided to sideload it through Google Play thinking that this version might be better. It isn't. The EXACT same issues I was having on the Amazon version is here! This indicates that it's an issue with the game itself, not the device. I have other games sideloaded that don't have issues THIS severe. Do yourself a favor, stay away until fixed!

The cost of playing a round keeps going up, which is confusing and frustrating. First it's 3,000 , then it's 3,100. It's currently at 5,100 to play a round. It takes like, half a day for me to actually play a round and not run out of coins WITHOUT paying out of my pocket. I still play the game, but the rising cost and incessant money-ad ons is disappointing.

You are lucky if you can even play for more than 5 minutes. You get enough money for one try and if you unable to beat the level then you have to either spend real money or wait an hour. The levels most of the time aren't even possible, as it gives you cards you can't do anything with. No one should play this game unless your interested in wasting money

This game is complete trash to me. It doesn't function like traditional solitaire. This is like playing solitaire with multiple decks of cards and if you happen to not have the cards you need you have to pay for a chance to get the right cards to complete the game. Between paying coins just to play the level then the coins you spend for extra cards, replays, and wild cards you can go from 50k to 500 within 4 levels. Ask me how I know😒. I'd uninstall it if not for Free Cash. But not for long.

this game could be fun, but they charge you to play but don't give you any options to get more coins except spend money. I just wanna play. if you're playing for money like on free cash, don't bother. you may make a dollar. this game is much like the theme park. you have fun in the very beginning but quickly gets boring and dumb and expensive.

it's okay much like other games that use coins. But, today I played it and suddenly I was put back to the first scene and level. It was working fine all day! This is horrible, I was well into the game and had (sadly) paid for some packs. Now, all the progress and time is wasted. Will be uninstalling. And because I don't have a FB anymore I didn't save it because I didn't think this would happen. I never uninstalled it before this happened. So this sucks

Honestly, I downloaded this game because I like solitaire and I was bored. But seriously this game is a scam. The rewards for each level are less than what it costs in coins to play each level and it's really just Disney looking for yet another cash grab. there are way better card game apps out there that won't cost you actual money to play. Don't get me wrong. I love Disney characters and the like but this app is not worth the download.

There are many levels that I've beat and not made my coins back to cover the cost of the level. I've watched it happen multiple times. If I have 116k coins, and a level costs 13k, why do I only end up with 115k coins after a win? it's hard not to think it's rigged to force you to pay to play to get ahead. it feels a lot like gambling, it'll hook you in when things are good, but it will waste all your money in the end. it's addicting enough that I could easily spend a chunk of money on this game.

if you're playing this game for money, do not waste your time. U literally have to buy coins just to progress in all the scenes. and you waste most of your coins when you reup more cards during a game, going back on a card, etc etc. you can lose coins real fast in just one game and to get it all back and save to keep playing takes forever. but if you are just playing for fun because you like solitaire then have at it. just dont expect to progress fast or play many games. the ai is brutal!

Now I remember why I deleted this game a while ago. I kept getting frustrated with the bad hands delt, losing all my coin, and not making up enough coin to keep playing or play again. It keeps wanting me to pay for coin, but I want an actual free game. Something fun and to pass the time. I can't really have fun, when I play a couple games and then run out of all my coin faster than able to earn any. It's a cute game, good idea, but not the greatest in actually achieving anything.

the game starts out fun. very engaging I loved it. then it became very obvious that its pay to win. all the sudden you just never get the card you need, unless you spend coins for one more set of cards and then you win. quickly drains your free money to play the game. the fun stoped when I realized I was forced to spend money and not encouraged to support a good game. I want to give you money for quality, not as an obligation to stay here.

it's not a game, it's a pay to play game! not even pay to win! can't play without paying! you lose more coins to start a round than actually winning coins! so you end up without coins to play after a few rounds and you need to pay again just to be able to play! and no you aren't looking for new FUN way, it'snt your first game that runs this way!

I was really enjoying this game, but I think it's rigged after a certain point to make you lose so you will spend real money to keep playing. I did a google search, and A LOT of other people think so, too. This is supposed to be fun, and solitaire is supposed to be somewhat easy, but I can't win one game today. I get making higher levels more challenging, but this is going a bit too far.

Terribly unfair hands quite often, like I'll skip 4-7 cards that aren't helpful to anything on the board. I have no issue losing a hand when I go too fast or if I poorly planned which one I'm gonna hit next, but when all I have left is a 3 and none of my remaining cards are a 2 or a 4, I feel like I'm being screwed so I'll keep using my coins and maybe buy some. this game is predatory, like many other games, but it's a good way to kill time

Yes it's fun to play but goodness it is SO hard to get any coins! It cost 2,300 to play the level I'm on and I only get about 2,700 ish after winning. That's hardly anything considering if you lose there goes the 2,400 that you put in. You can get a bonus but only every hour for about 2,200. Also there is a streak reward of 6 straight wins, which is difficult but once you get that one the next is a 28 streak. That is outrageous! We need to be able to easily obtain more coins! I'm out of coins...

I dont know how its rated so high when most reviews I see are 3 and below. its a bit fun at first, rapid progression, kinda fun. later on to play a game you HAVE to spend coins because the cards are randomized so its not a thinking game, you're at the mercy of the random cards to which almost all the time the ones you get will not complete the board. it gets more and more expensive the higher you go so its almost impossible to play at higher points without spending which is sad.

I absolutely love this game. but even if you beat solitaire your coin goes down and if you need extra cards, depending on how many sets you need you could kill $20 worth of coin in one game. I've been playing less than a week and emptied my bank account. the bonuses are impossible to get because you can get 40 puzzle pieces and not one will match. the items you need aren't coming fast enough and it's like 5500 coin for one free card.that needs to be looked at by the game admin.
