This game is terrible, you can't make progress on the missions unless you spend tons of coins, and you don't earn enough from winning to keep playing. The developer just comments "thanks! we're working on it!" and don't make the game any better. Game is a great looking, but it's on fire. Avoid it, go play something else.

The game was ok. There are wayyyy too many pop ups for in game purchases for deals, it's insane!! And it's too quick and easy to lose all your money and not be able to play. Not long into the levels the cost goes up for each round and the aid cards and things get crazy expensive. You end up having to log in every hour just to collect the hourly reward to be able to play. I also noticed this game significantly drained my phone battery, even if I cleared it out completely.

This game is fun.. Sometimes it's extremely difficult to play if you don't want to spend money, and I don't. I wish when you won free game tickets all levels were free, not just the first level, nor free plus whatever. those 3 levels should also get more stars when you win it. 1st level, 1 star. 2nd level, 2 stars, 3rd 3 stars. Not just 1 each level. If I have enough of something like the blue orbs, I shouldn't have to purchase something in order to use what I earn from playing for free.

Let's not beat around the bush-- this is a DISNEY game, so yes it's pricey to play. (I can already predict the dev's trying to claim it's free; it absolutely is not possible to play longterm for free.) However-- the graphics and scenes are SUPER cute and nostalgic. The gameplay itself is fast and smooth. I personally bought the starter package, but once the coins are gone I'm gonna uninstall so I'm not tempted to spend more. It really is a cute game though 🥹

I didn't expect to find a game I could get so invested in. I've been playing games to make a little money. I love this game and would play it either way. It's cute, fun and challenging enough to keep me interested.

Deleting the game. As other's have mentioned, it's too hard to progress without spending money. You could basically log into the game every hour, receive the hourly bonus, and still not progress a single level. Even if you have enough to buy an extra five cards for the deck with only two cards left on the board, you'd still come up with no matches. The game has become increasingly frustrating, and not worth the time.

It's a cute game and is fun to play. However, it quickly becomes pay to play to an annoying degree. The cost to play each level is absurd, and the game becomes impossible without using bonus cards or wild cards, which becomes extremely expensive. I got frustrated at a level in the 130s and did a test. I had ONE card left to clear. I had 2 cards, then blew through all my gold on the +5 card. I ultimately went through 32 cards without being able to clear it. Insanity.

Fun game at the start, cool character themes but expensive. You win for a bit and then it really costs you to play more. To play new games (or hands) you buy with the coins you receive but it never matches up to what you spent. Some of the rewards don't even show up. The higher levels you go the worse it gets. what a disappointment.

Very fun game and love the graphics! however, I'm at Level 127 and it's impossible to go through a level without using all your coins. The percentage of coins earned does not equate to one game play, and you'll have to buy more coins with real money. Things need to cost less and more rewards or else most people will tap out at around Level 150. Hopefully an update will solve this.

The very start of the game is great and you get hooked. However, the higher the levels you achieve the more coins it takes to play. So it comes down to choice, spend money to receive more coins to play. Or wait an hour or more to collect free coins. I personally like to keep playing NOT to wait every hour on the hour to collect free coins. HUGE LET DOWN!!

Great graphics & solid game, but it's no fun when you can only play a few games at a time. It doesn't gradually build up to each game costing a lot of your saved coins to play; it starts almost right from the very beginning. 2200 coins just to play a game. 5000-6000 to buy extra cards. And your winnings aren't nearly enough to make up for what you're spending. I thought this was going to be a game I would play for a very long time. Uninstalled today. Games should be fun, not aggravating.

it's a great game but few things I don't enjoy: 1. waiting an hour for more coins to play one round. most games have you wait 30 mins. 2. Whether the round is hard or easy the number of stars are the same. For more difficult rounds, you should earn more stars to complete the scenes, same goes for the puzzle pieces. the amount of puzzle pieces needed are also unrealistic. it would take forever to get 100 "puzzle pieces" to uncover one piece. The only way you are able to finish a puzzle $$$

Once you pass level 100 expect to constantly have to pay to be able to complete the level, the ratio between what you get for winning versus what you have to spend to play is awful. You can have 15 cards on the bottom and one left on the board and you will not get the card you need to win. This game certainly pushes micro purchases to the point you need them in order to get any further. Otherwise cute game.

A few days in & the fun has been zapped out of it. I'm a big Disney fan, so cute themes, but the fact that you pay coins to play each level is ridiculous. The amount payed vs won is usually close, meaning you never get ahead in the game. For instance, if the level costs you 2,100 coins to play and you win 2,237 at the end of the round, then you are only up by 137. Stop charging to play! Also, I'd watch a quick ad for a free set or wild card if it meant saving coins. I mean 5k for a wild? Dumb.

predatory monetization, as with all free games. it starts off well enough. but once you get to a certain point you can potentially play 1 match every 6 hours. That by itself is not great. The major problem is that when you start the game you're greeted with, NO LIE, at LEAST 6 windows with offers to get coins to play with purchases. If you accidentally click a button to use something you don't have coins for, you see them ALL again.

This game is genuinely fun to play with lovely animations and it brought back nice memories. I truly enjoyed it up to a certain point. After that, it sadly turned into a money pit.To make progress and earn achievements, I had to spend an absurd amount of money. Items are extremely expensive, and the game feels downright unfair; it's pure bad luck not being able to play that last card, while you have many chances. To avoid financial trouble, I unfortunately had to uninstall it.

Basic canned response to every review calling it out as the pay to win structure that it is, stating that it's "optional to buy coins". I mean, I guess you could play that gaslighting card if you want to. It's certainly optional I suppose, if you never want to play, or only want to play one hand a day and wait for the coins to regenerate so you can play for 5 more minutes. The game itself is super cute.

The game itself is fun, but there are too many ads for in-app purchases and too few coins for what things cost in-game. To afford a single game (standard rewards) where you also need to use a wild card, you'd need to have opened the app and collected 4 separate times, at least an hour apart, without using those coins for a round of the game, and each of those times you open the app, you have to click through 4-6 ads for in-app purchases.

After spending some times to play this game (lvl 900+), I feel exhausted to keep on trying to win. The amount of the reward we got everytime we success on finishing a level does not give significant amount for us to save up and use the coins to play the next level/attempt. In fact, realize it or not, I feel the urge to purchase packages to help me finish the level just because I "almost" finish it...

The game started out fun, but I had to change my review, because after so long I feel like they rig it to make you spend money. They only give you enough free money every hour to play the lowest level. Then when you when a lot of money like up to 100k, they make it where you can't win the round without spending it. It's a nice concept, but I'm not spending a bunch of money on solitaire when there are other games that have the same concept without having to spend the money.

The first two levels were great, but after that, the game becomes way too expensive to play. It’s frustrating that you need coins just to continue playing — I’ve never seen a game that charges coins simply to access levels. On top of that, the multiplier option only results in a single star, which feels pointless when you need 50 stars to complete a scene. Really disappointing. The game had so much potential, but it ends up feeling like a cash grab.

I want to like this game, I really do. I've played it for a while to give it a fair review. It is adorable and so nicely crafted. But it's frustratingly difficult to pass levels, and each level is so expensive that you run out of coins quickly. I don't even bother with the Cars race because I can only pass 2-3 levels a day most days. And I'm typically very good at Solitaire, puzzle, and logic games. But this game is just unreasonably difficult.

This game's a lot of fun. I love the Disney feel of it. What I don't love is that I feel like it's rigged & after you get past a certain level, the cost of playing each round continues to go up more & more & it costs an outrageous amt of coins to do the extra 5 cards/wild. There have been countless times where I'm down to one card left and end up losing. I had 170k coins at one point and they diminished extremely quickly. It feels like a money grab even though it's "optional" to buy extra coins.

I wasnt expecting this,since we all know about the algorithms these types of games have,but its actually such a fun game to play. Tons of events and things to do (you unlock more events and stuff while you progress through the stages).Yes the game has algorithms,if you fail a level,just stop playing and play the next day so that the algorithm resets.Of course you have to grind every event and combo with them in order to have a slow and steady progress every day if you are a free to play player.

there's 2 kinds of solitaire games: 1, is the solitaire we've all come to recognize. 2 is a carefully orchestrated sequence with zero variation designed to make it impossible to advance without sp3nding money. the cards you'll see in every level will never vary, and are set up for failure. so it's spend money or lose. and I'm not really down for that.. it's not fun and there's no skill involved. there IS. a bonus you can wait an hour at a time to get to be able to buy your way through the level

The game at its core is amazing, I'm on level 809. I've been playing it for months and I've come to realise two big problems with the game. Both problems surround monetisation. The first problem is the coin system. Some days, I'm only able to play one game because if I lose all my coins are gone. I feel like a heart system like candy crush is better suited. The second issue is that every time you log in, multiple screens pop up trying to entice me to buy coins and perks. It ruins the enjoyment

The graphics are (of course) adorable but even after spending real money to buy extra coins, more then once, I would be wiped out of coins and unable to play. I was never offered "watch videos" to advance. And as you advance the cost of each game increases, as does the cost for extra cards to complete a game. It is impossible to get ahead. II finally deleted the game because I was so frustrated that a single game wiped out all the $$ coins that I had just purchased. So disappointing

the game was fun until their puzzle event turns out to be a scam. I once rushed for the event, where I am very near to the final reward which I have also reloaded. The remaining time was supposed to have at least 19 hours left, but the puzzle just suddenly disappear for no reason, when the other promotions/events that were sharing the same count down still exists. It was good until I experienced such scam from Disney. Disappointing.

I like the game. My main complaint is only getting one star per level. The higher and harder the level, the more you should get. like the levels with the cards that shift, you should get more stars and such because it cost more stars to complete each scene the higher you go. it just makes me not want to play. also, making the extra cards and wild cards cost more coins the higher the level, but not really winning more coins than what you get on the lower levels just doesn't make sense to me.

Fun and enjoyable for Solitaire and Disney lovers! It just becomes more difficult to progress due to increasing prices for each level. I don't mind paying coins for extra cards but I feel like the price to play a level should've stayed at 1000 coins like when you first start out (2000 for double rewards and so on). I get wanting to make money but these prices just make the game so much harder to play through and enjoy.

Like others I've seen, the game is fun. Currently, I am at level 131 and am at a standstill. The levels cost so much to play, the next time I am able to collect hourly coins, I still will not be able to play a game. So the expectation, I guess, is that I log in, collect coins, and wait an additional hour, do it again to play 1 round? Unfortunately, that's going to be a hard pass. I honestly don't understand the mindset of creating a mobile game that you don't want people to play. 🤷‍♂️

Don't waste your time playing this game. It is fun and challenging at first but once you get higher up in the levels it's impossible to get through without buying packs. Not to mention it seems very obvious it will give you cards over and over that you cant use till you spend over 200,000 coins and are then broke so you have to buy more to beat the level. It starts out nice, easy and fun until you're hooked then its a money grabber game. I'm currently in the 700's. Beware!

Money grabbing scam game. Once you reach a certain level, it's ridiculous how many coins it costs to get to the next level. It costs when you lose, then costs to retry, then just to play the next level. Clearly not random play. I deliberately chose wrong several moves in a row, and I would still win, or use saved up wild cards and still lose. Uninstalled.

This is a really fun game. The graphics are great, and I like the different ways it brings disney into the game. But it's a money grab. If you want to advance at all, you have to spend money. It feels very rigged. Say I need an 8 to finish the round, half the time the last few cards I'll get are 8s. So I can lose my progress in the events or use more coins to get a few more cards that usually don't help anyway. I really enjoy playing, but I'm not spending more money to play solitaire.

It's a good game!... I just didn't like it as it wasn't the solitaire I play. There is a stack of cards and some other cards scattered face down with whatever card on top of the scattered ones being shown. You are supposed to stack the card with the next number/face higher than the one you pulled from your pile (if have a 4, you need a 5 card of any color to stack it). That is how you get more coins to play more solitaire games or tokens to get the characters. Will not keep.

It started off really fun. However, as you advance, the game becomes basically unplayable due to the large amount of coins needed per level. You can wait an hour for more coins, but it's still not enough to complete a level due to needing additional cards to complete the level. This is a game I really wanted to keep playing. However, it's an obvious cash grab so I uninstalled it.

fun game, obvious money grab. the game itself is really fun. I like collecting parts and playing the side games. adds more to just the usual solitaire. unfortunately you have to get though at least 8 pop up ads every time you open the game (very annoying) and then you get to play one or two games before you run out of coins and it bombards you with options to pay quite a lot of irl money to get not a lot of in game coins. the obvious cash grab is to infinity and beyond annoying

The average rating would be much lower if people would not rate when asked to rate, because after that is when they start pushing transactions. Levels become extremely difficult, fairly quickly after you are asked to rate, so you must use coins to complete the level...but you can buy more coins of course. The scenes you build look great and makes you want to keep going to see what else can be added. The gameplay is very simple but a lot of luck as well.

This was a fun game at first. Then it turned into a money grab. You can't replay past levels, and the only way to get more turns is to wait and collect coins every hour. Forget about the side quests altogether unless you want to drop a fortune. *Edited add* I finally deleted it. After 4 tries on the same level, with over 7 cards left in the deck and 1 on the board, I didn't get the card I needed either try. Don't waste your time!!

The game is super fun, but the rigging to lose is almost too glaring to gloss over. The game forces you to either lose or waste a large amount of coins to buy lifelines. The mega push the entire time is to get you to spend and burn thru as many coins as possible until you run out...it's the business model but it's to the point that the game feels rigged and non-genuine.

Cute scenes, relaxing play, and bonus coins every hour. Great game! Edit 5/18/25: I reduced my rating from 5 to 4 stars. Everything I said before is true, but as you progress through the game, everything gets more expensive, and coins are lost too quickly. I lost interest after a month of trying to get coins as often as possible, only to lose them after a few games. I would rather have a few ads to get bonuses rather than pay $

Cute and fun gameplay, but past the first few worlds, it's impossible to play more than one or two rounds per day without spending real cash. The cost of everything goes up and it takes more items to progress to the next round. The hourly/daily coins are barely enough to play one round, you have to buy cards and still might not win. Wish I would have read reviews, uninstalling to save the frustration.

When this game is good, it's really good. The problem is that it feels needlessly frustrating the rest of the time. Every level and bonus items costs coins, and coins can be really hard to come by unless you're willing to pay real money for them. Like real solitaire, the cards are random every round, but here a bad round can easily wipe out days of decent progress and saving. The addition of special cards that hinder your progress make any attempt at strategy absolutely pointless.

Scam. The game is addictive and the graphics are good looking... But the game is a total scam. After the first 100 levels, you'll run out of coins quickly and the only way to continue for the day is to buy more. Some games are impossible to win, even though you have many cards to play. Daily rewards are low, and the hourly reward is laughable. It's a shame that Disney uses their IP like this... I think that the most popular gachas in the store still have more honor than this.

EDIT: I'm deleting what I previously wrote, as my complaints seem to be the same as everyone else's. I came back to lower my star rating because as I read reviews and the amount of times the reply "purchases are optional" in response to these complaints bugged me. Purchases are not optional if you need to purchase things to play more than once an hour. Great idea, but it probably wasn't the best strategy to exhibit the cash grab right out of the gate.

This game is rigged to make you lose everything so you'll pay. I have lost over 100,000 coins on just trying to beat one level (cost was 3200/game) Many times I'll have one card left and none of the 10 plus cards I flip are what I need. This game is such a rip off and when you run out you can wait an hour and play only 1 game. There should be a way to earn more coins without paying for it. Come on Disney...you have enough money let the poor people enjoy the game too!!!

As much as I love Disney and solitaire, I am so tired of the cost of levels going up so often. Especially when the daily coin rewards remain the same. And the cost of wild cards or extra cards increases as well. I want so badly to enjoy this game, but I just find myself getting more and more frustrated with it. The constant need for more coins makes it almost not worth playing anymore. I hope the developers make some serious changes soon.

Game was fun at first but gets more difficult as you go because you don't have enough coins to complete level. Also deals are stacked so you can't win them without buying coins. Too many request to but coins and puzzles that you complete disappear every few days. I wish it would not require you to pay to play because I like the Disney theme. I plan to uninstall and find something else that does not require you to pay.

I really like the fun Disney aspect added to a card game. However, the longer you play, the higher the cost in coins of each match and things like 'More Cards' or a 'Wild Card'. Its like a punishment for continuing to play. I do agree that sometimes it seems the match is set up to make you fail until you run out of coins and ultimately purchase more. the very next game you'll win even after playing the same level 10+ times.

classic game of a card before and after. the big issue with this game is that every time you play, it costs alot of coins. there is really no way to save up on the coin ls because if you want to get ahead in the game as well as beat the levels, you have to spend ALOT of money! there are other option ls to get rewards but it takes a long time if you don't play the max.

I like that game very much!! I love how it takes you back to the movie!! Just minor stuff that could be better. ok, Ive been playing for sometime and here are some of the stuff I think we need ...one of the things I dislike is that when it starts getting harder I feel I need to buy coins and that shouldn't be. We also need groups where we can share cards without having to friend them on fb or any other app...

T game is a total scam. beware that if you make a purchase especially for puzzle pieces that they only good for those certain puzzles and they will be taken away once the puzzles change even though you have spent the money on it. no one tells you that before you make a purchase so please be aware. I will never purchase from them again. I purchased over 300 puzzle pieces they were gone the next day just to be told by their support team oh well sorry they were only good for that event.

oh shi... here we go again PAYWALL. Great graphics, colors combinations, love it. Of course, if you want to enjoy this game you better get your wallet ready. - How does it work: you got in-game coins that you will spend just to enter a round of a game. At first, the game drowns you in coins which makes you feel like fun will never end. Unfortunately, from level 70 to 100 you'll lose a significant amount of coins... I mean all of them. Purchase some or wait... PAYWALL... bruh, come on..

It's generally a good game, lovely graphics and game play is smooth. But it's a cash grab. I get 3 popups asking me to buy stuff when launching. Then levels cost more and more as you progress, 5 extra cards cost more after each use. After about 3-4 uses it costs 2x the level cost.wild card is about 3x more. Levels become harder to beat. Coins will slowly run out and I will uninstall. It won't be fun anymore and not spending real money. Also need a way to stop animations, drains battery quickly.

Good game, however, it takes way too much to get to the next level or win the little games within the game, where extra rewards are earned if you win stars or other items. Players would have to devote 3 hours, or more, daily to play in order to win the little games that give extra rewards because those little side games require a lot of points, but are only active a certain amount of time before they end, ending all your progress with them, and new ones begin.

Really promising at the start. But it slowly turned into a cash grab. You will see it once past level 40 or something. Levels are increasingly impossible to clear without power ups. The cost far outweighs the rewards. being a Disney game, this is really disappointing. and yeah, going to expect a purchase is an optional reply from the devs. Classic.

Fun and addicting until the microtransaction wall hits. What happened to playing to progress? This app sadly hits a wall where you have to pay to progress. It's not like normal solitaire and it feels like the game chooses when you win since the cards are all at random. I don't want to pay just to finish a level. I'll probably end up deleting the app. Wish I could've gotten into the game more but I can't stand the microtransactions.

Terribly greedy! It's fun at first but it quickly turns in to a cash grab! You have too pay in game currency too play a level and if you pass the level you get what you paid and maybe and extra 15-25% of what you paid. That would be fine if the boosters didn't also cilost the same currency and the price goes up every time you use one... Upwards of 2-3 times the cost of playing a level... With very limited other options for getting coins, besides paying for them, time to play becomes limited...

The premise of the game is interesting and the disney theme is fun. The problem is that the game quickly becomes pay to play. You have to pay in game currency for just about every action that you do. The game heavily punishes you if you fail a level and they use common mobile game tactics to try to coerce you into spending money. Prepare to be stuck on levels and not get very far if you aren't willing to spend money daily. Not worth my time. Uninstalling.

It's fun for sure, but it's a cash grab at it's finest. They are always pushing 3 to 4 different "sales" per day to buy more coins. the game is rigged so you fail and need to buy more coins. otherwise you're looking at getting to play 1 game per HOUR. the game doesn't reward you which is my biggest issue. You can achieve huge combos and have like 1 card left to match with like 8 cards left in your draw pile, and none will work forcing you to spend your coins. It's obvious what they are doing.

Great game until you get past a certain level. Then, you are required to spend money on coins to continue playing. It gets stupidly expensive to play each game, and on top of that, if you want to buy wild cards or add 5 cards, it gets ridiculously expensive. When you run out of coins, tons of things pop up asking you to buy coins. I had over 600k coins @ 1 point. Then they were gone within 3 days. Not worth it. Great game if they didn't ruin it by being money hungry. Way to ruin a good game.

I have gotten to level 1100 without paying cash, but it seems like the game has caught on as I have only been able to win one level a day! I had over 120,000 coins and suddenly my level cost went up after every level and it depleted all of my coins without a single win. It is obvious that not every game is structured in a way that you are able to win. The game itself is cute and they are adding some fun new features, but I'm unable to play them all because I win one level a day 🤷.

This game is a 10/5 on fun and a -1000/10 on monetization. Ripping off faerie solitaire gameplay is a smart move, the graphics and gameplay are good riffs on that original idea. But there is so much BS, pushes to purchase, fifty different forms of money, "sales", a dozen events at any given time, and all kinds of psychological manipulation. the second star here is only because the game is fun, but it deserves far, far worse than that. Faerie Solitaire is more worth your time and money.

Fun at first, then they just want your money. The rounds become more and more impossible to beat unless you spend more and more money. To buy more cards, just 5, cost a ridiculous amount of coins. I uninstalled it. Stopped being fun when I realized how much it costs. Developer: Yes, all purchases are optional. You missed the point of my review. You make the levels impossible to beat without spending real money. The amount of coins required to play to continue is ridiculous. Others say the same.

it becomes way to expensive to buy coins Play tip: If you don't want to spend money playing. First ignore any contests or puzzles that want you to get to the end. Puzzles are laughably difficult to get to the end. Get all of your hourly coins (waaay too small compared to the cost of extra cards or wild cards. 2000) you keep getting money as long as you win. lose and it's costly. currently weighted too much to pay. i uninstalled it but came back but will likely uninstall it again.

Don't get this game. it's the absolute biggest scam. Seems great in the beginning, however the higher level you reach, the more coins it costs, and yet the prizes don't go up. Alot of times the prizes are lower than what it even costs to play. "The Decks" aren't accurate and it's an absolute waste unless you wanna dump several dollars a day, just to play a couple games, cause the suck all your coins out of you and never let you get ahead. It's a SCAM and a RIP-OFF.

Yeah, they're optional. But it costs coins to start a level. So if you get to a point where you either have to buy more cards or a wild, you can leave, but now you lost those coins. In 1 night I went from 80k coins to under 20k. What you're doing is just telling me to only play once in a while and idle to get coins back. Fine with me, but not a great business strategy. I play this one about once a week and idle the rest gathering coins every hour. If that's what you're going for, it's working.

needs to be more skill based rather than needing to buy coins & more ways to obtain coins. Puzzle results seem to be randomly determined at the start of the level you'll either fail or pass based on RNG!

It was fun, when I could play. It's 1800 gold pieces to play each level and you MIGHT clear 2200 gold pieces when you complete one. 1800 for each try, around 3000 for any help or "booster" and for your investment you MIGHT make 450 profit to keep going. I'm sure you can do that math. Doesn't appear to be any way to even watch ads to get more gold; you're pretty much forced to spend real money.

Updated to 1 Star. I mean, seriously, to be at level 1175 and needing 3 cards for the complete album for 3 weeks now, and it closes in 2 days. You must give 1% of players a complete album. So much time and embarrassingly, money - Im done now. Agree with others - Seems to be biased. There are levels that take 10+ tries, and you get to one card left, with 8 or so in the deck and dont even come close to that you need. You also bring friends in and never get credit for them.

Super fun game and I love the characters; however, you need way too many stars to advance each piece and it gets boring fast. plus, the computer doesn't let you win more than a couple rounds in a row very often so you have to wait to generate more money to play the same level several times before you advance. Not worth playing if it takes several days to earn enough stars to do just one piece of each level.

Has the potential to be fun and has good mechanics. However it is entirely luck based and you frequently have hands that are incapable of winning the round, seemingly to push you buying the expensive power-ups to drain your coins faster. it gets quite frustrating when you have seen 6 of the same card. If it were more balanced for allowing more skill and less programmed luck it would be better rated. This may be a programing error rather than a push to buy currency, but frustrating regardless.

As other reviews have mentioned, this game is an obvious cash grab and completely rigged. Honestly I wouldn't spend a dime on this game because everything is overpriced and there are no ways to gain energy. Unless you want to constantly spend, you'll have to wait 1-2 hours in order to make an attempt at a level, often taking multiple attempts to pass a single level. This game needs the option of sending coins to friends and ways to earn coins. Possibly offline rewards up to 24h

Edit 6/10/25: I'm around level 290. It takes about 16 hours of collecting gold coins to play 1 game, unless you spend real money. I've uninstalled the game. Extremely predatory game. Every time you sign on, you get about 6 pop-ups trying to get you to spend money. The higher the level, the longer it takes to save up the coins to even play. I have to collect coins for several days just to play the game for 10 minutes, or I could spend a boatload of money to play for an hour or so

It's cute but the 'cost' to play keeps going up but the hourly login bonus never does. So it may cost $12,000 to play a hand but you can only collect $2,800 every hour. So after 10 hours you can play 1 hand. Then the puzzle pieces expire. I saved up 340 puzzle pieces, knowing I still didn't have enough to finish the puzzle but thinking I could get a head start on the next puzzle...the puzzle expired and took my pieces with it. So I'm back to square one with the puzzles. loosing interest.

Not impressed, the more you play this game the more money you loose. To start with you have to pay money to play a level!!!! The price for levels keeps rising, plus you have to pay for cards and the price doubles then triples. There is no way you can get ahead without buying from them. Huge money grabbing! Big disapointment from Disney, I expected more.

Loved it at first, but it didn't take too long to realize you will have to spend money, to continue enjoying game play. Personally, I prefer being able to play more than 1 game of solitaire, at a time. Furthermore, having to replay the same round over, multiple times, because it's not winnable, without purchasing additional boosts, really annoys me. This game is similar to Grand Harvist, which I uninstalled for those same reasons. I guess I had higher expectations of a game with the Disney name.

Great! But everything in the app 'costs' way too much in my opinion.... coins to even play the next level, coins to 'buy' an advantage (extra or wild card)... some levels are nearly impossible without! It feels impossible to complete some of the challenges without spending real money since you have to spend so many coins to advance a level. But I love the scenes and the basic play. it'll just take forever to complete any.

This is a really enjoyable game, but the costs for the game saving bonuses and frequency with which you almost HAVE to use them are outrageous compared to how much you gain for winning levels and progressing in events. It is far too easy to blow QUICKLY through a couple hundred thousand coins and find yourself having to collect hourly coins for a whole day or two before you can hope to play for any longer than 5 minutes at a time.

Game appears to be designed to just rip you off. I paid for extra coins quite a few times, like an idiot. Only to have the game rig the cards to lose it all in 5 mins. Also, once you get close to filling the sticker album, which carries a pretty big pay off, you never get the remaining new cards to fill it. Time will expire on the album and a new one will start. As if Disney really needs this game to make more money.

This game is HEAVILY relies on Pay-to-play. If you don't buy a tremendous amount coins and soley rely on Free-to-play. Then you'll be stuck on Scene 3 for a while. It'll feel like eternity when trying to complete Scene 4. Also, odds of getting lucky with good cards is EXTREMELY LOW! Plus every scene gets more and more expensive. As you progress through the game. Once you hit level 90 you can increase your rewards. But, I wouldn't recommend it. As the cost of coins outweighs the benefits.

CASH GRAB. I'm glad I played for a while before leaving a review. I loved the game at first. You have to pay coins just to play a level, and if you lose the level, you lose the coins. The higher the level, the more difficult to win AND you have to pay more coins just to play and lose, which means you quickly run out of coins. I did buy coins once to get ahead, but after a few days I was back down to nothing. I deleted the game so I'm not tempted to buy more.

This game has one of the most predatory gameplay loops I have ever seen. The solitaire portion is fun and the layout of the cards are inventive and entertaining, HOWEVER, it constantly feels rigged against you. It will give you a deck full of cards that have no use, only to force you to spend coins on items to keep playing. They throw "deal" after "deal" in your face trying to get you to spend money just to simply engage with the game. Absolutely shameful. Especially since it is Disney themed.

I really like to play this game, hence I am a big Disney person. the pictures are bright and fun. however I can only play one, maybe two rounds before I run out of coins. I can't proceed for two days due to the high amount of coins to play another round? I have to wait for the coins to add up again- if I'm even available to see the notification every hr, to keep up in order to get enough coins to play again. then I gotta wait a whole other day to play again. it takes the enjoyment out of playing

While it's a good game to have with kids who love seeing the Disney scenes play out, it's frustrating as an adult. the game very obviously slows you down on progress, not giving you cards that you need to defeat the level at a statistically impossible rate. it's an obvious ploy to get you to spend money in the shop. wish I could stop playing, but my kids like the scenes playing out, so I'll just have to inch my way forward and not pay anything out of spite 😅

I deleted the app. At first, it was fun but the cost to play each round kept going up. The rounds seem to be set up so you have to pay for extra cards with in-game currency to win and the cost keeps going up there as well. One reviewer shared a strategy that I used, which is to stop playing for a while then go back to the app and you'll receive coins but with the cost to play going up and the rounds are set up to use more coins to win, eventually that strategy may not work. Very disappointing.

Game is what it is: Fairway Solitaire meets Disney but made in a way that (if kids were to play this), they would be asking their parents to buy the coins needed to play. I've reached the 180s in level and the game really either forces you to wait for those Daily Bonus of coins or pay to play. I don't want to say it's a cash grab but it feels so much like it. EDIT: Also, Devs don't really listen. They say they do, but considering the date of the reviews that say the same thing? Doubtful.

I love winning one round and then immediately losing. Then I have to wait an hour cause the prices are predatory. Fun but certainly bad for those with gambling habits. EDIT: This game has not improved. I encountered five 4 cards in one game. It is not played with a 52 card deck. It has been built to make you lose in hopes you will spend money to keep playing. I'd prefer a one-time fee to just play the game.

Fun, but costly. What more could a classic Disney fan (before they went off the deep end) ask for. You get to play cards to unlock themed backgrounds from beloved Disney movies. However, that enjoyment quickly fades away once the player realizes that each level costs coins to play, the cost for 'power ups' increases substantially (right from the start, too), and the constant reminders of purchasing packages, the game just becomes another cash grab. Coins for power-ups are fine, but not levels.

Great game when you actually get to play. Once you get to Frozen, you'll get to play once a day. Clearly a cash grab as others have said. The coin costs for items etc is absolutely insane. Without paying for coins, you're not going to get to play as much as you get to with the first two movies. The hourly coin retrieval is laughable considering what everything costs. Uninstalling if no improvement very soon. How on earth is the average for this 5 stars right now? Sus

HOW DID YOU MAKE SOLITAIRE PAY TO WIN???? Don't get me wrong it's a decent game, and the animations are fantastic, but the transactions are DISGUSTING. This game is meant for young kids! Yet the first thing that pops up whenever you load into the game are paid items?! sometimes you even need to pay to play. Some parent has probably downloaded this game for their kids, only to mysteriously have random credit card charges pile up because of this game. Young kids should probably avoid this game.

It's not even solitaire, which I was pretty sad about since I love solitaire, but I tried it out anyway. Was pretty fun at the start. Feels great when you get a streak of cards back to back. But that doesn't make up for later levels when you get 5-6 cards back to back that you can't even use, sometimes even off the bat. it's like the levels are intentionally designed to be unwinnable. I play perfect and still can't win cuz they don't give me anything. Just not worth the irritation. Uninstalled

Was a lot of fun at first. It started to get frustrating with only being able to finish levels and challenges if you purchase something. Then when with the albums were getting close to closing, no matter how many I earned it never gave me any I needed. Almost all of the albums only had one picture left to be completed, but the game never gave me any of them. It's completely rigged. It's not even fun to play anymore if they make it impossible to complete things without spending real money.

This game is probably one of the more enjoyable ones as far as the graphics. Be ready to pay to play. Yes, you can play for free if you don't want to advance in levels or you don't want to gain in the collection of items throughout the game within the time frame given. Also, when you start items like 5 extra cards will be a few hundred coins, and then by level 100+ it is $16,500. The same with the wild card it starts around 1,000 and then goes to 10,500 for the same item that is in the beginning

Game is fun, but too stingy on coins. every hour you get like 2500. similar solitaire games I play give 12k in that same timeframe. and when levels cost at MINIMUM 2600, well it's just not worth it to only be able to play a couple times a day. other solitaire games beat this one out. the "grand prizes" are also a joke. the costs increase exponentially. you think you're doing okay and then all of a sudden you need 600+ to get to the final tier. waste.
I'm enjoying it I think it's a great game. Not only you're playing Solitaire but you also get a chance to decorate the room dance put statues and items on the wall it's ongoing fun.

It is very average. The gameplay is kind of entertaining, but the levels feel rigged. They almost always trend toward the negative. Gotta pay 2k to get 5 more cards in this game, but in the next game, you'll have a bunch of cards left over, which you'll only get 120 for. It just feels off. There are way better time wasters out there.

Avoid this game unless you don't mind spending money on them—it’s designed to entice you. Once you run out of tokens, you’ll wait an hour to play again. Though “free items” exist, they often require purchases or unlocking paid features. Tokens are scarce, leaving gameplay unstable—you earn about 400 above what you spend, varying slightly. It takes several (5 at minimum) wins to recover from a single loss, making it costly to stay in the game.

Been cheated one to many times with this game. This game is pay a lot and win very little money. Stay away from these crooks. You also don't get everything you are supposed to get with purchases. Missing over 60,000 coins in my last 2 purchases. I am done with this money grubbing games and Disney in general. Do not waste your time. I also cancelled my play pass. You get no where in this game unless you buy a lot of purchases, also after every single game, the cost goes up by over a 1,000 coins.

well, as far as solitaire games go, it's so so. the pop-up ads are really annoying. the game is a huge money grab all the cost, real money bundles pop up every time you open the game. you cant interact with the characters and the "mini games" arent games they are just things you collect. also you dont keep the puzzles you unlock they disappear and are replaced with new ones so theres no real incentive to compete. all the events last only a few days at most cuz they want you to spend money.

What I've found: 1. Money Grab. If you have money laying around, go for it. If not, think 2ce. 2. Levels are purposely set up to have you fail. Again, the money grab. If you can, wait it out for the hourly replenishment. 3. Once I purchased, I was kicked off the app before I got the freebies that came with the purchase. When I logged back in, the freebies didn't populate. I purchased again and had to let them know. Though they restored, it happened again, but no response from them now. 👎🏾

Going to start off with saying that I LOVED this game.... that being said, once you get to level 300 it becomes the most pay to play game I've ever come across. You get stuck on a level for days. It doesn't matter how many wilds or +5 cards you use. The game will just not LET you go past that level until it allows you to. I log in ever hour to play a round and no matter what I either end up with 1 card left or 3 of the same numbered cards over and over and over again.

The game is fun and addictive. However, it's completely a cash grab game. The higher you get in levels, the more coins it costs to play. Yes, you get a "refill" every hour, but it is only the amount to play one round. Daily rewards seem to depend on the current amount of coins you have. Some days, there are no additional coins. When you win a round, the prize is only slightly more than the cost to play one round. In order to play this game continuously, you need to play, which is ridiculous.

the graphics and game is great. The huge downside is as you progress it takes many levels to proceed but the difficulty in getting your lives refilled is one every hour but does not automatically accumulate you have to go in every hour to collect coins. The coins required to play one level is ridiculous. Too bad I was really enjoying and now not much worth my time and effort. I will be deleting.

Unable to play for more than 5 minutes unless you are willing to go in and out of the game hour after hour for days on end to get enough points to play for an amount of time worth playing. Anyone not mentioning this is either rich enough to have enough disposable income to throw away money on an app that you should be able to play for free, or they work for the developer. Just make the "reward" for finishing a hand ten times what it is now to fix this.

Very nice game, but each level costs ENORMOUS amount of coins. If you need a few extra to win the level, forget it. You Just can't keep up. It's impossible to play since there's never enough coins. On top of that, when you spend the enormous amount of coins needed for the few extra cards, it's not a guarantee that you'll even get the card you need!!! I'm not sure why the game was designed like this, but you really can't play for more than 5 minutes. I've since uninstalled this game.

fun and can be addicting. *update* I am dumping this game. It is fun to play but you have to pay for everything. I have purchased two of the $4.99 Coin packages. I have made it to level 40 but the second set of coins is nearly gone due to the cost of items going up as I get higher in levels. The amount that you win for completing a level doesn't make up for the cost to enter and then all the extras that come up song the way as you play the level. I am deleting this as soon as I leave the review.

I invested in this game because I liked it, wanted to keep playing without the hourly coin allowance and wanted to finish the villians puzzle. 4 out of the 5 purchases done the same day did not give me everything I was supposed to get in their "deals". I contacted customer support through the game and received an automated response. No efforts have been made by support to rectify this. The deals and coordinating prizes for the events have now ended. I'm out money and time.

The game is fun to play and the graphics are good. I refuse to spend money on apps and extra coins, so that greatly limits the amount of time you can play. You can come back every hour and get free coins, but the deck is literally stacked against you and you usually have to use extra coins to beat a level. I only downloaded it to get coins through Fetch, so once I've gotten to the next scene I'm deleting the game. It loses the appeal when you can't play very often.

Fun and cute. No stress or annoying adds *So, once you get up to higher levels 130 or so, it gets ridiculously expensive to play. Many of the hands will not be winning hands, so you will need to use a WILD card or pay tons of coins to get a few more cards. Every draw costs even more coins. I just replay over and over instead. At Easter, I spent some Google coins to buy a $25 pack they had on special. Once those coins are gone, I will delete the app. It's too much of a micro trans hungry app.

I've been playing for a while now and admittingly purchased rewards-coins, cards, etc.- the game is fun for what it is but I have to agree with other users that this is a cash grab. I noticed on one occasion after buying coins, how the game gets expensive and harder, and essentially you're right where you started. It lowers the experience of an otherwise fun game. note to developers: either up the hourly bonus or lower the price of cards during the game.

I read all the reviews and this game seemed like it would be fun, I'm literally stuck on lvl 6. I use every card available and can't pass it. I've played it over and over again. Am I supposed to skip over useable cards? When I lose, I have backed out of the level to play again,and I've just hit play again. It costs 1,000 and I get the same cards in the same exact order. I had 3 other people try the level too and none of them could figure it out. Look, its not rocket science, it's level 6.

This game is actually a ripoff and waste of time. It's completely rigged and only lets you keep coins when it wants you to. It's all just a gimmick to make you start paying real money to progress faster. I haven't spent a single dime and I don't plan to. It takes so long to complete scenes, especially the further along you get. It'll start making you pay 10 stars 1 PART. It's not even really solitaire. I wouldn't recommend this app to anyone, but I have another app that's paying me to play it.

I want to love this game. With some tweaks, it could be amazing. It's not traditional Solitaire, but matching threes to twos or fours, for example, to recreate chibi-fied versions of your favorite Disney scenes is fun...at first. But it's WAY too aggressive about wanting your money. In later levels, if you don't pay, you can't even play for hours on end; not enough coins. The "more cards" power up doesn't even guarantee you'll get even ONE needed card to continue. Way overpriced too. Boo.

Typical tower like solitaire game. Nothing special, this one is just Disney. Games need to make money. Because this one does not use external ads, it relies on in app purchase only. In doing so, they've ramped up cost per play so high that after a few hours and 80 levels, you're tempted to making those purchases. It's not sustainable as a player and waiting hours for just enough coins to play 1 level is actually insulting. The app is beautiful and flawless, the income strategy is anything but.

The game is really fun and super cute! But it's so annoying to play at times. I would even say it's kina pay-to-win. I just went from having over 30k coins to having 400. Some rounds, you don't even have cards that can be used, and you're left with just a few card left with nothing in the deck, so you HAVE to gamble of purchasing more cards with coins, but it's still not garenteed you'll get what you need. Sometimes, you have to purchase more 1-3 times.

I made a review but it was lacking detail. this game is really fun, but it's pay to win. you start off with a decent amount of coins and you have to spend coins to play a level, to buy more decks of cards, to undo a move and to buy the magic cards. The cost of extra decks are ridiculous and not worth it. 5 times out of 10 the 5 cards you get in that extra deck are useless and you just wasted 4k for nothing and can't retry the round because you spent all your coins. Just greedy developers.

it's a fun game in the beginning but then it gets way too expensive to play. It absolutely blows my mind that you have to use coins to play each level, that alone takes a massive chunk of your coins. God forbid you need to use any of the coins on extra cards or the gold card, you end up spending like 5k coins in one level. If they didn't charge coins for the level, the game would probably be much better to play. They 100% want you to spend real money on the game so they make it hard to progress

The game is fun to play, but it definitely wants your money. When you first start playing, the gameplay is easy to pick up and engaging, but as you continue on you're flooded with different in game purchase ads. If you don't buy any, then you're forced to wait every hour to collect more coins just for even a chance to play one round. And that cycle will continue if you don't continuously win or dish out a few bucks for coins.

It is fun and addicting, but I don't like that it costs coin to make pay a round and so many coins that get through the higher levels. You always need more cards, which costs a large amount of coins. They definitely get you that way because you may have to send end money to get coins. I just wait because you can get more every hour and ever day.

the overall game is cute and fun but there's to many challenges going on at the same time. the cost to play each game is ridiculous and you lose money really fast and cant make it up. the puzzles are cute but it takes so many pieces to put it together, I mean I would literally have to play all day to achieve some of them and who's got time for that. also the cost of a wild card to get help to finish a game is to much too....I love the game but I refuse to spend real money to play any game.

Fun game, but a total money pit. ex: by lvl 200, it costs $10,000 coins to play a round. you win $12,000. It's just not sustainable, even if you win every round, and get all the bonuses. And you won't, if only because of the arbitrary nature of solitaire. My kids like watching the animations and stuff, and are actually good little helpers when we play...but the math doesn't math. You just can't win, or even play, without spending money.

the game is a fun concept, but as you get to levels 75 and higher you don't have the opportunity to earn enough coins to continue playing. ot takes an average of 3 plays per level (sometimes more) to beat it for only a pay out of 400 extra coins. using 6600+ coins to earn 2600-2900 coins seems off. I also lose every time by just one card which feels a bit rigged. the extra ways to earn coins take a super long time. this greatly limits the amount of play time I give this game at a time.

I have to echo these other reviews. As a Disney fan, I was so excited for this game, and it was actually fun at first. The themes are great. The obvious money grabs just turned me off. The game becomes impossible to play once you reach the Toy Story level, unless you're willing to pay (which, seeing how the cards are ridiculously stacked against you, is not tempting as I know my money will not go far). Fix your game and fix it quickly, because I can guarantee it will flop very soon if you don't.

Its an alright game until you reach certain levels, then after that point don't expect to make any real progress. Objectives cost double digit stars, levels cost more and more coins, and it's got a hard push pay to win through it. Levels are harder to win without spending every coin you have or money to buy coins. I've never been able to get the grand prize in all of those pop up activities because I can't win enough levels. Not a game I see keeping around long term. Definitely not worth $.

Its fun and polished but definitely wants your money. Tbf I've put no money into this game and am currently on level 350. I have plenty of coins from daily bonuses, hourly rewards, etc... but with 8-9 pop ups asking if you want to buy this or that before you can play a round, is incredibly annoying. That and levels that are clearly designed to suck your coins away or force you to fail bring the game down a little for me. Its fun if you just need something to pass the time but can be frustrating.

its very fun and addictive. however, the amount of pop ups each and every time I open the app, the time it takes to go through each 'reward' pop up, how rigged winning a game after the first few levels are, the amount of coins it takes to play 1 level. it makes the game not worth it. its frustrating and such a ploy to make you spend money (I dont have) very disappointing considering Disney definitely doesnt need it lol

I'm deleting the game. I was finally able to get into it after receiving error messages for several days; but now I can't even play 1 level without it constantly crashing. Their customer support isn't very helpful either. I might try again at some point, because I did enjoy playing the game when I was able to; but they need to correct these issues.

The concept of the gane is unique and fun. They did a great job at creating the maps, sounds, and visuals. However, the game is designed to take your coins in hopes for you to spend money. Ex. a game that cost 2,200 coins to play if you want a wild card it is 5,000 coins (the price of 2 games). If you want an additional 5 cards it is 4,000 coins (almost the price of 2 games). An undo is 700 coins. The money you make off of each round is enough to play 1 additional game.

This game is highly predatory. Sure, they will reply to all the critical reviews saying "in game purchases are optional" but they aren't really. Not if you actually want to play the game with any regularity. At higher levels you'll need to collect coins for days to play a single round and the game is not a true solitaire game, they can make it as unfair as they like forcing you to expend extreme amounts of coins because you can't beat a round without extras.

Love the idea of having disney characters involved, but I was stuck on one of the beginning levels and couldn't pass on my own. after the 3rd time playing the exact same sequence, it occurred to me that it was basically forcing me to use "coins" for extra cards. Not fair gameplay. I believe the coins should be used for "missed" cards- not "missing" cards.

the app has some good components. I am very tired of the price for a game raising constantly. I like the fact that it has different prizes and events, but they make it almost impossible to complete events. I also wish that you could click a button that says "do not show again" for the event and market ads after you sign in for the day.

absolutely loved the game at first. little to no ads & the characters are cute ! but it becomes ridiculous when you get a few levels into the game. the price to play shoots up & you're never given enough coins to play. I get paying is optional, but why can't someone create a game like this & NOT force people to have to pay money. they would have billions of people playing this game & more then half paying money because it would still be an option. this game WAS fun at first. now, uninstalled !

I'm editing my review due to same issue every else is having. Adorable game but the cost of coins goes up the more levels you play. You can't even shuffle the cards to go back through them to have a chance to win, but get stuck using your coins for extra cards. Really?? Absurd concept. The creators of this game will lose a lot of players if this game stays on this path

The game starts out easy and fun but you will get to a point quickly where you can no longer play unless you either wait 1 hour or pay money to get more coins which are used to play levels. This is a cash grab, plain and simple. There are so many "events" happening at the same time and they all push you to use your coins to progress which in turn expects you to pay real money to get more coins. Each power up is super expensive to use and it's better to restart the level.

This game was a lot of fun at first, but pretty fast, it becomes impossible to beat levels without using extra coins, which you alr have to spend (at increasing prices) to play the levels at all. You can do everything right and still end up with 1 card left bc the RNG sucks. Extra cards or a wild card are at least TWICE the cost of the level itself. So with all of the promos and extremely short events, it's obvious the real goal is to squeeze you dry with as many microtransactions as possible.

Game play was fun at first, but it when goes hill after the first day. This is the most pay to win game I've played in a long time. They make the levels unbeatable unless you have a massive amount of coins, but you can't earn coins unless you complete levels and scenes. Then they give you options to buy more coins to continue playing the Level. This wouldn't be so bad if you could actually win the levels, but they intentionally make it so you HAVE to buy additional cards.

the game is very well made, no ads at all, however it's a very obvious money grab. it definitely looks rigged to make you lose so that you buy more coins in order to just try the level again. when you get free power ups like wildcards or extra cards, for sure they will be gone by the end of the level. i really want to like the game, and invest in it but it has to be more balanced.

The 5 star reviews are very obviously paid promos and/or bot accounts. This game is one of the most egregious cash grabs. They make the first 150 levels extremely easy, but once you hit the harder levels it becomes near impossible to play without spending money. The "you get coins every hour so you can't lose" from all the fake 5 star reviews is NOT a feature. Limiting coins to every hour means you can play one game every hour if you aren't consistently winning. 1 game every hour... Yuck.

Great graphics and gameplay but like true Disney fashion they want to rob you blind! You're charged a ridiculous amount of coins to play a level, go back a turn, or for five additional cards. Each pop-up has the option to purchase more coins (also a ridiculous amount of real money) so you won't lose current winning streaks. It lost my interest after 24 hours.

I love the graphics and theme, and tri peaks is my favorite version of solitaire, but at about lvl 150, the game becomes impossible. I swear it gives you impossible decks so that you will make in app purchases, and honestly I may have to delete this app. Make it more playable, because right now it takes me 3 or 4 time to beat a lvl, and if I run out of coins I have to wait 2 hours until I can play again. Ridiculous.

this game could be so much fun if it didnt require to use money. in your responses you say "payments are optional". well, yes. but the game is purposefully made to be hard, you barely get any coins to play levels and the coins that you win per level barely get you anywhere. the game is well done, i love the design and animations, the music etc and the levels are fun. but its very obviously a cashgrab which is pretty sad..

Not truly solitaire because you're not playing with 1 or even just 2 decks of cards, but a random pull of any possible card at any time. The randomization is also clearly stacked against you, especially the longer you play. And gameplay continuation becomes unmanageably expensive for in-game currency, so that you're not playing more often than you are. When you do get a run going, it is satisfying, but that's so rare.

Game play is mostly enjoyable, but you will lose far more often than you win, and frequently you'll find yourself staring at your last card with the only possible option being a hefty expenditure of coins to get just a chance to play it. This is not single deck solitaire, and the in-game currency dwindles fast. I spent about 20 real dollars and am absolutely done. At the ultra level, you only come out two thousand coins ahead of what you paid to play the round and that's only if you win.

agreeing with most comments. game is fun and I love the Disney themes for each level. however I log in for the day and I get maybe 1 win and the cards needed to complete a level never appear. forcing a player to pay for wild or more and the price of the more cards or wild is more than the price of a new match to start. Also the amount of pop ups for you to buy or spend money is a bit much. 8 different things to close out Everytime I start the game in the morning. Clean up the make you pay please

The game itself is decent, but it is engineered to make you spend money. Bonuses for streaks, events, etc. but then they throw in a level here and there where it is literally impossible to beat without using power ups, which cost in-game currency. And if you don't have enough? No worry, here's 5 pop ups to show you where you can buy more.

Difficult to play more than one or two games at a time without paying for play time or waiting an hour for points to reload for one more game. It's a good game and I would pay a one time fee for it, as I have other games to skip the ads, but this is ridiculous! all of the challenges require purchases, as well. Sadly, I'll be uninstalling.

I'm not quite sure if you understand how games work, but each level in most games have the ability to be beaten, usually a loss is because the player messes up. This game seems to have levels that are quite literally unwinnable. You start the level and it's already decided that you can't actually win, that's poor design. I want to enjoy this game, but it's impossible to play for long periods of time and the power ups we can buy in level sometimes don't actually help.

This was a great game at the start, but I'm now around level 91 and even though everything is costing more game coins, the coins you gain per level don't make up for how much it costs to play a level, let alone pay for any bonusses. This is making it impossible to finish levels without paying actual money. Finishing events is completely impossible. Since it's a fairly new game, I'm giving it to the next update. But depending on the hourly bonuses to be able to play isn't great gameplay.

First, I gave a review about two months ago and only gave it a 2-star rating. now it looks like this app changed it to a 5 star. pay to play. Still playing... for now. I consider it a trade off, ads or shiny dangles of look what cool stuff you can spend money on. This game is clearly rigged to get you to spend actual money. You have to spend a lot of coins to play levels & even if you win the reward is barely more than you spent to play. It's a good Solitaire game, but it's a HUGE miss that you have to use coins to play levels. I want to play the game more, but I literally can't unless I either spend money or wait at least an hour for the next coin bonus. Personally I would much rather there be a heart based system.

The game graphics is superb, the scenes are adorable, but the game is a money stealer. it's a fun game, but gets crazy expensive. 2000+ coins to play one game, gets more expensive after if you choose to play a "harder" version (which gives not much of a reward? This game is fun in the beginning. I have been playing for several months. However. At a certain point whatever you have built up isn't enough. I love this game.... but it's IMPOSSIBLE to play without spending money due to the events ending WITHIN A DAY along with the puzzles and albums.... it's literally IMPOSSIBLE to finish ANYTHING.... it's becoming very frustrating if I'm being honest...... you keep saying "purchases are optional" but they're really not if you want to keep playing the game.....

It was cool and fun until it wasn't. I can see that most people feel the same and hopefully the developers will consider making changes. The app brings you in with a few good hands and then sets you up to fail. Slap a disney logo on it and you think... oh, it's Disney they won't cheat you...but they do. Please don't spend money on it. Updating to 1 star. It may be optional to buy coins but you devs make it so it feels like you have to if you want to play this game. Lvls seem rigged. Pay to Play 200% So.. The game is beautiful and whimsical and fun, but if you're not willing to spend a lot of actual money, gameplay gets very difficult very quickly. I don't know how much longer I'll keep this game on my phone.
seems like you really have to spend to play with sucks because it's a fun game makes people lose interest 🙄

really fun game just wish it actually gave you things you need. Just went through the Easter egg painting got 4 of 5 colors in a day, the other 4days I couldn't get the 5th color to save my LIFE!! Don't make stuff unwinable.

BEWARE. This game is very fun and addictive, but it is almost impossible to achieve challenges without spending money. pretty good solitaire game with little to no ads unless you want them.

This is a scam.. you do not "play" this version of solitare. you simply watch and see ifvit let's it complete.. card movements do not change the outcome of the game.. it simply clears or it does not.. then asks for moneyvto clear the level.. it basically extort you into paying to clear a level.. you can't get past level 4 without paying real world money.. it's a scam..

Extremely disappointing. I really enjoyed this game and found it so fun to play. The further you go in the game the more you have to do in-app purchases to move on. They're a trick. Want to love this game. Animation is good. Fun game play. However as many other reviews state events are set up so it's near impossible to progress without spending. Best strategy I've found is to just collect daily gifts and coins thru the day and wait to play until you have built up enough to play a few rounds.

I really do enjoy playing this game, but the constant pop-ups every 2 seconds when you first start up the game are very annoying. 90% of them are prompting you to buy something. I just want to play! Cute and fun. However, the cost (of gold) of everything is astronomical and unsustainable. The payouts are way too low compared to how much gold is needed to even play a level. I installed this game for a challenge on a rewards app.. this game is geared towards taking your money and nothing else. in order to get to one of the challenge levels I had to spend money. the minute I spent it the game took it. There is definitely an algorithm you figure out after playing for a while. This game is fun and I have willingly spent over $200 on it so far. Last night, I made a purchase but there was a bug and I did not receive the gold/items in my purchase. FRUSTRATING 😡!!! It's fun until about level 140. I am unfortunately going to have to turn my back on this app. I should not have to spend money to play more than a few minutes. It was fun at first, but isn't nearly as enjoyable as you advance. Levels get harder, which is undersrandable, but you have to spend more coins to play each level. At first I was excited about this game. DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY UNLESS YOU HAVE MONEY TO BURN. It's definitely rigged to spend money. You don't get what you need to complete a level. I love the game and all the Disney characters. update im really getting frustrated with this game to the point I dont know if I want to keep playing. This game is a cash grab, and not a very good one at that. Unless you have loads of money to spend, don't download this game. NINE times (on average)I have to close the pop up windows before I can play one game. Nine! Max playing time is around 5 min.

An unreasonably grind-heavy game, which makes in-app purchases a necessity to play for more than 5 minutes a day, due to constantly having to spend more coins than is possible to earn. Horrible level design with each level being heavily based on RNG that can make it go from a decent challenge, to needing to use hundreds of thousands of coins just to pass one level because the game refuses to give you the cards you need. I really love the gameplay. However, I am convinced that the game is rigged. You only really level up after you make a purchase. This game is so nostalgic for me and is enjoyable for my kids! The graphics are detailed and the music goes with each scene. The pop ups are a little much as they come up several times a game. It would be fun if it wasn't just a cash grab. The longer you play, you are forced to purchase or play only a game or two because they make it impossible to win without buying cards with coins. what's missing: it costs real money to earn things and move forward in levels. Biggest money grab game I've ever played and I would advise people not to install it. Starts off great but then when you reach a certain level they make it impossible to win without spending money. very poor game. for starters takes over a minute after the game has already loaded to x out of all the pop up ads they make you go through to get you to pay for coins. this happens every time you open the game and it resets with a new event every 2 or 3 days. and then after every round you sit for 30 seconds waiting for all the rewards, they don't let you skip it. lastly, game is designed for you to lose. 1/15 rounds can you win on first go without spending any kind of boost

this game is a scam!!! The more money you spend the more you lose!! I've bought plenty of the in-game packages, and every time I get them I lose all my game money immediately. starts off fun but quickly becomes a money grab. you earn coins when you pass a level, but you have to spend those coins playing the. ext round. out of coins, you have to wait an hour to be given more coins but just enough for one game unless you pass the level, then rinse and repeat. Greedy Game! Well put together, very fun, but definitely a PAY to win game. Each game is set up so that you'll need extra coins to finish, and the game doesn't allow you to earn enough coins to continue. I must say, could be an awesome as game.. but the amount of times you lose is dumb. All levels should be solvable, but clearly are not. was a fun game early on I used to be able to complete some of the events as a free to play player but they've slowly increased the amount of event items required to get rewards. you only get those rewards from winning or paying. the amount of coins needed to play a level becomes astronomical to the point you get one game an hour and 95% of that is going to be you losing and having to wait another hour just to lose again. tldr: fun but obviously cash grab

While the game is a lot of fun, it is impossible to play without spending a ton of money. Rounds become increasingly more expensive to play while the pay out stays pretty much the same. I like the game but it took me a minute to realize that you are forced to spend any coins you may earn for free period. For the most part this is a cool tri-peaks solitaire game featuring heart-warming and adorable Disney characters. Fun and relaxing with a variety of events and goals to achieve. I like it. However...as others have commented it does quickly become a less than enjoyable pay-to-advance or wait until your hourly bonus is available scenario. You'll either need deep pockets or an even deeper amount of patience to be successful. It's not yet an unplayable mess. We'll see... fingers crossed.

Money Grab. All of the events are impossible to complete or get decent rewards. You have to wait an hour to get 2 minutes of game time. I am only playing for points on another app, as soon as that time is out I will be uninstalling. Its a waste of time and money. Update: I really loved this game but as with so many good games it starts to be about money. As with everything Disney, this game is a money grab. everything is set for you to pay money. you can be on a streak it will always end with you needing 1 card more 98% of the time. same issues as other low reviews. game is made for you to have to pay. you have to save up like 16k coins now after 100 to play one game so you can buy more cards and wilds in order to win. This was fun at first but with the coin to play system, you basically get to play once and if you fail then you close it and forget about it. Cost is too high.... and by that I mean multiple things. First, the game is super fun but, the price per level & the amount of stars and coins you need to progress is egregious. all the reviews are saying the same thing & nothing is being done to correct it. costs TOO MANY coins to play the levels. which requires you to spend lots of $$ just to play or wait an hour for enough coins to play one time & if you lose the level your waiting again LOVE this game but spending too much $$ to enjoy. don't want to delete it but may not have a choice. This app's monetization is the worst I've ever seen from any app I've ever had. the issue is: the gameplay is addicting, but you never have enough coins to play! Do NOT download this game! Seems rigged in order for you to spend money. The game itself is fun....until you start losing round after round. you have to bet a few thousand just to win a few hundred. the game is obviously set up so you lose and want to spend money. Game starts you off easy with giving you plenty of gold coins to continue playing. Avoid at all costs if you are easily tricked into spending money on a very basic card game that shouldn't even be called "Solitaire".

As others have stated this game has cute Disney scenes, but the difficulty and stuff you need to gather ramps at a pretty brutal rate to the point where you spend money or lose. They also have incentives that stack when you succeed on your first attempt at a level, meaning if you "randomly" get dealt a bad hand you will have to use cash resources to win. Cash grab tactics are just overplayed at this point and it's disappointing.

This game is great but no matter how much coin you earn just to enter and play a game costs more than what u actually get for winning. It's impossible to play for free, I get spending here and there but then they make the bonuses more expensive then what u actually earn for winning so in one game you could lose a weeks worth of savings.
