Pretty decent game if you have at least $90k coins minimum. It feels like the game is rigged against you when you have less coins to play with and it's harder to earn fast when you can't spend fast. I have a few screenshots of multiple times when the same card is in play twice... you can't make strategic decisions when there ends up being six 10 cards in one game.

I downloaded this game and was super excited....for 20 minutes. The algorithm for the cards forces you to not play for hours while gaining coins. (every 1 hour equals 1 "game" of coins) but you have to spend coins to finish a round no matter your skill level. I am so close to undownloading it because pay to play games are nothing but selfish, and that's exactly what this is. But in all honesty, what else should anyone expect from a Disney game. The optional purchases comments are BS just an FYI

it's extremely irritating how many coins you have to spend to play a level and if you keep losing you lose massive amounts of your coins. Once you get up there, there's way too many levels that are difficult to beat and if you can't then all your hard earned coins are gone 🤷🏼‍♀️ and it's absolutely ridiculous the amount of coins you have to spend to get an extra deck at the end or a wild card. Disney sucks in every aspect! Do better!

I started playing this game because I love both Disney, solitaire, and because it was offered on branded surveys. I actually spent money and points on the game which is unusual for me. However, the game was only offered for a very short period of time. Once the offer expired, I could no longer justify spending money on the game. Too bad. It was a lot of fun

Pay coin for every level try doesn't seems right. Trying to win with help also pay coin. After some level, the coin always decreased after completing a level. Ended up with me running out of coin, and can't play anymore. Maybe, better with energy system, and the coin just for the help inside the game, or give some other way to earn coin besides waiting for 1 hour for 1 try. Besides, the game is also based on luck, so it's imposible to always win the game on any level.

it's a fun game, BUT....you have these bonus "film" things that you have to watch an ad to get the stuff. And while I don't mind the ad, I DO mind that it is constantly kicking me to the play store after the ad, and then when I try to get out of that, it's booted me out of the game and starts over. Getting pretty frustrating when I'm just trying to get some bonus stuff.

ok.. but... The game gets you hooked by being easy at first but at about level 100 the deck is stacked with useless cards so you have to spend coins to finish the round. The only way to get more coins is to spend money (or wait an hour for more). If you don't have money to spend on the game, you can only play for about 2 minutes and you're done for an hour.

Fine, if you don't mind occupying your time with a ton of grind. I downloaded the game through the Free Cash app to give it a try; but after a few unlocked achievements, I have to get rid of this game. ten rounds to complete a puzzle would be fair, but twenty rounds just for a puzzle piece is atrocious. too demanding; would not recommend.

Rigged game. Fun at first, but difficult to progress. It is very obvious that they want you to spend real money to keep playing. I don't do in-app purchases, so I have to wait an hour to be rewarded enough coins to play the next level, only to have them stack the cards in such a way that forces me to use more coins to "maybe" draw the card I would've needed to win, no guarantees. Forget trying to save up enough coins to play this game for more than a few minutes at a time.

This game is fun and I like the variety beyond a basic solitaire game, but the amount of coins that you get daily gets you maybe three tries, and then every hour you get one more try. So unless you are paying tons of money, you get very VERY limited game time. Other games you at least can spin a wheel or watch an ad to continue playing but not here.

it's not the traditional solitaire game. it's geared towards kids but as you advance the levels, kids may get frustrated because it gets harder to beat unless you have A LOT of coins and then parents aren't going to spend money on the actual game so kids have to wait days to accumulate enough coins to beat the level without ending the game if you run out of cards and don't have enough coins. otherwise, it is a fun game but kids may need parents help with the more difficult levels

The gameplay is fine. The biggest issue for me is that the mini games they run don't last very long in comparison to other games. Hopefully they will eventually figure out how to create teams for people to work together for collecting items. I'm not too far into the game, but I'm already stuck with losing a lot. The puzzle collecting is near impossible when it seems the game wants you to lose if you're doing too well.

Editing my review to say definitively, do not install this game. My previous review explained that it was excruciating when trying to play without spending money, and after actually spending, i can confidently say it's STILL excruciating after spending money. Levels become unplayably difficult that it drains your bank instantly. How did I go from 100k coins to 20k after two levels? Uninstalled. If you can shell out $13 constantly, sure, but i'd avoid.

it's fun! And right now it's easy to do! But wait until you get to level 70. My coins disappeared and I didn't get any more of them! It started to present me with offers to buy more. ARE YOU JOKING???? There's no way I am putting money into a silly game!!! I will be deleting it after writing this review! Also, the game's Support says they are working on changing the way the game works. DON'T BELIEVE THEM!! And to Support, don't leave some crazy, soupy answer to this review.

Total money grab! It starts out easy and fun with all the characters you love, but then it requires more and more coins to complete a single hand. Like others have said, it is obviously rigged; once you purchase more coins, you suddenly start winning hands again... to a point. Then the cycle starts all over again. It's infuriating and so disappointing. Don't fall for it!

it's cute. I don't like how costly it seems to be with in-game currency. I'm pretty sure that because I make easy mistakes, I'm going to become coinless and unable to get further in the story. or, it'll cost me real money at some point. Solitaire is more fun when you're not struggling to just earn enough coin to pay for the level being played.

As others have said, it feels like they feed you cards that make it impossible to win without spending extra coins. I do like the events, and the game is cute, but in no real odds should you be regularly given 6 cards in a row with none of them being playable. playing more than two levels in a row is rare due to the coins they expect you to use.

This game is a 5 star game! very well made and brings me back to my nostalgia! However... the algorithm they use FORCES you to buy coins, no matter how skilled you are at TriPeaks solitaire. it is extremely annoying and very obvious that they force you to buy coins. I will be deleting after I reach checkpoint 10 in Mistplay. Nostalgia is not worth buying, and buying, and buying some more, just to be able to play a couple card hands. Stop with the greed, Disney. Your greed loses customers.

An arbitration clause is awful to have in a random spin-off solitare game. That plus it really feels like a good portion of games are force losses at the end to try and get the end user to drain their coins faster, causing players to get stuck. (unless you pay up) I wish mobile games could monetize themselves without being this predatory about it. Of course there are worse examples, but that doesn't excuse it here. The gameplay is fine so I won't give it 1 star, but do better.

Could be a great game, but boy, are they greedy. You get one game every hour for free via bonus coins you can collect. Every game won gives you a bonus between 250 and 500 coins, but it costs 2300 (for me at this point) to play one round. Boosts in the game (like +5 cards) cost i.e. 4000 coins. Don't even try throwing your money at the game, you'll end up broke... 4 dollars give you 5 rounds to play in coins that's just ridiculous. Uninstalling now

it's a fun game, but it's very addictive and almost impossible to play without spending money. every hour, you receive enough coins to play once, and the levels are getting more and more difficult which is frustrating bc you have to wait another hour just to try again the daily events are cute, though, with lots of prizes for me, this addiction became an issue, and I seriously think I should stop

The game is super cute! I enjoy playing it. I wish the add ons to continue a level weren't so many coins though. It's discouraging to use a huge chunk of coins to continue and then fail the level. I'd be willing to purchase coins occasionally if I didn't feel like I'd lose them almost immediately.

Very sad.. LOVED this game at first, but it definitely needs to be rebalanced for higher levels coin wise. I'm almost done with Moana and it cost 4400 coins a game, but only gives 2200 every hour only if you log in to collect and re start the timer. Thats not on top of special cards costing 10k plus coins. So as you can see you have to log in every few hrs just to play again, which the levels are almost impossible to beat without hecka coins for the Xtra cards , ultimately forcing you to spend$

Not solitaire, so don't be fooled by that. Also the fact you have to spend gold to play levels is an insane choice by the developers. Especially when the levels only seem to have one correct answer so, if you run out of cards and need more to finish, you're spending a massive amount of gold to finish one level. Also not for kids with the amount of pop up ads for purchases.

I want to like this game so much but after many times getting down to one card left and having over a dozen left in my deck I still can't win. It's very clear that this game is set up to only make you spend money. They need to take a page out of Fishdom's solitaire game and give you coins for each card you've earned. It's almost unplayable without spending money.

Cute game and addictive. BUT it's really designed to separate you from your money. No ads because you cannot get past level 40 without bleeding coins either through buying more hands or wildcards to finish. Each level gets more and more loaded for the house so that you will go from having 20k coins to not enough to keep playing by level 43 or 44. They want to sell you more coins but it will only decline each time. Don't let your kids play this one. The house always wins.

its fun but I don't like as you beat levels the coins you earn you have to pay and use them to play the next level. the amount gets higher and higher as you pass more levels to buy into the next level which is dumb. the coins should be spent on undos or continuations to help you pass the levels. shouldn't have to cost to play the next one. I also don't like that if I do spend my coins on an extra 5 cards to help me beat the level, it doesn't always give me a card to do that. otherwise great.

One of the most predatory games I’ve played. It's generous with rewards, but progress depends on rigged matches that push you toward using up free boosts and coins, or you have to end the game and lose event progress and associated rewards. Alternative is to buy coins to continue, which is optional only if you're ok waiting and starting over. Disney shouldn’t have approved this exploitative setup.

I love Disney, but this game quickly turned into a massive dissapointment. I am level 89 and can barely afford to keep playing as the cost of playing far outweighs the rewards for completing levels. I HAVE spent money in this game as I like progressing and puzzle games. But enough is enough. It becomes a pure cash grab past level 50. It cost 2x more than the level for a wildcard, sometimes 3x 4x more for extra cards. Not to mention the reminder to buy coins after each level or game start. Unsub.

I love this game. All accept one thing. the fact that it costs thousands of coins to play one round and thousands more to get an extra card if you want a chance to win a level just blows my mind. I stupidly purchased coins and went through 300k coins in less than an hour. why the hell does it have to cost so much to play?! for some reason, all these solitare games are the same, and I hate it. I just want a game that is reasonable to play. I will be uninstalling it due to this.

starts out great. then quickly becomes almost unplayable due to coins and the clear mechanics to get you to spend money. multiple events and passes all at the same time all costing money. you can hardly play a level with out being berated by mechanics to spend money. your hourly coins only which is good for 1 play only collect if you login. daily coins are slightly more but don't match the exponential cost of wild cards and moves that the game clearly forces you to use to spend more money.

I've played for about a month and have decided this isn't worth my time. the game simply does not want you to play past 10 minutes a day. The events are rigged in favor of the house. Its not random and it appears that those who leave 5 star reviews are lying or have not really played the game.. what a joke. a suggested improvement: if you finish a level and have gold cards left in your deck - carry them over into a bank for future plays.

money hungry app. DO NOT INSTALL!! My wife and I instantly fell in love with this game as it was fun and is a card game with a beautiful disney/Pixar flare. At least that's what it seems like till you get a few levels in. The app creators charge a lot for minimal coins to play and the more you play the more each level will cost you. I've put countless money into the app and I can barely get through 1 level which is ridiculous bc they want you to keep spending. Uninstalled!

Disney Solitaire is designed to make you spend real money to win. Unlike most games which give you 5 lives that replenish over time, this game makes you spend in-game coins to play a level. The amount of coins you win if you beat a level is hardly more than the cost to play a level, and if you fail, you actually end up losing more coins than you win. Beating a level is based on the luck of the draw as opposed to having skill or strategy. It ends up being more frustrating than fun. Uninstalling.

Edit after more levels of play: this game gets really tough and annoying to play at higher levels. Everything costs so many coins to play. if you're playing mega mode good luck as everything costs x4 and even after spending coins for extra cards you still don't win the level. Very frustrating. This game has been addicting so far and so fun! I do wish that the characters helped you or had their own special ability depending on which scene you were in.

OK at first, but after about 100 levels it's basically required to pay for wilds and other power ups to complete a level in one try. These can be earned with in game gold, but there is only so much free gold so chances are your play time will be limited unless you want to spend. I'm all for supporting games, but by level 100 it's basically $1 per game if you want to play more than a couple games at a time

While the premise of this game is fun, it's a complete money-grab. Once you get a few levels in, majority of the puzzles become nearly impossible and take several tries to solve, while using your avaliable coins to start each puzzle. Not fun for someone who doesn't want to drop tons of real money into a mobile game.

Get any other solitaire game. This game was fun, but yeah it basically tries to convince you to either constantly login in to claim the free hourly currency to play or spend real money. Like I enjoyed it, but I get stuck on a level for a day.....and then maybe get 2 levels, before back to a whole day stuck. The cards given dont even make sense. I only have one card to match to start the level but the first 2 cards aren't what I need. Not worth it and I've had it maybe a week or 2 and I'm done

It doesn't take long before you get to like maybe 30 or 40 levels and then you can only play one level. and it's not long before that that you can't even get through that level but once a day. which is approximately 3 to 5 minutes of gameplay tops. when you have to buy extra cards they cost way too much. so if you want to spend money this is a game for you. the randomization in this game for which card is drawn is skewed very heavily towards the game. It literally just gave me 7 jacks in a row

I still have this game, however, agreeing with everyone.. there's no way to earn coins without having to pay for them half of the time. Crazy expensive. Too many annoying pop up ads. The game also advertised that if you invite your friend, you can both get rewards.. but that never happened after she reached level 20. It is a very fun game though besides all of that annoyance

It's not bad, I'm on lvl 400+ (0$ spend, I'm f2p) but overall it's boring. You pass levels and do tasks, that's it. There is no interaction with characters, you cannot choose what scene to display - f.e I want to have an option to choose finished scenes and see them instead of scene for which i have tasks. And also to have an album with finished puzzles. Also add option to change nickname. I will not delete game, but will wait for next updates - mb devs will give more interesting content.

It's a fun time killer until about level 70. Then it's a pay to win solitaire. I'm on level 96 and I had 3 cards left on the board and about 15-ish left in the deck. Not a single one could be matched and it forced me to lose my winning streak. The scenes are cute and the art style is great but how much you need to pay just to get to the higher levels is insane.

It's okay. It's not truly a solitaire game. I never received my bonus gift for inviting others who followed my link and played the game. You can run out of coins quickly, especially if you use them on wild cards or extra packs to complete a streak. No annoying ads, which is a plus. I'm not sure if I'll keep playing, even though it is fun

I love the game, The only reason why it's not five stars is cause it can be annoying and frustrating to spend so much coins when you have one card left but you don't get a card you need to win. I work part time so I can't just buy more coins all the time I have to wait for the free coins once an hour(if I'm able to) and try again but if I fail then I have to wait another hour to play the same level and it took me over a day once to finish one level cause of that.

Should have read all the reviews before downloading. While the game mechanics are good and it's fun to play.. all of the reviews that mention a bunch of pop ups when you open it are accurate. All of the reviews that say after a certain level you are going to have to pay in order to advance are accurate. You get a few daily coins which are spent paying them to even play a game if you don't play at a tougher level then you don't win enough to do anything... loved it at first but it's not worth it.

i have had to change my original review. do NOT download this game unless you have no spending limit. it is literally impossible to come out on top without spending a lot of money. the earnings dont match what you put out. you pay for every level and only make more coins IF you pass it on the first deal. otherwise, you are putting out double, if not more, the amount you get back. just proves that there is never enough money for disney and they dont actually care about their fans

Not every match is winnable. It's an exhausting chore to keep playing/collect coins. It feels predatory and loses its fun, despite its beautiful design. I LOVE solitaire, I love Disney, but this game is frustrating on both fronts. I recommend deleting it from your phone. If they ever fix the game and make it so that every match is actually winnable (still challenging tho! just possible, rather than impossible), I will download again. Stay away for now.

This is a fun game to play. I really enjoyed it. The problem is, you only get enough coins to play one game every hour, and if you're not there to collect those coins, they don't add up. You only get the coins for the one single game you haven't played yet. As a result, when the levels get harder and it takes multiple tries to get through each level, and you're only getting that one try at a time, it becomes not worth your time.

I would really like to play this game more. You will need to spend money to get coins in order to play this game. I played this for an insulting amount of time, then I did not have enough coins to continue playing; I took the lack of coins as a sign that perhaps I shouldn't play this game after all. It did not take many rounds before I either had to wait or pay. TDLR: Atrocious monetization resulting in inability to play after a few games.

This game has lovely details in the animation but it has aggressive, timer-based monetization, so it's not kid friendly or good for people with conditions it can take advantage of. There's also some strange things going on under the hood--a timer that was around 18 hours suddenly went down to 4 minutes, I got the same cards in both the layout and deck that seemed to be designed to leave me with one less card than I needed to win, even after using a power up... I'm not sure I trust the game.

It is a fun game and all but it cost way to many coins to play, so if you are low on coins then you have to wait until hour to get just enough coins to play at once unless you of course want to buy more.The helps(wild cards, or 4 extra cards) take a ridiculous amount of coins to. It isn't as fun if i can only play one game and hour because I don't get lucky enough to win enough games to earn coins to play more than one or twice an hour.

Would be a much higher rating if the levels were actually playable without having to spend money. Each level is random in terms of what cards are revealed which can be fun just like any solitaire however there are some random plays where I didn't have the cards to play in the deck. Very frustrating because you have to spend your in game coins to get something playable. Hopefully since this game is new the hands get tuned. Still fun though. Just wish you didn't have to pay money every other level

the game itself is cute, although not too much different than other similar games. that being said, it's very similar to other games where it becomes almost impossible to pass levels after a while, you start running out of coins, you need to spend money to keep on playing or you get enough bonus coins to play one game every 2 hours.

It's a cute little game. And it could earn 5 stars if the coins count was correct, but it's not. Every time one wants to play has to pay 2000 coins for the attempt to pass the lvl. (why?) And the amount of coins required for 5+ cards is insane. Not sure why I should pay double the price if the game is giving me 5 or more cards not useful to finish the lvl. Give us lives or something, or make us earn more coins for the completion of the lvl.

edited to add: absolutely horrible customer service. missing out on completing challenges bc a reward was not given when purchased. very fun to play, but to be able to beat any of the special events, you literally have to buy more coins, which takes a lot of the fun out of the game itself. I feel like the daily boost helps but not enough for true enjoyment and not to help with beating any of the extra challenges.

Asking players to spend in-game currency per level is crazy work. And that requirement increases per level. The actual game is like solitaire, but its basically luck based. You may never the the get cards you need to finish the level and have to use the scarce pwrups. They tried to copy Royal match but the events reward you with basically nothing. If you got $ to blow, go for it.

Starting out this game seems fair and strategic but as you progress you will come to realise there's no strategy at all except to force you to buy coins to play. The graphics are nice and the game play is faultless however it doesn't take long to realise this is not luck of the cards as solitaire should be and in some instances it's obvious extortion to pass a level. By level 150 you will see exactly how this game is blatantly geared to force you to spend.

I mean it when I say this game is addictive, not in a good way, a bad way. The game is based off of a coin based system where it costs coins to play a single game that you aren't guaranteed to win because the cards being pulled come off as completely random. You will sometimes pull 5 cards off of your deck before you even have anything playable. That being said the more games you lose the more you have to retry with your coins, and then you're out for the next hour. (CASHGRAB)

I enjoyed playing this game at first. The first day, I actually spent my own money and was up to 400k in coins... I found out pretty quickly that your coin balance doesn't last nearly long enough. Before the end of the day, I was spending more money to keep playing. I wait for the daily and hourly rewards. Even then, sometimes I don't even get to complete a level.

I'm currently on level 283 and what do you mean it now costs 10,000 coins to play!? You have to play the Epic Level to be able to get by in the game and get the rewards otherwise its takes way too long on the Standard Level. Yes, I've spent on the game to play cause it's a good game. But.... Now it's coming to the point where after I've spent these coins I might as well cut my loses and uninstall the game because it's going to end up costing more than it's worth 😑

It had such high potential.. I absolutely loved this game at first. however, the coins to play each game is ridiculous and when you do win a game that payout is nominal in comparison to what you spent to actually play it. therefore, I find that you're only able to play a handful of games in an entire day without spending your own money. I highly recommend they reduce the cost to play each game while increasing the payouts. until these changes are made, I am no longer playing the game.

they always make it much harder towards the last puzzles of a level which almost forces you to spend money to beat it but being patient makes it so you don't have to. I'm kind of tired of apps that you have to spend money to still level up. it's nice to play a game that you can just play.. especially when you're already paying for a Play store subscription.

okay so this game is super fun super addictive the graphics are adorable it's obviously like any other game like this however my main complaint with this game is that it's pretty easy in the beginning stages but as you go along it makes it to where you have no option really but you spend money if you want to progress in the game. you can still do it without spending money it's just going to take you a lot longer and at that point I lose interest so there are better games out there for solitaire

So sad after the daily 4th in-a-row game you start losing options to play... yes losing while playing correctly in the free version at least. Good looking though but an excessive amount of sound and visual effects in-between each game that don't bring any more value to it. This well-known franchise might surely have others games that simply let you play more time per day. In conclusion, the payment option might let play more than 10 min per day (free version) since the content is quite limited.

I pre-registered for this game because it was Disney. It was fun the first few days, but like everyone else is saying it's a money grab/pay to win game. It's ridiculous to pay close to 10,000 coins to play a hand. Right now for me to purchase a wild card it's 20,000 coins!! 2xs the amount to play the hand, for 5 extra cards it's at 9,000. If it's going to stay costing a lot of coins to play a hand, there needs to be more ways to get coins that doesn't involve waiting or real money.

I went from enjoying it a lot to depleting all my coins once I got to the Frozen scene. They tweak the levels, so that the fail rate is high and the cost for five cards or a wild card is more than your rewards. Do not install. It is a money grab. The game is beautiful I will give it that, but being beautiful is not enough to be good

The game was really nice and addictive but the more you advance the more it becomes impossible to play without buying coins and the coins are just not enough. I am in level 311 and even with 110000 is practically impossible to win. The game is practically useless at this point. Are you making new levels for millionaires? or is this your idea for interesting? There are many other solitaire that at least give you an option to earn your coins not buy your wins. I am not buying anymore packages.

This game is 100000% pay to win. It's fun at first, but it stops being fun the more expensive everything gets. The prizes for in-game events are unattainable. The kitchen especially! You'll get to the last one, and it will be IMPOSSIBLE to obtain the remaining ingredients without spending $$$$. If you have a prize boost, don't even count on that. They are determined to get every penny out of every player. Disgusting - but what else do you expect from Disney

pretty good game but very much rigged to make you spend money, what do you expect being Disney right? will keep feeding you cards to make you feel like your progressing then you will have days of only going up a few levels and getting no wins with constant nagging to buy bundles that are on "special". currently lv. 166+ so I've had more then enough gametime for my review.

It's fun, but they screw you. When I have no coins left for a wild card or an additional 5 cards, I always end up with 1 card left. When I have coins, I have too many cards left and not enough funds to get more than 1 wild card or 5 additional cards. I am not going to spend money to play solitaire. I thought this was like any other solitaire game. Nope. "Gotta pay to play."

Not playable after the first day. Once you get to a certain point, its extremely difficult to beat a level without using coins. Once you run out of coins, you have to wait an hour to get roughly 2,000, but you need 4,000+ to beat the levels. It's by far the most "pay to play" game I've seen from a major company.

Was fun originally, but basically a pay to play. And when I paid, it has crashed /quit three times now and doesn't give me the active offer trails. While the graphics are fun, the payment--and app instability/ frequent crashes-- are not. Update: I didn't hear back after I reached out the way requested... then had a similar issue again. Despite the fact that I reached over level 300, I deleted the app. Done spending money on an app that crashes AND requires so many purchases to continue play.

a disaster just like the snow white movie. this game forces you to pay real money. you can't beat two levels in a row without losing. each time you want to play a level (even if it's a replay) you should spend gold and they give you gold needed to play it every one hour! it means you can play just once every one hour! and all the power ups need gold! sometimes you get to the final card on the field with 10 cards in your hand and the game doesn't give you the card you need. so you have to buy! 😡

So disappointed! I honestly thought this would be a fun little game... and then I saw all my coins disappearing at an insane rate. I barely made it to the 3rd scene before my entire game came grinding to halt. Ridiculous coin pricing, impossible to earn it back even when you win. I have to age with others , this game is sadly a massive cash grab. Save yourself money and disappointment, find a better app. :(

I enjoy playing the game because the cut scenes are fun to unlock. The only problem I have with it is that the higher the level, the more coins you need to play it. I think the coins should be set the same for all levels. This is because the scenes at higher levels already require a lot more levels to get through. Having both a coin increase and more levels to pass makes it too challenging. It should be one or the other(preferably more levels to pass to unlock a scene at the higher levels)

Really fun and smooth game, but (as many other reviews have said) if you want to continue to play beyond level 50, buying coins is almost necessary. The algorithm and everything reminds me a lot of Monopoly GO!, which again, really pushes buying packs to play more. Sure its optional to buy, but they constantly push extra coin packs.

like the golf one, fun but you don't have enough options to earn coins in order to play levels and levels are set up in a way that makes them impossible sometimes. going through 50% of the deck before you can move even one car makes it not as fun. if you fail one level you pretty much are done playing for at least an hour while you wait for your coins to load. and regularly there is 1 card left that doesn't go with anything and you have to fail a level with one card

No. Ads. Thank goodness!!! Difficult but fun puzzles. I am on level 219 as of this review. The game bonus resets every hour, giving you another go if you lost, and don't have enough coins to immediately try again. You also receive daily bonuses, bonus games and optional 2x and 4x the amount game play. It is very generous. There are options to buy of course, but you aren't forced to buy to keep playing. just tempted. love this game!
Fun and easy levels, no annoying ads.

great game at first but you cant earn enough coins to cope with the amount of re tries you need for most levels, money runs out just trying to get past 1 level and the opportunities to win coins aren't worth much coins

This game is the very definition of predatory. Tinkerbell getting mad at me for not spending more coins for power ups to MAYBE complete the level is a nice touch. Disney should really pull the licensing from this one. Bad look for Tink. As soon as you run out of coins, delete.
It is captivating. The game will catch you attention quickly at the begining amd will not let go. A different approach for a solitaire game. It is worth a try
